+let isaFlixAuthPending = {};

+window.__isaMemberSessionDone = function(id, raw) {
+    const cb = isaFlixAuthPending[id];
+    if (!cb) return;
+    delete isaFlixAuthPending[id];
+    let result = {};
+    try { result = JSON.parse(raw || '{}'); } catch (_) {}
+    cb(result);
+};

+window.__isaMemberLoginDone = function(id, raw) {

+    if (!cb) return;

+function isaFlixNativeCall(method, args, callbackName, callback) {
+    const id = String(++isaFlixAuthRequestId);
+    isaFlixAuthPending[id] = callback;
+    try {
+        if (!window.ISATV || typeof ISATV[method] !== 'function') {
+            delete isaFlixAuthPending[id];
+            callback({ok:false, error:'Giriş servisine ulaşılamadı.'});
+            return;
+        }
+        ISATV[method](...(args || []), id);
+    } catch (e) {
+        delete isaFlixAuthPending[id];
+        callback({ok:false, error:'İşlem gerçekleştirilemedi.'});
+    }
+}

+    function nativeCall(method, args, callback) {
+        if (typeof isaFlixNativeCall !== "function") {
+            if (callback) callback({ok:false});
+            return;
+        }
+        isaFlixNativeCall(method, args || [], "", callback || function(){});
+    }

+    function card() {
+        return document.getElementById("isa-central-broadcast");

+    function stopLocal(id) {
+        if (!id || !window.ISATV ||
+                typeof ISATV.stopBroadcast !== "function") return;
+
+        try { ISATV.stopBroadcast(String(id)); } catch (_) {}

+        if (openedBroadcastId === String(id)) {

+    function render(item) {

+
+        if (!item) {

+    function openBroadcast() {

+        const id = String(currentBroadcast.id);

+                if (window.ISATV &&

+    function handleList(result) {
+        polling = false;

+            if (currentBroadcast && currentBroadcast.id) {

+            closedBroadcastId = "";

+            ? String(currentBroadcast.id) : "";

+function isaFlixRequireLogin() {
+    if (isaFlixAuthenticated) {
+        isaFlixRender();
+        isaFlixAddLogoutButton();
+
+        if (typeof startCatalogAutoUpdate === 'function') {

+        private final android.os.Handler broadcastMonitorHandler =
+                new android.os.Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper());

+        private volatile String monitoredBroadcastId = "";

+        private final Runnable broadcastMonitorRunnable = new Runnable() {
+            @Override
+            public void run() {
+                final String id = monitoredBroadcastId;
+
+                if (id == null || id.isEmpty()) {
+                    return;
+                }
+

+                    boolean authoritative = false;
+                    boolean found = false;
+

+                        String token = readMemberToken();
+

+                            );

+                            JSONArray broadcasts =
+                                    response.optJSONArray("broadcasts");
+
+                            authoritative =
+                                    response.optInt("_http_status", 0) == 200
+                                    && response.optBoolean("ok", false)
+                                    && broadcasts != null;
+

+                                for (int i = 0; i < broadcasts.length(); i++) {
+                                    JSONObject item = broadcasts.optJSONObject(i);
+

+                                    }

+                                monitoredBroadcastId = "";
+                                broadcastMonitorHandler.removeCallbacks(
+                                        broadcastMonitorRunnable
+                                );

+                    }

+        };

+            );

+        // İSAFLİX kalıcı üye oturumu: token yalnızca AndroidKeyStore
+        // AES/GCM ile şifrelenmiş olarak SharedPreferences içinde tutulur.
+        private static final String MEMBER_API =
+                "https://isa-admin-api.githuba85.workers.dev";
+        private static final String MEMBER_PREFS =
+                "isaflix_member_session";
+        private static final String MEMBER_KEY_ALIAS =
+                "isaflix_member_session_key";
+
+        private android.content.SharedPreferences memberPrefs() {
+            return getSharedPreferences(MEMBER_PREFS, MODE_PRIVATE);
+        }
+
+        private SecretKey memberSecretKey() throws Exception {
+            KeyStore store = KeyStore.getInstance("AndroidKeyStore");
+            store.load(null);
+
+            java.security.Key existing = store.getKey(MEMBER_KEY_ALIAS, null);
+            if (existing instanceof SecretKey) return (SecretKey) existing;
+
+            KeyGenerator generator = KeyGenerator.getInstance(
+                    KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_AES, "AndroidKeyStore"
+            );
+            generator.init(new KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder(
+                    MEMBER_KEY_ALIAS,
+                    KeyProperties.PURPOSE_ENCRYPT |
+                            KeyProperties.PURPOSE_DECRYPT
+            ).setBlockModes(KeyProperties.BLOCK_MODE_GCM)
+             .setEncryptionPaddings(KeyProperties.ENCRYPTION_PADDING_NONE)
+             .setRandomizedEncryptionRequired(true)
+             .build());
+
+            return generator.generateKey();
+        }
+
+        private void saveMemberToken(String token) throws Exception {
+            Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding");
+            cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, memberSecretKey());
+
+            byte[] encrypted = cipher.doFinal(
+                    token.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
+            );
+
+            memberPrefs().edit()
+                    .putString("token_cipher",
+                            Base64.encodeToString(encrypted, Base64.NO_WRAP))
+                    .putString("token_iv",
+                            Base64.encodeToString(cipher.getIV(), Base64.NO_WRAP))
+                    .apply();
+        }
+
+        private String readMemberToken() throws Exception {
+            String encryptedText = memberPrefs().getString("token_cipher", "");
+            String ivText = memberPrefs().getString("token_iv", "");
+            if (encryptedText.isEmpty() || ivText.isEmpty()) return null;
+
+            byte[] encrypted = Base64.decode(encryptedText, Base64.NO_WRAP);
+            byte[] iv = Base64.decode(ivText, Base64.NO_WRAP);
+
+            Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding");
+            cipher.init(
+                    Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE,
+                    memberSecretKey(),
+                    new GCMParameterSpec(128, iv)
+            );
+
+            return new String(
+                    cipher.doFinal(encrypted),
+                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8
+            );
+        }
+
+        private String memberDeviceId() {
+            String id = memberPrefs().getString("device_id", "");
+            if (id.isEmpty()) {
+                id = java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString();
+                memberPrefs().edit().putString("device_id", id).apply();
+            }
+            return id;
+        }
+
+        private JSONObject memberHttp(
+                String method, String path, String token, JSONObject body
+        ) throws Exception {
+            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
+            try {
+                URL url = new URL(MEMBER_API + path);
+                connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
+                connection.setRequestMethod(method);
+                connection.setConnectTimeout(15000);
+                connection.setReadTimeout(20000);
+                connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json");
+
+                if (token != null && !token.isEmpty()) {
+                    connection.setRequestProperty(
+                            "Authorization", "Bearer " + token
+                    );
+                }
+
+                if (body != null) {
+                    connection.setDoOutput(true);
+                    connection.setRequestProperty(
+                            "Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8"
+                    );
+                    byte[] bytes = body.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
+                    try (java.io.OutputStream output = connection.getOutputStream()) {
+                        output.write(bytes);
+                        output.flush();
+                    }
+                }
+
+                int status = connection.getResponseCode();
+                java.io.InputStream input = status >= 200 && status < 400
+                        ? connection.getInputStream()
+                        : connection.getErrorStream();

+                try {

+                } catch (Exception ignored) {
+                    result = new JSONObject();
+                }
+                result.put("_http_status", status);
+                return result;
+            } finally {
+                if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
+            }
+        }

        settings.setJavaScriptEnabled(true);
        settings.setDomStorageEnabled(true);

        settings.setAllowContentAccess(true);
        settings.setJavaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically(true);
        settings.setMediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture(false);
        settings.setMixedContentMode(
                WebSettings.MIXED_CONTENT_ALWAYS_ALLOW);
        settings.setLoadsImagesAutomatically(true);
        settings.setUseWideViewPort(true);

        });

        webView.setWebChromeClient(new WebChromeClient() {
            @Override
            public boolean onShowFileChooser(
                    WebView view,
                    ValueCallback<Uri[]> callback,
                    FileChooserParams params) {

                if (fileCallback != null) {
                    fileCallback.onReceiveValue(null);
                }

                fileCallback = callback;

                try {
                    startActivityForResult(
                            params.createIntent(),
                            FILE_REQUEST
                    );
                    return true;
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    fileCallback = null;
                    callback.onReceiveValue(null);
                    return false;
                }
            }

    private void createTvLogo() {
        if (!shouldShowTvLogo()) return;

        try {
            tvLogo = new ImageView(this);

            try (java.io.InputStream input =
                    getAssets().open("isa-tv-hd/assets/logo.png")) {
                tvLogo.setImageBitmap(
                        BitmapFactory.decodeStream(input)
                );
            }

            tvLogo.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.FIT_CENTER);
            tvLogo.setPadding(dp(5), dp(5), dp(5), dp(5));
            tvLogo.setBackgroundColor(0x880F0F0F);
            tvLogo.setContentDescription("İSA TV HD");

            FrameLayout.LayoutParams params =
                    new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                            dp(145),
                            dp(90),
                            Gravity.TOP | Gravity.RIGHT
                    );

            params.setMargins(0, dp(16), dp(22), 0);
            root.addView(tvLogo, params);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "TV logosu yüklenemedi", e);
        }
    }

    private int dp(float value) {
        return (int) (
                value * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density
                + 0.5f
        );
    }

    private boolean shouldShowTvLogo() {
        Configuration c = getResources().getConfiguration();

        boolean landscape =
                c.orientation == Configuration.ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE;

        boolean television =
                (c.uiMode & Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_MASK)
                == Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_TELEVISION;

        boolean tablet = c.smallestScreenWidthDp >= 600;

        return landscape && (television || tablet);
    }

    public class ISATVBridge {

        @JavascriptInterface
        public void play(
                String name,
                String url,
                String headersJson,
                String queueJson,
                int selectedIndex) {

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (url == null ||
                        !url.matches("(?i)^https?://.*")) {
                    return;
                }

                Intent intent = new Intent(
                        MainActivity.this,
                        PlayerActivity.class
                );

                intent.putExtra("stream_url", url);
                intent.putExtra(
                        "channel_name",
                        name == null ? "İSA TV HD" : name
                );
                intent.putExtra(
                        "headers_json",
                        headersJson == null ? "{}" : headersJson
                );
                
try {
    java.io.File queueFile = new java.io.File(
            getCacheDir(),
            "isa-player-queue.json"
    );

    try (java.io.FileOutputStream output =
                 new java.io.FileOutputStream(queueFile, false)) {
        output.write(
                (queueJson == null ? "[]" : queueJson)
                        .getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
        );
        output.flush();
    }

    intent.putExtra("queue_file", queueFile.getAbsolutePath());
    intent.putExtra("selected_index", selectedIndex);
    startActivity(intent);

} catch (Exception e) {
    android.util.Log.e("ISATV", "Kanal kuyruğu aktarılamadı", e);
}

            });
        }


        @JavascriptInterface
        public String getFavorites() {
            return getSharedPreferences("isa_tv_data", MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .getString("favorites", "[]");
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public void setFavorite(String channelJson, boolean favorite) {
            try {
                JSONObject channel = new JSONObject(channelJson);
                String url = channel.optString("url", "");
                if (url.isEmpty()) return;

                android.content.SharedPreferences prefs =
                        getSharedPreferences("isa_tv_data", MODE_PRIVATE);

                JSONArray old = new JSONArray(prefs.getString("favorites", "[]"));
                JSONArray updated = new JSONArray();

                for (int i = 0; i < old.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject item = old.optJSONObject(i);
                    if (item == null) continue;
                    if (!url.equals(item.optString("url", ""))) {
                        updated.put(item);
                    }
                }

                if (favorite) updated.put(channel);

                prefs.edit().putString("favorites", updated.toString()).apply();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Favori kaydedilemedi", e);
            }
        }


        private void reportDominoProgress(
            String callbackId, String stage, int percent
        ) {
            final String id = callbackId == null
                ? "0" : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");
            final int value = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent));

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (webView == null) return;
                webView.evaluateJavascript(
                    "if(window.__isaDominoProgress)window.__isaDominoProgress(" +
                    JSONObject.quote(id) + "," +
                    JSONObject.quote(stage) + "," + value + ");",
                    null
                );
            });
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public void fetchDominoCatalog(String callbackId) {
            networkExecutor.execute(() -> {
                String result = null;
                String error = null;

                HttpURLConnection connection = null;

                try {
                    java.io.File cache = new java.io.File(
                        getCacheDir(), "domino-catalog.json"
                    );

                    android.content.SharedPreferences prefs =
                        getSharedPreferences("domino_catalog", MODE_PRIVATE);

                    String etag = prefs.getString("etag", "");
                    String modified = prefs.getString("modified", "");

                    URL url = new URL(
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dominoiptv/dominotv/main/liste.json"
                    );

                    connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
                    connection.setConnectTimeout(20000);
                    connection.setReadTimeout(180000);
                    connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
                    connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
                    connection.setRequestProperty("Accept-Encoding", "identity");
                    connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "ISA-TV-HD/1.0");

                    if (!etag.isEmpty())
                        connection.setRequestProperty("If-None-Match", etag);

                    if (!modified.isEmpty())
                        connection.setRequestProperty("If-Modified-Since", modified);

                    int status = connection.getResponseCode();

                    if (status == 304 && cache.isFile() && cache.length() > 0) {
                        reportDominoProgress(callbackId, "load", 0);
                        result = readUtf8File(cache);
                        reportDominoProgress(callbackId, "load", 100);
                    } else if (status >= 200 && status < 300) {
                        java.io.File encrypted = new java.io.File(
                            getCacheDir(), "domino-catalog.download"
                        );

                        long totalBytes = connection.getContentLengthLong();
                        long downloaded = 0;
                        int lastPercent = -1;
                        long lastReport = 0;

                        reportDominoProgress(callbackId, "download", 0);

                        try (
                            java.io.InputStream in = connection.getInputStream();
                            java.io.FileOutputStream out =
                                new java.io.FileOutputStream(encrypted)
                        ) {
                            byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
                            int n;

                            while ((n = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                                out.write(buffer, 0, n);
                                downloaded += n;

                                int percent = totalBytes > 0
                                    ? (int)Math.min(100, downloaded * 100L / totalBytes)
                                    : 0;

                                long now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();

                                if (percent != lastPercent &&
                                    (now - lastReport >= 150 || percent == 100)) {
                                    reportDominoProgress(
                                        callbackId, "download", percent
                                    );
                                    lastPercent = percent;
                                    lastReport = now;
                                }
                            }

                            out.getFD().sync();
                        }

                        reportDominoProgress(callbackId, "download", 100);
                        reportDominoProgress(callbackId, "load", 0);

                        decryptDominoFile(encrypted, cache, callbackId);
                        encrypted.delete();

                        String newEtag = connection.getHeaderField("ETag");
                        String newModified = connection.getHeaderField("Last-Modified");

                        android.content.SharedPreferences.Editor edit = prefs.edit();
                        if (newEtag != null) edit.putString("etag", newEtag);
                        if (newModified != null) edit.putString("modified", newModified);
                        edit.apply();

                        result = readUtf8File(cache);
                    } else {
                        throw new java.io.IOException("Domino HTTP " + status);
                    }

                } catch (Exception ex) {
                    error = ex.getMessage() == null
                        ? "Domino kataloğu alınamadı." : ex.getMessage();

                    Log.e(TAG, "Domino katalog hatası", ex);
                } finally {
                    if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
                }

                final String response = result;
                final String failure = error;
                final String id = callbackId == null
                    ? "0" : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (webView == null) return;

                    webView.evaluateJavascript(
                        "window.__isaDominoDone(" + id + "," +
                        JSONObject.quote(response) + "," +
                        JSONObject.quote(failure) + ");",
                        null
                    );
                });
            });
        }

        private String readUtf8File(java.io.File file) throws Exception {
            StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
            try (
                java.io.BufferedReader reader = new java.io.BufferedReader(
                    new java.io.InputStreamReader(
                        new java.io.FileInputStream(file),
                        StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                    ), 65536
                )
            ) {
                char[] buffer = new char[32768];
                int n;
                while ((n = reader.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                    result.append(buffer, 0, n);
                }
            }
            return result.toString();
        }

        private void decryptDominoFile(
            java.io.File source,
            java.io.File destination,
            String callbackId
        ) throws Exception {

            try (
                java.io.BufferedInputStream input =
                    new java.io.BufferedInputStream(
                        new java.io.FileInputStream(source), 65536
                    )
            ) {
                byte[] header = new byte[4];
                int count = 0;
                while (count < 4) {
                    int n = input.read(header, count, 4-count);
                    if (n < 0) throw new java.io.IOException("Dosya eksik.");
                    count += n;
                }

                boolean encrypted =
                    header[0] == 68 && header[1] == 84 &&
                    header[2] == 86 && header[3] == 49;

                java.io.InputStream plain = input;

                if (encrypted) {
                    byte[] iv = new byte[12];
                    int filled = 0;

                    while (filled < 12) {
                        int n = input.read(iv, filled, 12-filled);
                        if (n < 0)
                            throw new java.io.IOException("DTV1 IV eksik.");
                        filled += n;
                    }

                    byte[] digest = java.security.MessageDigest
                        .getInstance("SHA-256")
                        .digest(
                            "domino|tv-cat|alog-v1|-2026"
                            .getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                        );

                    javax.crypto.Cipher cipher =
                        javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding");

                    cipher.init(
                        javax.crypto.Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE,
                        new javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(digest, "AES"),
                        new javax.crypto.spec.GCMParameterSpec(128, iv)
                    );

                    final long cipherTotal = Math.max(1L, source.length() - 16L);

                    plain = new javax.crypto.CipherInputStream(
                        new java.io.FilterInputStream(input) {
                            private long consumed = 0;
                            private int lastPercent = -1;
                            private long lastReport = 0;

                            private void updateProgress(long amount) {
                                consumed += amount;

                                int percent = (int)Math.min(
                                    99L, consumed * 100L / cipherTotal
                                );

                                long now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();

                                if (percent != lastPercent &&
                                    (now - lastReport >= 150 || percent == 99)) {
                                    reportDominoProgress(
                                        callbackId, "load", percent
                                    );
                                    lastPercent = percent;
                                    lastReport = now;
                                }
                            }

                            @Override
                            public int read(byte[] b, int off, int len)
                                throws java.io.IOException {
                                int n = super.read(b, off, len);
                                if (n > 0) updateProgress(n);
                                return n;
                            }

                            @Override
                            public int read() throws java.io.IOException {
                                int value = super.read();
                                if (value != -1) updateProgress(1);
                                return value;
                            }
                        },
                        cipher
                    );
                } else {
                    java.io.PushbackInputStream push =
                        new java.io.PushbackInputStream(input, 4);
                    push.unread(header);
                    plain = push;
                }

                java.io.File temp = new java.io.File(
                    destination.getParentFile(),
                    destination.getName() + ".tmp"
                );

                try (
                    java.io.InputStream decoded = plain;
                    java.io.BufferedOutputStream output =
                        new java.io.BufferedOutputStream(
                            new java.io.FileOutputStream(temp), 65536
                        )
                ) {
                    byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
                    int n;

                    while ((n = decoded.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                        output.write(buffer, 0, n);
                    }

                    output.flush();
                }

                reportDominoProgress(callbackId, "load", 100);

                if (!temp.renameTo(destination)) {
                    try (
                        java.io.InputStream in = new java.io.FileInputStream(temp);
                        java.io.OutputStream out =
                            new java.io.FileOutputStream(destination)
                    ) {
                        byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
                        int n;
                        while ((n = in.read(buffer)) != -1)
                            out.write(buffer, 0, n);
                    }
                    temp.delete();
                }
            }
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
public void fetchText(String address, String callbackId) {
    networkExecutor.execute(() -> {
        String result = null;
        String error = null;

        for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= 3; attempt++) {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                URL url = new URL(address);

                if (!"http".equalsIgnoreCase(url.getProtocol())
                        && !"https".equalsIgnoreCase(url.getProtocol())) {
                    throw new Exception("HTTP/HTTPS adresi gerekli.");
                }

                connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
                connection.setConnectTimeout(20000);
                connection.setReadTimeout(120000);
                connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
                connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
                connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "*/*");
                connection.setRequestProperty("Accept-Encoding", "identity");
                connection.setRequestProperty(
                    "User-Agent",
                    "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 11) AppleWebKit/537.36 "
                    + "(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Mobile Safari/537.36"
                );

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    throw new java.io.IOException("HTTP " + code);
                }

                StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();

                try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(
                        new InputStreamReader(
                            connection.getInputStream(),
                            StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {

                    String line;
                    while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                        output.append(line).append('\n');

                    }
                }

                result = output.toString();
                error = null;
                break;

            } catch (Exception e) {
                error = e.getMessage();
                Log.w(TAG, "Kaynak indirme denemesi " + attempt + "/3", e);

                if (attempt < 3) {
                    try {
                        Thread.sleep(attempt * 1200L);
                    } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                        error = "İşlem iptal edildi.";
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        }

        final String response = result;
        final String failure = error;
        final String safeId = callbackId == null
                ? "0"
                : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");

        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (webView == null) return;

            String js = "window.__isaFetchDone("
                    + safeId + ","
                    + JSONObject.quote(response) + ","
                    + JSONObject.quote(failure) + ");";

            webView.evaluateJavascript(js, null);
        });
    });
}




        @JavascriptInterface
        public void fetchTextWithHeaders(String address, String headersJson, String callbackId) {
            networkExecutor.execute(() -> {
                String result = null;
                String error = null;
                HttpURLConnection connection = null;
                try {
                    URL url = new URL(address);
                    if (!"http".equalsIgnoreCase(url.getProtocol()) &&
                            !"https".equalsIgnoreCase(url.getProtocol())) {
                        throw new Exception("HTTP/HTTPS adresi gerekli.");
                    }
                    connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
                    connection.setConnectTimeout(20000);
                    connection.setReadTimeout(120000);
                    connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
                    connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
                    connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "*/*");
                    connection.setRequestProperty("Accept-Encoding", "identity");

                    JSONObject supplied = new JSONObject(headersJson == null ? "{}" : headersJson);
                    java.util.Iterator<String> keys = supplied.keys();
                    while (keys.hasNext()) {
                        String key = keys.next();
                        String value = supplied.optString(key, "");
                        if (key.matches("(?i)[a-z0-9-]+") &&
                                !key.matches("(?i)host|content-length|connection|transfer-encoding|accept-encoding") &&
                                !value.contains("\r") && !value.contains("\n")) {
                            connection.setRequestProperty(key, value);
                        }
                    }

                    int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                    if (code < 200 || code >= 300) throw new java.io.IOException("HTTP " + code);

                    StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();
                    try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(
                            new InputStreamReader(connection.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                        String line;
                        while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                            output.append(line).append('\n');
                            if (output.length() > 64 * 1024 * 1024) {
                                throw new Exception("Kaynak 64 MB sınırını aştı.");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    result = output.toString();
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    error = e.getMessage() == null ? "İstek başarısız." : e.getMessage();
                    Log.w(TAG, "Başlıklı kaynak isteği başarısız", e);
                } finally {
                    if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
                }

                final String response = result;
                final String failure = error;
                final String safeId = callbackId == null ? "0" : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (webView == null) return;
                    String callback = "window.__isaFetchDone(" + safeId + "," +
                            JSONObject.quote(response) + "," +
                            JSONObject.quote(failure) + ");";
                    webView.evaluateJavascript(callback, null);
                });
            });
        }

                @JavascriptInterface
        public void openPage(String address) {
            if (address == null || !(address.startsWith("https://") || address.startsWith("http://"))) return;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                try {
                    Intent browser = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(address));
                    MainActivity.this.startActivity(browser);
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "Kaynak sayfası açılamadı", e);
                }
            });
        }

@JavascriptInterface
        public void cachePut(String key, String value) {
            try {
                java.io.File directory = new java.io.File(
                        getFilesDir(),
                        "isa-source-cache"
                );

                if (!directory.exists()) {
                    directory.mkdirs();
                }

                String fileName = Integer.toHexString(
                        key == null ? 0 : key.hashCode()
                ) + ".cache";

                java.io.File file = new java.io.File(
                        directory,
                        fileName
                );

                try (java.io.FileOutputStream output =
                             new java.io.FileOutputStream(file, false)) {
                    output.write(
                            (value == null ? "" : value)
                                    .getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                    );
                    output.flush();
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                android.util.Log.e("ISATV", "Önbellek yazma hatası", e);
            }
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public void cacheGet(String key, String callbackId) {
            String result = null;
            String error = null;

            try {
                java.io.File directory = new java.io.File(
                        getFilesDir(),
                        "isa-source-cache"
                );

                java.io.File file = new java.io.File(
                        directory,
                        Integer.toHexString(
                                key == null ? 0 : key.hashCode()
                        ) + ".cache"
                );

                if (file.isFile()) {
                    StringBuilder content = new StringBuilder();

                    try (java.io.FileInputStream input =
                                 new java.io.FileInputStream(file)) {
                        byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                        int count;

                        while ((count = input.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                            content.append(
                                    new String(
                                            buffer,
                                            0,
                                            count,
                                            java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                                    )
                            );
                        }
                    }

                    result = content.toString();
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                error = e.getMessage();
            }

            final String finalResult = result;
            final String finalError = error;

            final String safeId = callbackId == null
                    ? "0"
                    : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (webView == null) return;

                String valueJson = finalResult == null
                        ? "null"
                        : org.json.JSONObject.quote(finalResult);

                String errorJson = finalError == null
                        ? "null"
                        : org.json.JSONObject.quote(finalError);

                webView.evaluateJavascript(
                        "window.__isaCacheDone(" +
                                safeId + "," +
                                valueJson + "," +
                                errorJson + ");",
                        null
                );
            });
        }

    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(
            int requestCode,
            int resultCode,
            Intent data) {

        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data);

        if (requestCode == FILE_REQUEST && fileCallback != null) {
            Uri[] result =
                    WebChromeClient.FileChooserParams.parseResult(
                            resultCode,
                            data
                    );

            fileCallback.onReceiveValue(result);
            fileCallback = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (webView != null) {
            webView.postDelayed(() -> {
                if (webView != null) {
                    webView.evaluateJavascript(
                        "if(window.homepage && typeof window.homepage.restoreLastPlayedChannel === 'function'){" +
                        "window.homepage.restoreLastPlayedChannel();}",
                        null
                    );
                }
            }, 250);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onBackPressed() {
        if (webView == null) {
            handleExitBack();
            return;
        }

        webView.evaluateJavascript(
                "(function(){return window.isaHandleBack ? window.isaHandleBack() : false;})()",
                value -> {
                    if ("true".equals(value)) {
                        backPressedAt = 0L;
                    } else {
                        handleExitBack();
                    }
                }
        );
    }

    private void handleExitBack() {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (now - backPressedAt < 2000L) {
            finish();
            return;
        }

        backPressedAt = now;
        Toast.makeText(
                this,
                "Çıkmak için geri tuşuna tekrar basın",
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
        ).show();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (fileCallback != null) {
            fileCallback.onReceiveValue(null);
            fileCallback = null;
        }

        networkExecutor.shutdownNow();

        if (webView != null) {
            webView.destroy();
            webView = null;
        }

        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

(function () {
'use strict';



const STORAGE_KEY = 'isa-tv-playlists-v3';

let channels = [];
let playlists = [];
let vodProviders = [];
let fetchCounter = 0;
let cacheCounter = 0;
let currentProvider = null;
let isaFavoritesOpen = false;
let isaFavoritesToggleBound = false;

window.__isaCacheCallbacks = {};
window.__isaFetchCallbacks = {};

window.__isaCacheDone = function(id,value,error) {
    const cb = window.__isaCacheCallbacks[id];
    if (!cb) return;
    delete window.__isaCacheCallbacks[id];
    if (error) cb.reject(new Error(error));
    else cb.resolve(value);
};

window.__isaFetchDone = function(id,value,error) {
    const cb = window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id];
    if (!cb) return;
    delete window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id];
    if (error) cb.reject(new Error(error));
    else cb.resolve(value);
};


let dominoRequestId = 0;
let dominoTimerStarted = false;
let dominoLastData = null;
let dominoLoading = false;
let dominoInFlight = null;

window.__isaDominoCallbacks = {};

window.__isaDominoProgress = function(id, stage, percent) {
    const root = document.getElementById('isa-flix-app');
    if (!root) return;

    const value = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(percent) || 0));
    const label = stage === 'download'
        ? 'İçerikler indiriliyor'
        : 'İçerikler yükleniyor';

    root.innerHTML =
        '<div class="isaf-progress-screen">' +
            '<div class="isaf-progress-title">' + label + '</div>' +
            '<div class="isaf-progress-track">' +
                '<div class="isaf-progress-fill" style="width:' +
                    value + '%"></div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="isaf-progress-percent">' + value + '%</div>' +
        '</div>';
};

window.__isaDominoDone = function(id, value, error) {
    const callback = window.__isaDominoCallbacks[id];
    if (!callback) return;

    delete window.__isaDominoCallbacks[id];

    if (error) {
        const root = document.getElementById('isa-flix-app');
        if (root) {
            root.innerHTML =
                '<div class="isaf-progress-error">İçerikler alınamadı: ' +
                esc(error) + '</div>';
        }
        callback.reject(new Error(error));
    } else {
        callback.resolve(value);
    }
};


function fetchDominoCatalog() {
    if (dominoInFlight) return dominoInFlight;

    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.fetchDominoCatalog) {
        return Promise.reject(
            new Error('Domino native bağlantısı kullanılamıyor.')
        );
    }

    dominoLoading = true;

    dominoInFlight = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const id = ++dominoRequestId;

        window.__isaDominoCallbacks[id] = {
            resolve: value => {
                try {
                    const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
                    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') {
                        throw new Error('Boş veya geçersiz katalog.');
                    }
                    dominoLastData = parsed;
                    resolve(parsed);
                } catch (e) {
                    reject(new Error('Domino JSON doğrulaması başarısız: ' + e.message));
                } finally {
                    dominoLoading = false;
                    dominoInFlight = null;
                }
            },
            reject: error => {
                dominoLoading = false;
                dominoInFlight = null;
                reject(error);
            }
        };

        try {
            window.ISATV.fetchDominoCatalog(String(id));
        } catch (e) {
            delete window.__isaDominoCallbacks[id];
            dominoLoading = false;
            dominoInFlight = null;
            reject(e);
        }
    });

    return dominoInFlight;
}

async function refreshDominoCatalog(silent=false) {
    try {
        const data = await fetchDominoCatalog();

        window.ISA_DOMINO_CATALOG = data;
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(
            'isa:domino-catalog-updated',
            {detail:data}
        ));

        if (!silent) {
            const status = document.getElementById('isa-live-status');
            if (status) status.textContent = 'Domino kataloğu güncellendi.';
        }

        return data;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Domino katalog güncellemesi:', error);

        if (!silent) {
            const status = document.getElementById('isa-live-status');
            if (status) status.textContent =
                'Domino güncellenemedi: ' + error.message;
        }

        return dominoLastData;
    }
}

function startDominoAutoUpdate() {
    if (dominoTimerStarted) return;
    dominoTimerStarted = true;

    refreshDominoCatalog(true);

    window.setInterval(() => {
        if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
            refreshDominoCatalog(true);
        }
    }, 60000);
}

function nativeCacheGet(key) {
    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.cacheGet) {
        try {
            return Promise.resolve(localStorage.getItem('isa-cache:'+key));
        } catch(e) {
            return Promise.resolve(null);
        }
    }

    return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
        const id = ++cacheCounter;
        window.__isaCacheCallbacks[id] = {resolve,reject};
        window.ISATV.cacheGet(key,String(id));
    });
}

function nativeCachePut(key,value) {
    if (window.ISATV && window.ISATV.cachePut) {
        window.ISATV.cachePut(key,value);
    } else {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem('isa-cache:'+key,value);
        } catch(e) {}
    }
}

function nativeFetch(url) {
    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.fetchText) {
        return fetch(url).then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
            return response.text();
        });
    }
    return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
        const id = ++fetchCounter;
        window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id] = {resolve,reject};
        window.ISATV.fetchText(url,String(id));
    });
}

function nativeFetchWithHeaders(url,headers={}) {
    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.fetchTextWithHeaders) {
        return fetch(url,{headers}).then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
            return response.text();
        });
    }
    return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
        const id = ++fetchCounter;
        window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id] = {resolve,reject};
        window.ISATV.fetchTextWithHeaders(url,JSON.stringify(headers || {}),String(id));
    });
}

function getTextWithHeaders(url,headers={}) {
    return nativeFetchWithHeaders(url,headers);
}

async function getText(url,forceRefresh=false) {
    let cached = null;

    try {
        cached = await nativeCacheGet(url);
    } catch(e) {}

    if (!forceRefresh && cached) return cached;

    try {
        const fresh = await nativeFetch(url);
        nativeCachePut(url,fresh);
        return fresh;
    } catch(e) {
        if (cached) return cached;
        throw e;
    }
}

function esc(value) {
    return String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c => ({
        '&':'&amp;',
        '<':'&lt;',
        '>':'&gt;',
        '"':'&quot;',
        "'":'&#39;'
    })[c]);
}

function loadSaved() {
    try {
        const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)||'[]');
        playlists = Array.isArray(saved) ? saved : [];
    } catch(e) {
        playlists = [];
    }
}

function saveLists() {
    try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(playlists));
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('Liste kaydedilemedi',e);
    }
}

function isHttp(url) {
    return /^https?:\/\//i.test(String(url||''));
}


function isDirectMedia(url) {
    if (!isHttp(url)) return false;
    try {
        const path = new URL(url).pathname.toLowerCase();
        return /\.(m3u8|mp4|mpd|mp3|m4a|aac|ts|mkv|webm|m4v|mov|ogg|flv|mpeg|mpg|3gp|avi)$/i.test(path);
    } catch(e) {
        return false;
    }
}



function cleanMediaTitle(value) {
    let name = String(value || '').trim();
    name = name.replace(/^(.*?)\s+-\s+\1(?=\s|$)/i, '$1').trim();
    // Dil/ülke etiketlerini yalnızca baştaki etiket olarak kaldır; TRT 1 gibi adlara dokunma.
    name = name.replace(/^(?:TR(?:\s*[:/.-]\s*|\s*🇹🇷\s*|\s+)|DE(?:\s*[:/.-]\s*|\s+|🇩🇪\s*))/iu, '');
    name = name.replace(/^(?:🇹🇷|🇩🇪)\s*/u, '');
    // Bölüm/sezon numaraları içerik başlığında tekrarlanmaz; oynatıcı alt bilgisinde gösterilir.
    name = name.replace(/\s*(?:[-–|·]\s*)?(?:S\s*\d{1,2}\s*E\s*\d{1,3}|Sezon\s*\d+\s*[-–:]?\s*\d+\s*\.?(?:bölüm|bolum)|\d+\s*\.?\s*(?:bölüm|bolum|episode))\s*$/i, '');
    return name.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').replace(/[\s|–-]+$/, '').trim();
}
function cleanGroupTitle(value) { return cleanMediaTitle(value); }
function cleanEpisodeTitle(value, fallbackNumber) {
    const name = cleanMediaTitle(value);
    const match = name.match(/(?:^|\s)(\d+)\s*\.?\s*(?:bölüm|bolum|episode)\s*$/i);
    return match ? (Number(match[1]) + '. Bölüm') : (fallbackNumber ? fallbackNumber + '. Bölüm' : name);
}



function parseM3U(text,prefix) {
    text = String(text || '').replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');

    const result = [];
    let current = null;
    let headers = {};
    let position = 0;
    let index = 0;

    while (position < text.length) {
        let end = text.indexOf('\n', position);
        if (end < 0) end = text.length;

        let line = text.slice(position, end).trim();
        position = end + 1;

        if (!line) continue;

        if (line.startsWith('#EXTINF:')) {
            const comma = line.lastIndexOf(',');
            const name = cleanMediaTitle(
                comma >= 0 ? line.slice(comma + 1) : 'İsimsiz yayın'
            );

            const group =
                (line.match(/group-title="([^"]*)"/i) || [])[1] || 'Genel';

            const logo =
                (line.match(/tvg-logo="([^"]*)"/i) || [])[1] || '';

            current = {
                name,
                group,
                logo,
                url:'',
                headers:{},
                id:prefix + '-' + index
            };

            headers = {};
        }
        else if (line.startsWith('#EXTVLCOPT:') && current) {
            const option = line.substring(11);
            const i = option.indexOf('=');

            if (i > 0) {
                const key = option.substring(0,i).toLowerCase();
                const value = option.substring(i+1);

                if (key === 'http-user-agent')
                    headers['User-Agent'] = value;

                if (key === 'http-referrer' || key === 'http-referer')
                    headers['Referer'] = value;

                if (key === 'http-origin')
                    headers['Origin'] = value;
            }
        }
        else if (line.startsWith('#EXTHTTP:') && current) {
            try {
                Object.assign(headers, JSON.parse(line.substring(9)));
            } catch(e) {}
        }
        else if (current && !line.startsWith('#') && isHttp(line)) {
            current.url = line;
            current.headers = {...headers};

            result.push(current);
            current = null;
            headers = {};
            index++;
        }
    }

    return result;
}

function play(channel,queue=channels,index=-1,isLive=true) {
    if (!channel || !isHttp(channel.url)) return;

    if (window.ISATV && window.ISATV.play) {
        window.ISATV.play(
            cleanMediaTitle(channel.name || 'İSA TV HD'),
            channel.url,
            JSON.stringify(channel.headers||{}),
            JSON.stringify((queue||[channel]).map(item => ({...item, is_live:item.is_live !== undefined ? item.is_live : !!isLive, name:cleanMediaTitle(item.name || 'İSA TV HD')}))),
            index < 0 ? Math.max(0,(queue||[]).indexOf(channel)) : index
        );
        return;
    }

    const query = new URLSearchParams({
        stream:channel.url,
        name:cleanMediaTitle(channel.name||'İSA TV HD'),
        group:channel.group||'',
        logo:channel.logo||''
    });

    location.href = './player.html?'+query.toString();
}

function openPage(url) {
    if (!isHttp(url)) return;

    if (window.ISATV && window.ISATV.openPage) {
        window.ISATV.openPage(url);
        return;
    }

    window.open(url,'_blank','noopener');
}

function renderChannels() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('all-channels');
    if (!grid) return;

    grid.innerHTML = '';

    if (!channels.length) {
        grid.innerHTML = '<p class="isa-loading">Henüz kanal bulunamadı.</p>';
        renderFavorites();
        return;
    }

    const PAGE_SIZE = 500;
    const groupCounts = new Map();

    for (let i = 0; i < channels.length; i++) {
        const group = cleanGroupTitle(channels[i].group || 'Genel');
        groupCounts.set(group, (groupCounts.get(group) || 0) + 1);
    }

    const groupNodes = new Map();

    function getGroupGrid(group) {
        if (groupNodes.has(group)) return groupNodes.get(group);

        const details = document.createElement('details');
        details.className = 'isa-channel-category';

        const summary = document.createElement('summary');
        summary.textContent = group + ' (' + groupCounts.get(group) + ')';

        const list = document.createElement('div');
        list.className = 'channels-grid';

        details.appendChild(summary);
        details.appendChild(list);
        grid.appendChild(details);

        groupNodes.set(group, list);
        return list;
    }

    let shown = 0;
    let moreButton = null;

    function appendNextPage() {
        if (moreButton) {
            moreButton.remove();
            moreButton = null;
        }

        const end = Math.min(shown + PAGE_SIZE, channels.length);

        for (let index = shown; index < end; index++) {
            const channel = channels[index];
            const group = cleanGroupTitle(channel.group || 'Genel');
            const list = getGroupGrid(group);

            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'channel-card';
            card.dataset.isaIndex = String(index);

            const thumbnail = document.createElement('div');
            thumbnail.className = 'channel-thumbnail';

            if (channel.logo) {
                const img = document.createElement('img');
                img.src = channel.logo;
                img.alt = '';
                img.onerror = function () {
                    this.style.display = 'none';
                };
                thumbnail.appendChild(img);
            } else {
                const placeholder = document.createElement('div');
                placeholder.className = 'channel-placeholder';
                placeholder.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-tv"></i>';
                thumbnail.appendChild(placeholder);
            }

            const name = document.createElement('div');
            name.className = 'channel-name';
            name.textContent = cleanMediaTitle(channel.name || 'İsimsiz kanal');

            card.appendChild(thumbnail);
            card.appendChild(name);

            card.addEventListener('click', function () {
                play(channels[index], channels, index);
            });

            list.appendChild(card);
        }

        shown = end;

        if (shown < channels.length) {
            moreButton = document.createElement('button');
            moreButton.type = 'button';
            moreButton.className = 'isa-load-more';
            moreButton.textContent =
                'Daha Fazla Kanal Yükle (' + shown + ' / ' +
                channels.length + ')';

            moreButton.style.display = 'block';
            moreButton.style.width = '100%';
            moreButton.style.padding = '14px';
            moreButton.style.margin = '16px 0';
            moreButton.style.cursor = 'pointer';

            moreButton.addEventListener('click', appendNextPage);
            grid.appendChild(moreButton);
        }
    }

    appendNextPage();
    renderFavorites();
}
function renderFavorites() {
    const section = document.getElementById('isa-favorites-section');
    const grid = document.getElementById('isa-favorites-grid');
    const toggle = document.getElementById('isa-favorites-toggle');
    if (!section || !grid || !toggle) return;
    let favorites = [];
    try {
        if (window.ISATV && window.ISATV.getFavorites) favorites = JSON.parse(window.ISATV.getFavorites() || '[]');
    } catch(e) { console.warn('Favoriler okunamadı:', e); }
    if (!Array.isArray(favorites)) favorites = [];
    if (!favorites.length) {
        isaFavoritesOpen = false;
        section.hidden = true;
        toggle.hidden = true;
        toggle.style.display = 'none';
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
        grid.innerHTML = '';
        return;
    }
    toggle.hidden = false;
    toggle.style.display = 'block';
    if (!isaFavoritesToggleBound) {
        toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
            isaFavoritesOpen = !isaFavoritesOpen;
            section.hidden = !isaFavoritesOpen;
            toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isaFavoritesOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
            toggle.innerHTML = isaFavoritesOpen ? '♥ Favoriler ▴' : '♥ Favoriler ▾';
        });
        isaFavoritesToggleBound = true;
    }
    section.hidden = !isaFavoritesOpen;
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isaFavoritesOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
    toggle.innerHTML = isaFavoritesOpen ? '♥ Favoriler ▴' : '♥ Favoriler ▾';
    grid.innerHTML = favorites.map((item,index) => `
        <div class="channel-card isa-favorite-card" data-favorite-index="${index}">
            <div class="channel-thumbnail">${item.logo ? `<img src="${esc(item.logo)}" alt="" loading="lazy" onerror="this.style.display='none'">` : '<div class="channel-placeholder"><i class="fas fa-tv"></i></div>'}</div>
            <div class="channel-name">${esc(cleanMediaTitle(item.name || 'İsimsiz içerik'))}</div>
        </div>`).join('');
    grid.querySelectorAll('[data-favorite-index]').forEach(card => card.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const item = favorites[Number(card.dataset.favoriteIndex)];
        if (!item || !item.url) return;
        const index = channels.findIndex(c => c.url === item.url);
        if (index >= 0) play(channels[index],channels,index,true);
        else play(item,favorites,Number(card.dataset.favoriteIndex),item.is_live !== false);
    }));
}

function renderSavedLists() {
    const compact = document.getElementById('isa-saved-lists');
    const full = document.getElementById('isa-all-saved-lists');
    const makeRows = () => playlists.map((item,index) => {
        const type = item.type === 'xtream' ? 'Xtream Codes' : item.type === 'mag' ? 'MAG' : 'M3U';
        const detail = item.type === 'xtream' ? item.host + ' • ' + item.username : item.type === 'mag' ? item.host + ' • ' + item.mac : (item.url || 'Cihazdan yüklenen dosya');
        return `<div class="isa-list-row"><span class="isa-list-info"><strong>${esc(item.name || ('Liste '+(index+1)))}</strong><small>${esc(type)} · ${Number(item.lastCount || 0)} içerik</small><small>${esc(detail)}</small></span><span class="isa-list-actions"><button data-refresh-list="${index}" title="Yenile"><i class="fas fa-rotate"></i></button><button class="delete" data-delete-list="${index}" title="Sil"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button></span></div>`;
    }).join('');
    if (compact) {
        if (!playlists.length) compact.innerHTML = '<p class="isa-vod-note">Henüz kaynak eklenmedi.</p>';
        else {
            const active = playlists[playlists.length-1];
            const n = playlists.length;
            compact.innerHTML = `<details class="isa-active-list"><summary><span><b>AKTİF LİSTE</b><strong>${esc(active.name || ('Liste '+n))}</strong><small>${Number(active.lastCount || 0)} içerik · ${active.type==='xtream'?'Xtream':active.type==='mag'?'MAG':'M3U'}</small></span><i class="fas fa-chevron-down"></i></summary><div class="isa-account-menu">${makeRows()}</div></details>`;
        }
    }
    if (full) full.innerHTML = makeRows() || '<p class="isa-vod-note">Henüz kaynak eklenmedi.</p>';
    [compact,full].filter(Boolean).forEach(box => {
        box.querySelectorAll('[data-refresh-list]').forEach(button => button.onclick = async e => {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); sourceLoading(true,'Kaynak yenileniyor...');
            try { await refreshAll(true); } finally { sourceLoading(false); }
        });
        box.querySelectorAll('[data-delete-list]').forEach(button => button.onclick = async e => {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); const index=Number(button.dataset.deleteList); if(!playlists[index]) return;
            if(!confirm((playlists[index].name||'Liste')+' silinsin mi?')) return;
            playlists.splice(index,1); saveLists();
            sourceLoading(true,'Kaynaklar güncelleniyor...'); try { await refreshAll(false); } finally { sourceLoading(false); }
        });
    });
}

async function loadUserLists(forceRefresh=false) {
    const result = [];

    for (let index=0; index<playlists.length; index++) {
        const item = playlists[index];

        try {
            if (item.type === 'xtream') {
                const live = await xtreamAPI(item, 'get_live_streams');

                const categories = await xtreamAPI(
                    item, 'get_live_categories'
                ).catch(() => []);

                const categoryMap = new Map(
                    (Array.isArray(categories) ? categories : []).map(c =>
                        [String(c.category_id), c.category_name || 'Genel']
                    )
                );

                for (const stream of (Array.isArray(live) ? live : [])) {
                    const ext = stream.container_extension || 'ts';
                    const url = item.host.replace(/\/+$/, '') +
                        '/live/' +
                        encodeURIComponent(item.username) + '/' +
                        encodeURIComponent(item.password) + '/' +
                        stream.stream_id + '.' + ext;

                    result.push({
                        name:stream.name || 'İsimsiz kanal',
                        url,
                        logo:stream.stream_icon || '',
                        group:categoryMap.get(
                            String(stream.category_id)
                        ) || 'Genel',
                        headers:{},
                        id:'xtream-live-' + index + '-' + stream.stream_id
                    });
                }

                item.lastCount = live.length;
                item.error = '';
                continue;
            }

            if (item.type === 'mag') {
                const magChannels = await loadMagChannels(item);

                for (const channel of magChannels) {
                    result.push(channel);
                }

                item.lastCount = magChannels.length;
                item.error = '';
                continue;
            }

            if (item.type === 'url' || item.type === 'm3u-url') {
                item.text = await getText(item.url, forceRefresh);
            }

            if (!item.text ||
                (!item.text.includes('#EXTM3U') &&
                 !item.text.includes('#EXTINF:'))) {
                throw new Error('Geçerli M3U içeriği bulunamadı.');
            }

            const parsed = parseM3U(
                item.text,
                'user-' + index
            );

            item.lastCount = parsed.length;
            item.error = '';

            // Dosya adı artık grup adına eklenmez.
            for (const channel of parsed) {
                channel.group = channel.group || 'Genel';
                result.push(channel);
            }

        } catch(error) {
            item.error = error.message || 'Kaynak yüklenemedi.';
            console.warn(item.name, error);
        }
    }

    saveLists();
    return result;
}



function xtreamAPI(source, action, extra={}) {
    const host = String(source.host || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');

    const params = new URLSearchParams({
        username:source.username,
        password:source.password,
        action,
        ...extra
    });

    return getText(
        host + '/player_api.php?' + params.toString(),
        true
    ).then(text => {
        const data = JSON.parse(text);

        if (data && data.user_info &&
            data.user_info.auth === 0) {
            throw new Error('Xtream kullanıcı bilgileri geçersiz.');
        }

        if (data && data.user_info &&
            data.user_info.status === 'Disabled') {
            throw new Error('Xtream hesabı devre dışı.');
        }

        return data;
    });
}

function sourceHost(value) {
    let host = String(value || '').trim();

    if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(host)) {
        host = 'http://' + host;
    }

    const parsed = new URL(host);

    if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(parsed.protocol)) {
        throw new Error('Geçerli HTTP/HTTPS host girin.');
    }

    return {
        host:parsed.origin + parsed.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, ''),
        hasPort:!!parsed.port
    };
}

function sourceLoading(show, message) {
    const box = document.getElementById('isa-source-loading');
    const text = document.getElementById('isa-loading-text');
    if (box) box.classList.toggle('active', !!show);
    if (text && message) text.textContent = message;
}

function nextSourceName(type) {
    const prefix = type === 'xtream' ? 'Xtream' :
                   type === 'mag' ? 'MAG' : 'M3U';

    let n = 1;
    while (playlists.some(p => p.name === prefix + ' ' + n)) n++;
    return prefix + ' ' + n;
}

async function loadMagChannels(source) {
    const host = String(source.host || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const mac = String(source.mac || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!host || !/^([0-9A-F]{2}:){5}[0-9A-F]{2}$/.test(mac)) {
        throw new Error('MAG host veya MAC adresi geçersiz.');
    }

    const portal = host + '/portal.php';
    const baseHeaders = {
        'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (QtEmbedded; U; Linux; C) AppleWebKit/533.3',
        'X-User-Agent':'Model: MAG250; Link: WiFi',
        'Referer':host + '/c/',
        'Origin':new URL(host).origin,
        'Cookie':'mac=' + mac + '; stb_lang=en; timezone=Europe/Istanbul',
        'Accept':'*/*'
    };

    async function portalRequest(params, token='') {
        const query = new URLSearchParams({
            ...params,
            JsHttpRequest:'1-xml',
            mac:mac
        });
        const headers = {...baseHeaders};
        if (token) headers.Authorization = 'Bearer ' + token;
        const raw = await getTextWithHeaders(portal + '?' + query.toString(),headers);
        let response;
        try { response = JSON.parse(raw); }
        catch (e) { throw new Error('MAG portalı geçerli JSON döndürmedi.'); }
        if (response && response.js && response.js.error) {
            throw new Error(String(response.js.error));
        }
        return response;
    }

    const handshake = await portalRequest({type:'stb',action:'handshake',token:''});
    const token = handshake && handshake.js && handshake.js.token
        ? String(handshake.js.token) : '';
    if (!token) {
        throw new Error('MAG handshake token alınamadı. MAC ve portal erişimini kontrol edin.');
    }

    try {
        await portalRequest({type:'stb',action:'get_profile'},token);
    } catch (e) {}

    let genres = [];
    try {
        const genreResponse = await portalRequest({type:'itv',action:'get_genres'},token);
        const genreData = genreResponse && genreResponse.js
            ? (genreResponse.js.data || genreResponse.js) : [];
        genres = Array.isArray(genreData) ? genreData : [];
    } catch (e) {}

    const genreMap = new Map();
    for (const genre of genres) {
        const id = genre.id ?? genre.genre_id ?? genre.tv_genre_id;
        const name = genre.title || genre.name || genre.genre_name;
        if (id != null && name) genreMap.set(String(id),String(name));
    }

    const channelResponse = await portalRequest({
        type:'itv',action:'get_all_channels',force_ch_link_check:''
    },token);

    let rows = channelResponse && channelResponse.js
        ? channelResponse.js.data : [];
    if (rows && !Array.isArray(rows) && Array.isArray(rows.data)) rows = rows.data;
    if (!Array.isArray(rows) || !rows.length) {
        throw new Error('MAG portalı kanal listesi döndürmedi.');
    }

    function cleanCommand(value) {
        return String(value || '').trim().replace(/^(ffmpeg|auto)\s+/i,'').trim();
    }

    async function resolveMagLink(row) {
        const cmd = String(row.cmd || row.url || '').trim();
        const direct = cleanCommand(cmd);
        if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(direct)) return direct;
        if (!cmd) return '';

        const linkResponse = await portalRequest({
            type:'itv',
            action:'create_link',
            cmd:cmd,
            series:'0',
            forced_storage:'',
            disable_ad:'0'
        },token);

        const data = linkResponse && linkResponse.js ? linkResponse.js : {};
        const value = cleanCommand(
            data.cmd || data.url ||
            (data.data && (data.data.cmd || data.data.url)) || ''
        );
        return /^https?:\/\//i.test(value) ? value : '';
    }

    const result = [];
    // Portalı aşırı yüklememek için dörder kanal halinde çözümlenir.
    for (let offset = 0; offset < rows.length; offset += 4) {
        const batch = rows.slice(offset,offset + 4);
        const resolved = await Promise.all(batch.map(async (row,localIndex) => {
            try {
                const url = await resolveMagLink(row);
                if (!url) return null;
                const genreId = row.tv_genre_id ?? row.genre_id ?? row.category_id ?? '';
                return {
                    name:row.name || row.title || 'MAG Kanal ' + (offset + localIndex + 1),
                    url:url,
                    logo:row.logo || row.icon || '',
                    group:row.tv_genre_name || genreMap.get(String(genreId)) || 'MAG',
                    headers:{...baseHeaders,Authorization:'Bearer ' + token},
                    id:'mag-' + mac.replace(/:/g,'') + '-' + (offset + localIndex)
                };
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }));
        for (const item of resolved) {
            if (item) result.push(item);
        }
    }

    if (!result.length) {
        throw new Error('MAG portalından oynatılabilir yayın alınamadı. Portal create_link desteği vermiyor olabilir.');
    }
    return result;
}

async function detectXtreamM3U(url) {
    try {
        const parsed = new URL(url);
        const username = parsed.searchParams.get('username');
        const password = [REDACTED]('password');

        if (!username || !password) return null;

        const source = {
            host:parsed.origin,
            username,
            password
        };

        const data = await xtreamAPI(
            source,
            'get_live_categories'
        );

        if (!Array.isArray(data)) return null;

        return source;
    } catch(error) {
        return null;
    }
}

async function addM3UUrl(url) {
    const xtream = await detectXtreamM3U(url);

    if (xtream) {
        const choice = confirm(
            'Bu adres Xtream Codes desteği sunuyor.\\n\\n' +
            'Tam Xtream sistemiyle film ve dizileri de yüklemek için ' +
            'Tamam seçin.\\n\\n' +
            'Yalnızca düz M3U kanalları için İptal seçin.'
        );

        if (choice) {
            playlists.push({
                ...xtream,
                type:'xtream',
                name:nextSourceName('xtream')
            });
        } else {
            playlists.push({
                type:'url',
                name:nextSourceName('m3u'),
                url,
                text:''
            });
        }
    } else {
        playlists.push({
            type:'url',
            name:nextSourceName('m3u'),
            url,
            text:''
        });
    }

    saveLists();
    await refreshAll(false);
}

    vodProviders = [];

    }
}


/*
 * JSON nesnelerini düzleştirmeden korur.
 * Dizi nesnesinin episodes/seasons yapısı kaybolmaz.
 */

function normalizeVOD(data,result=[]) {
    if (Array.isArray(data)) {
        data.forEach(item => normalizeVOD(item,result));
        return result;
    }

    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return result;

    const title = data.title || data.name || data.baslik ||
                  data.titleName || data.filename || data.original_title;

    const url = data.url || data.link || data.file ||
                data.stream || data.playUrl || data.video ||
                data.videoUrl || data.video_url || data.embedUrl || '';

    const episodes = Array.isArray(data.episodes) ? data.episodes : [];
    const seasons = Array.isArray(data.seasons) ? data.seasons : [];
    const items = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : [];

    if (title && (url || episodes.length || seasons.length || items.length ||
                  String(data.type || '').toLowerCase().includes('dizi') ||
                  String(data.type || '').toLowerCase().includes('series'))) {
        result.push({
            type:String(data.type || '').toLowerCase(),
            name:String(title),
            title:String(title),
            url:url,
            videoUrl:data.videoUrl || data.video_url || '',
            logo:data.poster || data.image || data.cover ||
                 data.thumbnail || data.thumb || '',
            poster:data.poster || data.image || data.cover ||
                   data.thumbnail || '',
            description:data.description || '',
            category:data.category || '',
            genres:Array.isArray(data.genres) ? data.genres : [],
            year:data.year || '',
            platform:data.platform || '',
            episodes:episodes,
            seasons:seasons,
            items:items,
            raw:data
        });
        return result;
    }

    Object.values(data).forEach(value => {
        if (value && typeof value === 'object') normalizeVOD(value,result);
    });

    return result;
}




function itemIsSeries(item) {
    return (Array.isArray(item.episodes) && item.episodes.length > 0) ||
           (Array.isArray(item.seasons) && item.seasons.length > 0) ||
           String(item.type || '').includes('dizi') ||
           String(item.type || '').includes('series');
}
