                    .getString("favorites", "[]");
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public void setFavorite(String channelJson, boolean favorite) {
            try {
                JSONObject channel = new JSONObject(channelJson);
                String url = channel.optString("url", "");
                if (url.isEmpty()) return;

                android.content.SharedPreferences prefs =
                        getSharedPreferences("isa_tv_data", MODE_PRIVATE);

                JSONArray old = new JSONArray(prefs.getString("favorites", "[]"));
                JSONArray updated = new JSONArray();

                for (int i = 0; i < old.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject item = old.optJSONObject(i);
                    if (item == null) continue;
                    if (!url.equals(item.optString("url", ""))) {
                        updated.put(item);
                    }
                }

                if (favorite) updated.put(channel);

                prefs.edit().putString("favorites", updated.toString()).apply();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Favori kaydedilemedi", e);
            }
        }


        private void reportCatalogProgress(
            String callbackId, String stage, int percent
        ) {
            final String id = callbackId == null
                ? "0" : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");
            final int value = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent));

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (webView == null) return;
                webView.evaluateJavascript(
                    "if(window.__isaCatalogProgress)window.__isaCatalogProgress(" +
                    JSONObject.quote(id) + "," +
                    JSONObject.quote(stage) + "," + value + ");",
                    null
                );
            });
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public String readCatalogChunk(String offsetText, int requestedBytes) {
            try {
                long offset = Long.parseLong(offsetText);

                java.io.File file = new java.io.File(
                    getCacheDir(), "isaflix-web-katalog.json"
                );

                if (!file.isFile() || offset < 0 ||
                    offset >= file.length()) {
                    return "";
                }

                int size = Math.max(1024,
                    Math.min(65536, requestedBytes));

                int count = (int)Math.min(
                    (long) size, file.length() - offset
                );

                byte[] buffer = new byte[count];

                try (java.io.RandomAccessFile input =
                         new java.io.RandomAccessFile(file, "r")) {
                    input.seek(offset);
                    input.readFully(buffer);
                }

                return android.util.Base64.encodeToString(
                    buffer,
                    android.util.Base64.NO_WRAP
                );

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Catalog parça okuma hatası", e);
                return "";
            }
        }


        @JavascriptInterface
        public void loadCachedCatalogCatalog(String callbackId) {
            final String id = callbackId == null
                ? "0" : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");

            java.io.File cache = new java.io.File(
                getCacheDir(), "isaflix-web-katalog.json"
            );

            final boolean exists =
                cache.isFile() && cache.length() > 0;

            final long size = exists ? cache.length() : 0L;

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (webView == null) return;

                if (exists) {
                    webView.evaluateJavascript(
                        "window.__isaCatalogReady(" +
                        JSONObject.quote(id) + "," +
                        size + ",null,false);",
                        null
                    );
                } else {
                    webView.evaluateJavascript(
                        "window.__isaCatalogDone(" +
                        JSONObject.quote(id) +
                        ",null,'CACHE_EMPTY');",
                        null
                    );
                }
            });
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public void fetchCatalogCatalog(String callbackId) {
            networkExecutor.execute(() -> {
                String error = null;
                boolean notModified = false;

                HttpURLConnection connection = null;

                try {
                    java.io.File cache = new java.io.File(
                        getCacheDir(), "isaflix-web-katalog.json"
                    );

                    android.content.SharedPreferences prefs =
                        getSharedPreferences("isaflix_web_catalog", MODE_PRIVATE);

                    String etag = prefs.getString("etag", "");
                    String modified = prefs.getString("modified", "");

                    URL url = new URL(
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thechampisher/ISA-TV-HD/main/INCELEME/isaflix-web-katalog.json"
                    );

                    connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
                    connection.setConnectTimeout(20000);
                    connection.setReadTimeout(180000);
                    connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
                    connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
                    connection.setRequestProperty("Accept-Encoding", "identity");
                    connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "ISA-TV-HD/1.0");

                    if (!etag.isEmpty())
                        connection.setRequestProperty("If-None-Match", etag);

                    if (!modified.isEmpty())
                        connection.setRequestProperty("If-Modified-Since", modified);

                    int status = connection.getResponseCode();

                    if (status == 304 && cache.isFile() && cache.length() > 0) {
                        notModified = true;
                    } else if (status >= 200 && status < 300) {
                        java.io.File encrypted = new java.io.File(
                            getCacheDir(), "catalog-catalog.download"
                        );

                        long totalBytes = connection.getContentLengthLong();
                        long downloaded = 0;
                        int lastPercent = -1;
                        long lastReport = 0;

                        reportCatalogProgress(callbackId, "download", 0);

                        try (
                            java.io.InputStream in = connection.getInputStream();
                            java.io.FileOutputStream out =
                                new java.io.FileOutputStream(encrypted)
                        ) {
                            byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
                            int n;

                            while ((n = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                                out.write(buffer, 0, n);
                                downloaded += n;

                                int percent = totalBytes > 0
    ? (int)Math.min(70, downloaded * 70L / totalBytes)
    : 0;

                                long now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();

                                if (percent != lastPercent &&
                                    (now - lastReport >= 150 || percent == 100)) {
                                    reportCatalogProgress(
                                        callbackId, "download", percent
                                    );
                                    lastPercent = percent;
                                    lastReport = now;
                                }
                            }

                            out.getFD().sync();
                        }

                        reportCatalogProgress(callbackId, "load", 70);

                        decryptCatalogFile(encrypted, cache, callbackId);
                        encrypted.delete();

                        String newEtag = connection.getHeaderField("ETag");
                        String newModified = connection.getHeaderField("Last-Modified");

                        android.content.SharedPreferences.Editor edit = prefs.edit();
                        if (newEtag != null) edit.putString("etag", newEtag);
                        if (newModified != null) edit.putString("modified", newModified);
                        edit.apply();

                    } else {
                        throw new java.io.IOException("Catalog HTTP " + status);
                    }

                } catch (Exception ex) {
                    error = ex.getMessage() == null
                        ? "Catalog kataloğu alınamadı." : ex.getMessage();

                    Log.e(TAG, "Catalog katalog hatası", ex);
                } finally {
                    if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
                }

                final String failure = error;
                final boolean finalNotModified = notModified;
                final String id = callbackId == null
                    ? "0" : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");

                final java.io.File catalogFile = new java.io.File(
                    getCacheDir(), "isaflix-web-katalog.json"
                );

                final long catalogSize =
                    failure == null && catalogFile.isFile()
                    ? catalogFile.length() : 0L;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (webView == null) return;

                    webView.evaluateJavascript(
                        "window.__isaCatalogReady(" + id + "," +
                        catalogSize + "," +
                        JSONObject.quote(failure) + "," +
                        (finalNotModified ? "true" : "false") + ");",
                        null
                    );
                });
            });
        }

        private String readUtf8File(java.io.File file) throws Exception {
            StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
            try (
                java.io.BufferedReader reader = new java.io.BufferedReader(
                    new java.io.InputStreamReader(
                        new java.io.FileInputStream(file),
                        StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                    ), 65536
                )
            ) {
                char[] buffer = new char[32768];
                int n;
                while ((n = reader.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                    result.append(buffer, 0, n);
                }
            }
            return result.toString();
        }

        private void decryptCatalogFile(
            java.io.File source,
            java.io.File destination,
            String callbackId
        ) throws Exception {

            try (
                java.io.BufferedInputStream input =
                    new java.io.BufferedInputStream(
                        new java.io.FileInputStream(source), 65536
                    )
            ) {
                byte[] header = new byte[4];
                int count = 0;
                while (count < 4) {
                    int n = input.read(header, count, 4-count);
                    if (n < 0) throw new java.io.IOException("Dosya eksik.");
                    count += n;
                }

                boolean encrypted =
                    header[0] == 68 && header[1] == 84 &&
                    header[2] == 86 && header[3] == 49;

                java.io.InputStream plain = input;

                if (encrypted) {
                    byte[] iv = new byte[12];
                    int filled = 0;

                    while (filled < 12) {
                        int n = input.read(iv, filled, 12-filled);
                        if (n < 0)
                            throw new java.io.IOException("DTV1 IV eksik.");
                        filled += n;
                    }

                    byte[] digest = java.security.MessageDigest
                        .getInstance("SHA-256")
                        .digest(
                            (new String(new char[]{100,111,109,105,110,111}) + "|tv-cat|alog-v1|-2026")
                            .getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                        );

                    javax.crypto.Cipher cipher =
                        javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding");

                    cipher.init(
                        javax.crypto.Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE,
                        new javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(digest, "AES"),
                        new javax.crypto.spec.GCMParameterSpec(128, iv)
                    );

                    final long cipherTotal = Math.max(1L, source.length() - 16L);

                    plain = new javax.crypto.CipherInputStream(
                        new java.io.FilterInputStream(input) {
                            private long consumed = 0;
                            private int lastPercent = -1;
                            private long lastReport = 0;

                            private void updateProgress(long amount) {
                                consumed += amount;

                                int percent = (int)Math.min(
                                    90L, 70L + consumed * 20L / cipherTotal
                                );

                                long now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();

                                if (percent != lastPercent &&
                                    (now - lastReport >= 150 || percent == 99)) {
                                    reportCatalogProgress(
                                        callbackId, "load", percent
                                    );
                                    lastPercent = percent;
                                    lastReport = now;
                                }
                            }

                            @Override
                            public int read(byte[] b, int off, int len)
                                throws java.io.IOException {
                                int n = super.read(b, off, len);
                                if (n > 0) updateProgress(n);
                                return n;
                            }

                            @Override
                            public int read() throws java.io.IOException {
                                int value = super.read();
                                if (value != -1) updateProgress(1);
                                return value;
                            }
                        },
                        cipher
                    );
                } else {
                    java.io.PushbackInputStream push =
                        new java.io.PushbackInputStream(input, 4);
                    push.unread(header);
                    plain = push;
                }

                java.io.File temp = new java.io.File(
                    destination.getParentFile(),
                    destination.getName() + ".tmp"
                );

                try (
                    java.io.InputStream decoded = plain;
                    java.io.BufferedOutputStream output =
                        new java.io.BufferedOutputStream(
                            new java.io.FileOutputStream(temp), 65536
                        )
                ) {
                    byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
                    int n;

                    while ((n = decoded.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                        output.write(buffer, 0, n);
                    }

                    output.flush();
                }

                reportCatalogProgress(callbackId, "load", 90);

                if (!temp.renameTo(destination)) {
                    try (
                        java.io.InputStream in = new java.io.FileInputStream(temp);
                        java.io.OutputStream out =
                            new java.io.FileOutputStream(destination)
                    ) {
                        byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
                        int n;
                        while ((n = in.read(buffer)) != -1)
                            out.write(buffer, 0, n);
                    }
                    temp.delete();
                }
            }
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
public void fetchText(String address, String callbackId) {
    networkExecutor.execute(() -> {
        String result = null;
        String error = null;

        for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= 3; attempt++) {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                URL url = new URL(address);

                if (!"http".equalsIgnoreCase(url.getProtocol())
                        && !"https".equalsIgnoreCase(url.getProtocol())) {
                    throw new Exception("HTTP/HTTPS adresi gerekli.");
                }

                connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
                connection.setConnectTimeout(20000);
                connection.setReadTimeout(120000);
                connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
                connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
                connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "*/*");
                connection.setRequestProperty("Accept-Encoding", "identity");
                connection.setRequestProperty(
                    "User-Agent",
                    "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 11) AppleWebKit/537.36 "
                    + "(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Mobile Safari/537.36"
                );

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    throw new java.io.IOException("HTTP " + code);
                }

                StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();

                try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(
                        new InputStreamReader(
                            connection.getInputStream(),
                            StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {

                    String line;
                    while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                        output.append(line).append('\n');

                    }
                }

                result = output.toString();
                error = null;
                break;

            } catch (Exception e) {
                error = e.getMessage();
                Log.w(TAG, "Kaynak indirme denemesi " + attempt + "/3", e);

                if (attempt < 3) {
                    try {
                        Thread.sleep(attempt * 1200L);
                    } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                        error = "İşlem iptal edildi.";
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        }

        final String response = result;
        final String failure = error;
        final String safeId = callbackId == null
                ? "0"
                : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");

        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (webView == null) return;

            String js = "window.__isaFetchDone("
                    + safeId + ","
                    + JSONObject.quote(response) + ","
                    + JSONObject.quote(failure) + ");";

            webView.evaluateJavascript(js, null);
        });
    });
}




        @JavascriptInterface
        public void fetchTextWithHeaders(String address, String headersJson, String callbackId) {
            networkExecutor.execute(() -> {
                String result = null;
                String error = null;
                HttpURLConnection connection = null;
                try {
                    URL url = new URL(address);
                    if (!"http".equalsIgnoreCase(url.getProtocol()) &&
                            !"https".equalsIgnoreCase(url.getProtocol())) {
                        throw new Exception("HTTP/HTTPS adresi gerekli.");
                    }
                    connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
                    connection.setConnectTimeout(20000);
                    connection.setReadTimeout(120000);
                    connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
                    connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
                    connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "*/*");
                    connection.setRequestProperty("Accept-Encoding", "identity");

                    JSONObject supplied = new JSONObject(headersJson == null ? "{}" : headersJson);
                    java.util.Iterator<String> keys = supplied.keys();
                    while (keys.hasNext()) {
                        String key = keys.next();
                        String value = supplied.optString(key, "");
                        if (key.matches("(?i)[a-z0-9-]+") &&
                                !key.matches("(?i)host|content-length|connection|transfer-encoding|accept-encoding") &&
                                !value.contains("\r") && !value.contains("\n")) {
                            connection.setRequestProperty(key, value);
                        }
                    }

                    int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                    if (code < 200 || code >= 300) throw new java.io.IOException("HTTP " + code);

                    StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();
                    try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(
                            new InputStreamReader(connection.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                        String line;
                        while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                            output.append(line).append('\n');
                            if (output.length() > 64 * 1024 * 1024) {
                                throw new Exception("Kaynak 64 MB sınırını aştı.");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    result = output.toString();
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    error = e.getMessage() == null ? "İstek başarısız." : e.getMessage();
                    Log.w(TAG, "Başlıklı kaynak isteği başarısız", e);
                } finally {
                    if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
                }

                final String response = result;
                final String failure = error;
                final String safeId = callbackId == null ? "0" : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (webView == null) return;
                    String callback = "window.__isaFetchDone(" + safeId + "," +
                            JSONObject.quote(response) + "," +
                            JSONObject.quote(failure) + ");";
                    webView.evaluateJavascript(callback, null);
                });
            });
        }

                @JavascriptInterface
        public void openPage(String address) {
            if (address == null || !(address.startsWith("https://") || address.startsWith("http://"))) return;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                try {
                    Intent browser = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(address));
                    MainActivity.this.startActivity(browser);
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "Kaynak sayfası açılamadı", e);
                }
            });
        }

@JavascriptInterface
        public void cachePut(String key, String value) {
            try {
                java.io.File directory = new java.io.File(
                        getFilesDir(),
                        "isa-source-cache"
                );

                if (!directory.exists()) {
                    directory.mkdirs();
                }

                String fileName = Integer.toHexString(
                        key == null ? 0 : key.hashCode()
                ) + ".cache";

                java.io.File file = new java.io.File(
                        directory,
                        fileName
                );

                try (java.io.FileOutputStream output =
                             new java.io.FileOutputStream(file, false)) {
                    output.write(
                            (value == null ? "" : value)
                                    .getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                    );
                    output.flush();
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                android.util.Log.e("ISATV", "Önbellek yazma hatası", e);
            }
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public void cacheGet(String key, String callbackId) {
            String result = null;
            String error = null;

            try {
                java.io.File directory = new java.io.File(
                        getFilesDir(),
                        "isa-source-cache"
                );

                java.io.File file = new java.io.File(
                        directory,
                        Integer.toHexString(
                                key == null ? 0 : key.hashCode()
                        ) + ".cache"
                );

                if (file.isFile()) {
                    StringBuilder content = new StringBuilder();

                    try (java.io.FileInputStream input =
                                 new java.io.FileInputStream(file)) {
                        byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                        int count;

                        while ((count = input.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                            content.append(
                                    new String(
                                            buffer,
                                            0,
                                            count,
                                            java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                                    )
                            );
                        }
                    }

                    result = content.toString();
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                error = e.getMessage();
            }

            final String finalResult = result;
            final String finalError = error;

            final String safeId = callbackId == null
                    ? "0"
                    : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (webView == null) return;

                String valueJson = finalResult == null
                        ? "null"
                        : org.json.JSONObject.quote(finalResult);

                String errorJson = finalError == null
                        ? "null"
                        : org.json.JSONObject.quote(finalError);

                webView.evaluateJavascript(
                        "window.__isaCacheDone(" +
                                safeId + "," +
                                valueJson + "," +
                                errorJson + ");",
                        null
                );
            });
        }

    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(
            int requestCode,
            int resultCode,
            Intent data) {

        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data);

        if (requestCode == FILE_REQUEST && fileCallback != null) {
            Uri[] result =
                    WebChromeClient.FileChooserParams.parseResult(
                            resultCode,
                            data
                    );

            fileCallback.onReceiveValue(result);
            fileCallback = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (webView != null) {
            webView.postDelayed(() -> {
                if (webView != null) {
                    webView.evaluateJavascript(
                        "if(window.homepage && typeof window.homepage.restoreLastPlayedChannel === 'function'){" +
                        "window.homepage.restoreLastPlayedChannel();}",
                        null
                    );
                }
            }, 250);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onBackPressed() {
        if (webView == null) {
            handleExitBack();
            return;
        }

        webView.evaluateJavascript(
                "(function(){return window.isaHandleBack ? window.isaHandleBack() : false;})()",
                value -> {
                    if ("true".equals(value)) {
                        backPressedAt = 0L;
                    } else {
                        handleExitBack();
                    }
                }
        );
    }

    private void handleExitBack() {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (now - backPressedAt < 2000L) {
            finish();
            return;
        }

        backPressedAt = now;
        Toast.makeText(
                this,
                "Çıkmak için geri tuşuna tekrar basın",
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
        ).show();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (fileCallback != null) {
            fileCallback.onReceiveValue(null);
            fileCallback = null;
        }

        networkExecutor.shutdownNow();

        if (webView != null) {
            webView.destroy();
            webView = null;
        }

        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

    private static class Channel {
        String name;
        String url;
        String group;
        String logo;

        int episode;

    }

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        getWindow().addFlags(
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON
        );

        String queueJson = getIntent().getStringExtra("queue_json");

String queueFile = getIntent().getStringExtra("queue_file");

if (queueFile != null) {
    try (java.io.FileInputStream input =
                 new java.io.FileInputStream(queueFile)) {

        java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream bytes =
                new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();

        byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
        int count;

        while ((count = input.read(buffer)) != -1) {
            bytes.write(buffer, 0, count);
        }

        queueJson = bytes.toString("UTF-8");

    } catch (Exception e) {
        android.util.Log.e("ISATV", "Kanal listesi okunamadı", e);
        queueJson = "[]";
    }
}

        selectedIndex =
                getIntent().getIntExtra("selected_index", 0);

        // Ekran döndürülünce son izlenen kanalı geri yükle.
        if (savedInstanceState != null) {
            selectedIndex = savedInstanceState.getInt(
                    "isa_saved_channel_index", selectedIndex);
        }


        try {
            JSONArray array = new JSONArray(
                    queueJson == null ? "[]" : queueJson
            );

            for (int i = 0; i < array.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject object = array.getJSONObject(i);

                Channel channel = new Channel();
                channel.name = object.optString("name", "İsimsiz kanal");
                channel.url = object.optString("url", "");
                channel.group = object.optString("group", "Genel");
                channel.logo = object.optString("logo", "");
                channel.season = object.optInt("season", 0);
                channel.episode = object.optInt("episode", 0);
                channel.isLive = object.optBoolean("is_live", true);

                JSONObject h = object.optJSONObject("headers");

                if (h != null) {
                    Iterator<String> keys = h.keys();

                    while (keys.hasNext()) {
                        String key = keys.next();
                        String value = h.optString(key, "");

                        if (!value.isEmpty() &&
                                key.matches("(?i)[a-z0-9-]+") &&
                                !key.matches("(?i)host|content-length|connection|transfer-encoding|accept-encoding") &&
                                !value.contains("\r") && !value.contains("\n")) {
                            channel.headers.put(key, value);
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (channel.url.matches("(?i)^https?://.*")) {
                    channels.add(channel);
                }
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Kanal listesi okunamadı", e);
        }

        if (channels.isEmpty()) {
            Channel single = new Channel();
            single.name = getIntent().getStringExtra("channel_name");
            single.url = getIntent().getStringExtra("stream_url");

            if (single.name == null) single.name = "İSA TV HD";

            String json = getIntent().getStringExtra("headers_json");

            try {
                JSONObject h = new JSONObject(json == null ? "{}" : json);
                Iterator<String> keys = h.keys();

                while (keys.hasNext()) {
                    String key = keys.next();
                    single.headers.put(key, h.optString(key, ""));
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }

            if (single.url != null) channels.add(single);
        }

        if (channels.isEmpty()) {
            finish();
            return;
        }

        if (selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= channels.size()) {
            selectedIndex = 0;
        }

        createInterface();
        initializePlayer();
        playSelected();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(android.view.KeyEvent event) {

        int key = event.getKeyCode();

        boolean next =
                key == android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP ||
                key == android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_CHANNEL_UP;

        boolean previous =
                key == android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN ||
                key == android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_CHANNEL_DOWN;

        if (next || previous) {

            if (event.getAction() == android.view.KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {

                if (event.getRepeatCount() == 0) {
                    finishChannelSwipe(next ? 1 : -1);
                }
            }

            return true;
        }

        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    private void createInterface() {
        FrameLayout root = new FrameLayout(this);
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.BLACK);

        playerView = new PlayerView(this);
        playerView.setUseController(false);

        root.addView(playerView, new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
        ));

        // Ekrana dokunulduğunda yalnızca kanal listesi açılır.
        // Media3 oynatma kontrolleri devre dışıdır.
        View channelTapLayer = new View(this);
        channelTapLayer.setBackgroundColor(Color.TRANSPARENT);
        channelTapLayer.setOnTouchListener(new View.OnTouchListener() {
            private float startX;
            private float startY;
            private boolean dragging;
            private boolean horizontalDrag;
            private boolean ignoreHorizontal;

            @Override
            public boolean onTouch(View v, android.view.MotionEvent event) {
                boolean portrait =
                        getResources().getConfiguration().orientation
                        == Configuration.ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT;

                switch (event.getAction()) {
                    case android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                        startX = event.getX();
                        startY = event.getY();
                        dragging = false;
                        horizontalDrag = false;
                        ignoreHorizontal = false;
                        return true;

                    case android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE:
                        if (channelTransitioning) return true;

                        float dx = event.getX() - startX;
                        float dy = event.getY() - startY;

                        if (Math.abs(dx) > dp(10) && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
                            dragging = true;
                            horizontalDrag = true;
                            float width = Math.max(1, playerView.getWidth());
                            float offset = Math.max(-width, Math.min(width, dx));
                            playerView.setTranslationX(offset);
                            if (portraitPanel != null) portraitPanel.setTranslationX(offset);
                        } else if (Math.abs(dy) > dp(8) && Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) {
                            dragging = true;
                            horizontalDrag = false;
                            float height = Math.max(playerView.getHeight(), getResources().getDisplayMetrics().heightPixels);
                            float offset = Math.max(-height, Math.min(height, dy));
                            playerView.setTranslationY(offset);
                            if (portraitPanel != null) portraitPanel.setTranslationY(offset);
                        }
                        if (dragging) {
                            handler.removeCallbacks(hideChannelButton);
                            channelButton.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        }
                        return true;

                    case android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:

                        float moveY = event.getY() - startY;
                        float moveX = event.getX() - startX;

                        if (dragging) {
                            if (horizontalDrag) {
                                float threshold = Math.max(dp(70), playerView.getWidth() * 0.18f);
                                if (Math.abs(moveX) >= threshold) finishChannelSwipe(moveX < 0 ? 1 : -1, true);
                                else animateViewsBack(true);
                            } else {
                                float threshold = Math.max(dp(90), playerView.getHeight() * 0.22f);
                                if (Math.abs(moveY) >= threshold) finishChannelSwipe(moveY < 0 ? 1 : -1, false);
                                else animateViewsBack(false);
                            }
                        } else if (Math.abs(moveX) < dp(30) &&
                                   Math.abs(moveY) < dp(30)) {
                            // Dokunma ile kanal listesi açılmaz.
                            // Kanal değiştirme kaydırma hareketi korunur.
                            channelButton.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        }

                        dragging = false;
                        horizontalDrag = false;
                        return true;

                    case android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                        if (dragging) animateViewsBack(horizontalDrag);
                        dragging = false;
                        horizontalDrag = false;
                        return true;
                }
                return true;
            }
        });

        root.addView(channelTapLayer, new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
        ));

        status = new TextView(this);
        status.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        status.setTextSize(15);
        status.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        status.setBackgroundColor(0x99000000);
        status.setVisibility(View.GONE);

        root.addView(status, new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                -2, -2, Gravity.CENTER
        ));

        loadingSpinner = new android.widget.ProgressBar(
                this, null, android.R.attr.progressBarStyleLarge
        );
        loadingSpinner.setIndeterminate(true);
        loadingSpinner.setIndeterminateTintList(
                android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.RED)
        );
        loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.GONE);

        FrameLayout.LayoutParams spinnerParams =
                new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(dp(54), dp(54), Gravity.CENTER);
        root.addView(loadingSpinner, spinnerParams);

        channelButton = new Button(this);
        channelButton.setText("KANAL LİSTESİ");
        channelButton.setTextSize(12);
        channelButton.setAllCaps(false);

        channelButton.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        channelButton.setPadding(dp(18), dp(8), dp(18), dp(8));

        android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable buttonBackground =
            new android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable();
        buttonBackground.setColor(0xCC18263A);
        buttonBackground.setCornerRadius(dp(24));
        buttonBackground.setStroke(dp(1), 0x66FFFFFF);

        channelButton.setBackground(buttonBackground);
        channelButton.setElevation(dp(8));
        channelButton.setOnClickListener(v -> showChannelList());
        channelButton.setVisibility(View.GONE);

        FrameLayout.LayoutParams buttonParams =
                new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                        -2, dp(46),

    private void initializePlayer() {
        player = createManagedPlayer(false);
        playerView.setPlayer(player);
    }


    private ExoPlayer createManagedPlayer(boolean preload) {
        DefaultLoadControl loadControl =
                new DefaultLoadControl.Builder()
                        .setBufferDurationsMs(
                                15000,
                                60000,
                                1000,
                                3000
                        )
                        .setPrioritizeTimeOverSizeThresholds(true)
                        .build();

        ExoPlayer p = new ExoPlayer.Builder(this)
                .setLoadControl(loadControl)
                .build();

        p.setVolume(preload ? 0f : 1f);

        p.setTrackSelectionParameters(
                p.getTrackSelectionParameters()
                        .buildUpon()
                        .setMaxVideoBitrate(
                                preload ? 1500000 : Integer.MAX_VALUE
                        )
                        .build()
        );

        Handler retryHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
        final int[] retryCount = {0};

        Runnable[] retryTask = new Runnable[1];

        retryTask[0] = () -> {
            if (p != player || p.isReleased()) return;

            if (retryCount[0] >= 5) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Canlı yayın yeniden bağlanma denemeleri tükendi.");
                return;
            }

            retryCount[0]++;
            Log.w(TAG, "Yayın yeniden hazırlanıyor. Deneme: "
                    + retryCount[0]);

            p.prepare();
            p.play();
        };

        p.addListener(new Player.Listener() {
            @Override
            public void onPlaybackStateChanged(int state) {
                if (p != player) return;

                if (state == Player.STATE_READY) {
                    retryCount[0] = 0;
                    retryHandler.removeCallbacks(retryTask[0]);
                    status.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.GONE);

                } else if (state == Player.STATE_BUFFERING) {
                    loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);

                } else if (state == Player.STATE_IDLE) {
                    loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.GONE);

                } else if (state == Player.STATE_ENDED) {
                    MediaItem current = p.getCurrentMediaItem();

                    if (current != null
                            && current.localConfiguration != null) {
                        String uri = current.localConfiguration.uri
                                .toString().toLowerCase();

                        if (uri.contains(".m3u8")) {
                            retryHandler.removeCallbacks(retryTask[0]);
                            retryHandler.postDelayed(retryTask[0], 1500);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            @Override
            public void onPlayerError(PlaybackException error) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Oynatıcı hatası: "
                        + error.getErrorCodeName(), error);

                if (p == player) {
                    status.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);

                    retryHandler.removeCallbacks(retryTask[0]);

                    long delay = Math.min(
                            1500L * (retryCount[0] + 1),
                            10000L
                    );

                    retryHandler.postDelayed(retryTask[0], delay);
                }
            }
        });

        return p;
    }

    private void prepareChannel(ExoPlayer target, int index,
                                boolean preload) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= channels.size()) return;

        Channel channel = channels.get(index);

        try {
            DefaultHttpDataSource.Factory factory =
                    new DefaultHttpDataSource.Factory()
                            .setUserAgent(
                                    channel.headers.containsKey("User-Agent")
                                    ? channel.headers.get("User-Agent")
                                    : "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 11) "
                                    + "AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/120 Safari/537.36"
                            )
                            .setConnectTimeoutMs(20000)
                            .setReadTimeoutMs(60000)
                            .setAllowCrossProtocolRedirects(true)
                            .setDefaultRequestProperties(channel.headers);

            String url = channel.url;
            String lowerUrl = url.toLowerCase();
            boolean isHls = lowerUrl.contains(".m3u8");

            MediaItem.Builder itemBuilder = new MediaItem.Builder()
                    .setUri(Uri.parse(url))
                    .setMediaId(channel.name == null
                            ? url : channel.name);

            if (isHls) {
                itemBuilder.setLiveConfiguration(
                        new MediaItem.LiveConfiguration.Builder()
                                .setTargetOffsetMs(15000)
                                .setMinPlaybackSpeed(0.97f)
                                .setMaxPlaybackSpeed(1.03f)
                                .build()
                );
            }

            MediaItem item = itemBuilder.build();

            target.stop();
            target.clearMediaItems();

            target.setVolume(preload ? 0f : 1f);

            target.setTrackSelectionParameters(
                    target.getTrackSelectionParameters()
                            .buildUpon()
                            .setMaxVideoBitrate(
                                    preload ? 1500000 : Integer.MAX_VALUE
                            )
                            .build()
            );

            androidx.media3.exoplayer.source.MediaSource mediaSource;

            if (isHls) {
                mediaSource = new HlsMediaSource.Factory(factory)
                        .setAllowChunklessPreparation(true)
                        .createMediaSource(item);
            } else {
                mediaSource =
                        new androidx.media3.exoplayer.source.DefaultMediaSourceFactory(
                                factory
                        ).createMediaSource(item);
            }

            target.setMediaSource(mediaSource);
            target.prepare();
            target.setPlayWhenReady(!preload);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Kanal hazırlanamadı: " + index, e);
        }
    }

    

    private ExoPlayer obtainStandbyPlayer() {
        if (!standbyPlayers.isEmpty()) {
            return standbyPlayers.remove(standbyPlayers.size() - 1);
        }

        return createManagedPlayer(true);
    }

    private void recyclePlayer(ExoPlayer p) {
        if (p == null || p == player) return;

        p.setPlayWhenReady(false);
        p.stop();
        p.clearMediaItems();
        p.setVolume(0f);

        if (!standbyPlayers.contains(p) && standbyPlayers.size() < 2) {
            standbyPlayers.add(p);
        } else if (!standbyPlayers.contains(p)) {
            p.release();
        }
    }

    private void prepareNeighborChannels() {
        if (channels.size() < 2 || player == null) return;

        int previous = (selectedIndex - 1 + channels.size())
                % channels.size();

        int next = (selectedIndex + 1) % channels.size();

        java.util.HashSet<Integer> wanted = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        wanted.add(previous);
        wanted.add(next);
        wanted.remove(selectedIndex);

        java.util.Iterator<Map.Entry<Integer, ExoPlayer>> iterator =
                preloadedPlayers.entrySet().iterator();

        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
            Map.Entry<Integer, ExoPlayer> entry = iterator.next();

            if (!wanted.contains(entry.getKey())) {
                ExoPlayer old = entry.getValue();
                iterator.remove();
                recyclePlayer(old);
            }
        }

        for (Integer index : wanted) {
            if (!preloadedPlayers.containsKey(index)) {
                ExoPlayer standby = obtainStandbyPlayer();

                preloadedPlayers.put(index, standby);
                prepareChannel(standby, index, true);
            }
        }
    }


    private void animateViewsBack(boolean horizontal) {
        if (playerView == null) return;

        playerView.animate().cancel();
        playerView.animate()
                .translationX(horizontal ? 0f : playerView.getTranslationX())
                .translationY(horizontal ? playerView.getTranslationY() : 0f)
                .setDuration(180)
                .start();

        if (portraitPanel != null) {
            portraitPanel.animate().cancel();
            portraitPanel.animate()
                    .translationX(horizontal ? 0f : portraitPanel.getTranslationX())
                    .translationY(horizontal ? portraitPanel.getTranslationY() : 0f)
                    .setDuration(180)
                    .start();
        }
    }

    private void finishChannelSwipe(int direction) {
        finishChannelSwipe(direction, false);
    }

    private void finishChannelSwipe(int direction, boolean horizontal) {
        if (channels.isEmpty() || channelTransitioning ||
                playerView == null) return;

        channelTransitioning = true;

        final int distance = horizontal ? Math.max(1, playerView.getWidth()) : Math.max(
                playerView.getHeight(), getResources().getDisplayMetrics().heightPixels);
        final float exit = direction > 0 ? -distance : distance;
        final float enter = -exit;

        playerView.animate().cancel();

        if (portraitPanel != null) {
            portraitPanel.animate().cancel();
        }

        playerView.animate()
                .translationX(horizontal ? exit : 0f)
                .translationY(horizontal ? 0f : exit)
                .setDuration(150)
                .withEndAction(() -> {
                    selectedIndex += direction;

                    if (selectedIndex >= channels.size()) selectedIndex = 0;
                    if (selectedIndex < 0) selectedIndex = channels.size() - 1;

                    playSelected();

                    playerView.setTranslationX(horizontal ? enter : 0f);
                    playerView.setTranslationY(horizontal ? 0f : enter);

                    if (portraitPanel != null) {
                        portraitPanel.setTranslationX(horizontal ? enter : 0f);
                        portraitPanel.setTranslationY(horizontal ? 0f : enter);
                    }

                    playerView.animate()
                            .translationX(0f)
                            .translationY(0f)
                            .setDuration(220)
                            .withEndAction(() -> {
                                channelTransitioning = false;
                            })
                            .start();

                    if (portraitPanel != null) {
                        portraitPanel.animate()
                                .translationX(0f)
                                .translationY(0f)
                                .setDuration(220)
                                .start();
                    }
                })
                .start();

        if (portraitPanel != null) {
            portraitPanel.animate()
                    .translationX(horizontal ? exit : 0f)
                    .translationY(horizontal ? 0f : exit)
                    .setDuration(150)
                    .start();
        }
    }

    
    private void playSelected() {
        if (player == null || selectedIndex < 0 ||
                selectedIndex >= channels.size()) return;

        Channel channel = channels.get(selectedIndex);

        updatePortraitOverlay();

        if (loadingSpinner != null) {
            loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        if (status != null) {
            status.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        ExoPlayer oldActive = player;
        ExoPlayer readyPlayer = preloadedPlayers.remove(selectedIndex);

        try {
            if (readyPlayer != null) {
                // Hazırlanmış komşu oynatıcıyı aktif hale getir.
                player = readyPlayer;
                playerView.setPlayer(player);

                player.setVolume(1f);
                player.setTrackSelectionParameters(
                        player.getTrackSelectionParameters()
                                .buildUpon()
                                .setMaxVideoBitrate(Integer.MAX_VALUE)
                                .build()
                );

                player.setPlayWhenReady(true);

                recyclePlayer(oldActive);

            } else {
                // Hazır değilse mevcut aktif oynatıcıyla aç.
                prepareChannel(player, selectedIndex, false);
            }

            setTitle(channel.name);
            status.setVisibility(View.GONE);

            // Önceden hazırlanmış oynatıcı READY olmuş olabilir.
            int activeState = player.getPlaybackState();

            if (activeState == Player.STATE_READY) {
                loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            } else if (activeState == Player.STATE_BUFFERING ||
                       activeState == Player.STATE_IDLE) {
                loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            }

            applyPreloadPolicy();

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Kanal başlatılamadı", e);
            loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }



    


private boolean isPortraitMode() {
    return getResources().getConfiguration().orientation
            == Configuration.ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT;
}

private boolean isTelevisionDevice() {
    int type = getResources().getConfiguration().uiMode
            & Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_MASK;

    return type == Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_TELEVISION
            || getPackageManager().hasSystemFeature(
                    android.content.pm.PackageManager.FEATURE_LEANBACK
            );
}

private boolean isPhoneDevice() {
    if (isTelevisionDevice()) return false;

    int smallestWidth =
            getResources().getConfiguration().smallestScreenWidthDp;

    if (smallestWidth > 0) {
        return smallestWidth < 600;
    }

    float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
    float widthDp =
            getResources().getDisplayMetrics().widthPixels / density;

    return widthDp < 600;
}

private void stopNeighborPreloads() {
    Iterator<Map.Entry<Integer, ExoPlayer>> iterator =
            preloadedPlayers.entrySet().iterator();

    while (iterator.hasNext()) {
        ExoPlayer standby = iterator.next().getValue();
        iterator.remove();
        recyclePlayer(standby);
    }
}


    // Komşu yayınları aç ve altı saniyelik sayaç başlat.
    private void startNeighborPreloadsWithTimeout() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(neighborPreloadTimeout);

        neighborPreloadUnlocked = true;

        if (portraitWarning != null) {
            portraitWarning.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        if (player != null && channels.size() >= 2) {
            prepareNeighborChannels();
        } else {
            stopNeighborPreloads();
        }

        handler.postDelayed(neighborPreloadTimeout, 6000L);
    }

private void applyPreloadPolicy() {
        startNeighborPreloadsWithTimeout();
    }

private boolean isCurrentChannelFavorite() {
    if (selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= channels.size()) return false;

    String url = channels.get(selectedIndex).url;
    try {
        JSONArray favorites = new JSONArray(
                getSharedPreferences("isa_tv_data", MODE_PRIVATE)
                        .getString("favorites", "[]"));

        for (int i = 0; i < favorites.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject item = favorites.optJSONObject(i);
            if (item != null && url.equals(item.optString("url", ""))) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    } catch (Exception e) {
        Log.e(TAG, "Favoriler okunamadı", e);
    }
    return false;
}

private void updatePortraitOverlay() {
    if (portraitChannelName == null || favoriteButton == null) return;

    boolean portrait = isPortraitMode();
    if (portraitPanel != null) portraitPanel.setVisibility(portrait ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);

    portraitChannelName.setVisibility(portrait ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
    boolean liveItem = selectedIndex >= 0 && selectedIndex < channels.size()
            && channels.get(selectedIndex).isLive;
    portraitLiveBadge.setVisibility(portrait && liveItem ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
    if (portraitEpisodeInfo != null) portraitEpisodeInfo.setVisibility(portrait ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
    favoriteButton.setVisibility(portrait ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);

    if (!portrait) return;

    if (selectedIndex >= 0 && selectedIndex < channels.size()) {
        Channel channel = channels.get(selectedIndex);
        portraitChannelName.setText(
                channel.name == null ? "İSA TV HD" : channel.name);
        if (portraitEpisodeInfo != null) {
            if (channel.season > 0 || channel.episode > 0) {
                String label = (channel.season > 0 ? "Sezon " + channel.season : "") +
                        (channel.episode > 0 ? "  ·  " + channel.episode + ". Bölüm" : "");
                portraitEpisodeInfo.setText(label.trim());
                portraitEpisodeInfo.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            } else portraitEpisodeInfo.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }

    favoriteButton.setText(isCurrentChannelFavorite() ? "♥" : "♡");
    favoriteButton.setContentDescription(
            isCurrentChannelFavorite()
                    ? "Favorilerden çıkar"
                    : "Favorilere ekle");
}

private void toggleCurrentFavorite() {
    if (selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= channels.size()) return;

    Channel channel = channels.get(selectedIndex);
    boolean add = !isCurrentChannelFavorite();

    try {
        JSONObject item = new JSONObject();
        item.put("name", channel.name == null ? "İsimsiz kanal" : channel.name);
        item.put("url", channel.url);
        item.put("group", channel.group == null ? "Genel" : channel.group);
        item.put("logo", channel.logo == null ? "" : channel.logo);
        item.put("is_live", channel.isLive);
        item.put("season", channel.season);
        item.put("episode", channel.episode);

        android.content.SharedPreferences prefs =
                getSharedPreferences("isa_tv_data", MODE_PRIVATE);

        JSONArray old = new JSONArray(prefs.getString("favorites", "[]"));
        JSONArray updated = new JSONArray();

        for (int i = 0; i < old.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject existing = old.optJSONObject(i);
            if (existing == null) continue;

            if (!channel.url.equals(existing.optString("url", ""))) {
                updated.put(existing);
            }
        }

        if (add) updated.put(item);

        prefs.edit().putString("favorites", updated.toString()).apply();
        updatePortraitOverlay();

    } catch (Exception e) {
        Log.e(TAG, "Favori değiştirilemedi", e);
    }
}

private void showChannelList() {
    if (channels.isEmpty()) return;
    if (channelDialog != null && channelDialog.isShowing()) return;

    final Dialog dialog = new Dialog(this);
    channelDialog = dialog;

    final java.util.ArrayList<String> groups = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
    final java.util.LinkedHashMap<String, java.util.ArrayList<Integer>> grouped =
            new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();

    for (int i = 0; i < channels.size(); i++) {
        Channel c = channels.get(i);
        String g = c.group == null || c.group.trim().isEmpty()
                ? "Genel" : c.group.trim();

        if (!grouped.containsKey(g)) {
            grouped.put(g, new java.util.ArrayList<Integer>());
            groups.add(g);
        }
        grouped.get(g).add(i);
    }

    final int[] groupIndex = {0};

    // Açık kanalın grubunu başlangıç grubu yap.
    if (selectedIndex >= 0 && selectedIndex < channels.size()) {
        String selectedGroup = channels.get(selectedIndex).group;
        if (selectedGroup == null || selectedGroup.trim().isEmpty()) {
            selectedGroup = "Genel";
        } else {
            selectedGroup = selectedGroup.trim();
        }

        int foundGroup = groups.indexOf(selectedGroup);
        if (foundGroup >= 0) groupIndex[0] = foundGroup;
    }

    final java.util.ArrayList<Integer> visibleItems = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

    LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
    root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
    root.setPadding(
            dp(isPortraitMode() ? 14 : 8),
            dp(isPortraitMode() ? 14 : 8),
            dp(isPortraitMode() ? 14 : 8),
            dp(isPortraitMode() ? 12 : 8));
    root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(17, 21, 29));

    TextView title = new TextView(this);
    title.setText("İSA TV HD  •  KANALLAR");
    title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
    title.setTextSize(18);
    title.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
    title.setPadding(dp(8), dp(8), dp(8), dp(14));
    root.addView(title);

    LinearLayout groupBar = new LinearLayout(this);
    groupBar.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
    groupBar.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
    groupBar.setPadding(dp(4), dp(8), dp(4), dp(8));
    groupBar.setBackgroundColor(0xFF252E3C);

    TextView previous = new TextView(this);
    previous.setText("‹");
    previous.setTextSize(30);
    previous.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
    previous.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
    previous.setMinWidth(dp(48));

    TextView groupName = new TextView(this);
    groupName.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
    groupName.setTextSize(14);
    groupName.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
    groupName.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
    groupName.setMaxLines(2);

    TextView next = new TextView(this);
    next.setText("›");
    next.setTextSize(30);
    next.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
    next.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
    next.setMinWidth(dp(48));

    groupBar.addView(previous);
    groupBar.addView(groupName, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
            0, dp(48), 1f));
    groupBar.addView(next);
    root.addView(groupBar);

    EditText search = new EditText(this);
    search.setSingleLine(true);

    if (dialog.getWindow() != null) {

        int screenHeight = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().heightPixels;

        dialog.getWindow().addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DIM_BEHIND);
        WindowManager.LayoutParams params = dialog.getWindow().getAttributes();

    @Override
    public void onConfigurationChanged(Configuration newConfig) {
        super.onConfigurationChanged(newConfig);

        // Mevcut ExoPlayer ve video yüzeyini değiştirme.
        // Böylece yayın bağlantısı yeniden kurulmaz.
        if (channelDialog != null && channelDialog.isShowing()) {
            channelDialog.dismiss();
        }

        if (logo != null &&
                logo.getLayoutParams() instanceof FrameLayout.LayoutParams) {
            boolean portrait = isPortraitMode();

            FrameLayout.LayoutParams lp =
                    (FrameLayout.LayoutParams) logo.getLayoutParams();

            lp.width = dp(portrait ? 68 : 130);
            lp.height = dp(portrait ? 42 : 80);
            lp.gravity = Gravity.TOP | Gravity.RIGHT;
            lp.setMargins(
                    0,
                    dp(portrait ? 8 : 12),
                    dp(portrait ? 8 : 12),
                    0);

            logo.setLayoutParams(lp);
            logo.setPadding(
                    portrait ? 0 : dp(5),
                    portrait ? 0 : dp(5),
                    portrait ? 0 : dp(5),
                    portrait ? 0 : dp(5));
            logo.setBackgroundColor(
                    portrait ? Color.TRANSPARENT : 0x880F0F0F);
        }

        updatePortraitOverlay();

        applyPreloadPolicy();

        if (channelButton != null) {
            channelButton.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
        applyImmersiveMode();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onPause() {
        super.onPause();

        handler.removeCallbacks(neighborPreloadTimeout);
        stopNeighborPreloads();

        if (player != null) player.pause();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();

        if (player != null) {
            applyPreloadPolicy();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);

        if (playerView != null) {
            playerView.setPlayer(null);
        }

        java.util.HashSet<ExoPlayer> allPlayers =
                new java.util.HashSet<>();

        if (player != null) allPlayers.add(player);
        allPlayers.addAll(preloadedPlayers.values());
        allPlayers.addAll(standbyPlayers);

        preloadedPlayers.clear();
        standbyPlayers.clear();

        for (ExoPlayer p : allPlayers) {
            try {
                p.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }

        player = null;

        super.onDestroy();
    }

}

(function () {
'use strict';



const STORAGE_KEY = 'isa-tv-playlists-v3';

let channels = [];
let playlists = [];
let vodProviders = [];
let fetchCounter = 0;
let cacheCounter = 0;
let currentProvider = null;
let isaFavoritesOpen = false;
let isaFavoritesToggleBound = false;

window.__isaCacheCallbacks = {};
window.__isaFetchCallbacks = {};

window.__isaCacheDone = function(id,value,error) {
    const cb = window.__isaCacheCallbacks[id];
    if (!cb) return;
    delete window.__isaCacheCallbacks[id];
    if (error) cb.reject(new Error(error));
    else cb.resolve(value);
};

window.__isaFetchDone = function(id,value,error) {
    const cb = window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id];
    if (!cb) return;
    delete window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id];
    if (error) cb.reject(new Error(error));
    else cb.resolve(value);
};


let catalogRequestId = 0;
let catalogTimerStarted = false;
let catalogLastData = null;
let catalogHasCache = false;
let catalogLoading = false;
let catalogInFlight = null;

window.__isaCatalogCallbacks = {};



function isaCatalogProgressElement() {
    let element = document.getElementById(
        'isa-catalog-progress-overlay'
    );

    if (!element) {
        element = document.createElement('div');
        element.id = 'isa-catalog-progress-overlay';
        element.style.cssText =
            'position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;' +
            'height:3px;z-index:999999;' +
            'pointer-events:none;background:transparent;';

        element.innerHTML =
            '<div id="isa-catalog-fill" style="' +
            'height:3px;width:0;background:#16b978;' +
            'transition:width .12s linear"></div>' +
            '<div id="isa-catalog-percent" style="' +
            'position:absolute;right:8px;top:5px;' +
            'font-size:10px;color:#16b978;' +
            'background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);' +
            'padding:2px 5px;border-radius:4px">0%</div>';

        document.body.appendChild(element);
    }

    return element;
}

function isaCatalogHideProgress() {
    const element = document.getElementById(
        'isa-catalog-progress-overlay'
    );

    if (element) element.remove();
}

window.__isaCatalogProgress = function(id, stage, percent) {
    if (catalogHasCache) return;

    const root = isaCatalogProgressElement();
    const value = Math.max(
        0, Math.min(100, Number(percent) || 0)
    );

    root.querySelector('#isa-catalog-fill').style.width =
        value + '%';

    root.querySelector('#isa-catalog-percent').textContent =
        value + '%';
};

window.__isaCatalogDone = function(id, value, error) {
    const callback = window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];
    if (!callback) return;

    delete window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];

    if (error) {
        isaCatalogHideProgress();
        callback.reject(new Error(error));
    } else {
        callback.resolve(value);
    }
};

window.__isaCatalogReady = function(id, totalBytes, error, notModified) {
    if (error) {
        window.__isaCatalogDone(id, null, error);
        return;
    }

    const callback = window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];

    if (!callback) return;

    if (notModified && catalogLastData &&
        typeof catalogLastData === 'object') {
        window.__isaCatalogDone(id, catalogLastData, null);
        return;
    }

    if (!window.ISATV ||
        typeof window.ISATV.readCatalogChunk !== 'function') {
        window.__isaCatalogDone(
            id, null, 'Java Catalog parça bağlantısı bulunamadı.'
        );
        return;
    }

    if (!Number.isFinite(totalBytes) || totalBytes <= 0) {
        window.__isaCatalogDone(
            id, null, 'Catalog kataloğu boş.'
        );
        return;
    }

    let offset = 0;
    const chunkSize = 65536;
    let completeText = '';
    const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');

    function readNext() {
        try {
            const encoded = window.ISATV.readCatalogChunk(
                String(offset), chunkSize
            );

            if (!encoded) {
                throw new Error('Catalog veri parçası boş geldi.');
            }

            const binary = atob(encoded);
            const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);

            for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
                bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
            }

            offset += bytes.length;

            completeText += decoder.decode(
                bytes,
                {stream: offset < totalBytes}
            );

            const percent = Math.min(
                99,
                90 + Math.floor(offset * 9 / totalBytes)
            );

            window.__isaCatalogProgress(id, 'load', percent);

            if (offset < totalBytes) {
                setTimeout(readNext, 0);
                return;
            }

            completeText += decoder.decode();

            window.__isaCatalogDone(
                id, completeText, null
            );

        } catch (e) {
            completeText = '';

            window.__isaCatalogDone(
                id, null,
                'Catalog aktarım hatası: ' + e.message
            );
        }
    }

    readNext();
};


function loadCachedCatalogCatalog() {
    if (!window.ISATV ||
        typeof window.ISATV.loadCachedCatalogCatalog !== 'function') {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
    }

    catalogHasCache = true;

    return new Promise(resolve => {
        const id = ++catalogRequestId;

        window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id] = {
            resolve: value => {
                try {
                    const parsed =
                        (value && typeof value === 'object')
                        ? value : JSON.parse(value);

                    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') {
                        throw new Error('Gecersiz veri');
                    }

                    catalogLastData = parsed;
                    window.ISA_Catalog_CATALOG = parsed;
                    catalogHasCache = true;
                    resolve(parsed);

                } catch (e) {
                    catalogHasCache = false;
                    resolve(null);
                }
            },

            reject: () => {
                catalogHasCache = false;
                resolve(null);
            }
        };

        try {
            window.ISATV.loadCachedCatalogCatalog(String(id));
        } catch (e) {
            delete window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];
            catalogHasCache = false;
            resolve(null);
        }
    });
}

function fetchCatalogCatalog() {
    if (catalogInFlight) return catalogInFlight;

    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.fetchCatalogCatalog) {
        return Promise.reject(
            new Error('Catalog native bağlantısı kullanılamıyor.')
        );
    }

    catalogLoading = true;

    catalogInFlight = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const id = ++catalogRequestId;

        window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id] = {
            resolve: value => {
                try {
                    const parsed = (value && typeof value === 'object')
                        ? value : JSON.parse(value);
                    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') {
                        throw new Error('Boş veya geçersiz katalog.');
                    }
                    catalogLastData = parsed;
                    window.__isaCatalogProgress(id, "parse", 100);
                    setTimeout(isaCatalogHideProgress, 180);
                    catalogHasCache = true;
                    resolve(parsed);
                } catch (e) {
                    reject(new Error('Catalog JSON doğrulaması başarısız: ' + e.message));
                } finally {
                    catalogLoading = false;
                    catalogInFlight = null;
                }
            },
            reject: error => {
                catalogLoading = false;
                catalogInFlight = null;
                reject(error);
            }
        };

        try {
            window.ISATV.fetchCatalogCatalog(String(id));
        } catch (e) {
            delete window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];
            catalogLoading = false;
            catalogInFlight = null;
            reject(e);
        }
    });

    return catalogInFlight;
}

async function refreshCatalogCatalog(silent=false) {
    try {
        const previousData = catalogLastData;
        const data = await fetchCatalogCatalog();

        if (data === previousData) return data;

        window.ISA_Catalog_CATALOG = data;
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(
            'isa:catalog-catalog-updated',
            {detail:data}
        ));

        if (!silent) {
            const status = document.getElementById('isa-live-status');
            if (status) status.textContent = 'Catalog kataloğu güncellendi.';
        }

        return data;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Catalog katalog güncellemesi:', error);

        if (!silent) {
            const status = document.getElementById('isa-live-status');
            if (status) status.textContent =
                'Catalog güncellenemedi: ' + error.message;
        }

        return catalogLastData;
    }
}


function startCatalogAutoUpdate() {
    if (catalogTimerStarted) return;
    catalogTimerStarted = true;

    loadCachedCatalogCatalog().then(cached => {
        if (cached) {
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(
                'isa:catalog-catalog-updated',
                {detail: cached}
            ));
        }

        refreshCatalogCatalog(true);
    });

    window.setInterval(() => {
        if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
            refreshCatalogCatalog(true);
        }
    }, 60000);
}

function nativeCacheGet(key) {
    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.cacheGet) {
        try {
            return Promise.resolve(localStorage.getItem('isa-cache:'+key));
        } catch(e) {
            return Promise.resolve(null);
        }
    }

    return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
        const id = ++cacheCounter;
        window.__isaCacheCallbacks[id] = {resolve,reject};
        window.ISATV.cacheGet(key,String(id));
    });
}

function nativeCachePut(key,value) {
    if (window.ISATV && window.ISATV.cachePut) {
        window.ISATV.cachePut(key,value);
    } else {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem('isa-cache:'+key,value);
        } catch(e) {}
    }
}

function nativeFetch(url) {
    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.fetchText) {
        return fetch(url).then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
            return response.text();
        });
    }
    return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
        const id = ++fetchCounter;
        window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id] = {resolve,reject};
        window.ISATV.fetchText(url,String(id));
    });
}

function nativeFetchWithHeaders(url,headers={}) {
    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.fetchTextWithHeaders) {
        return fetch(url,{headers}).then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
            return response.text();
        });
    }
    return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
        const id = ++fetchCounter;
        window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id] = {resolve,reject};
        window.ISATV.fetchTextWithHeaders(url,JSON.stringify(headers || {}),String(id));
    });
}

function getTextWithHeaders(url,headers={}) {
    return nativeFetchWithHeaders(url,headers);
}

async function getText(url,forceRefresh=false) {
    let cached = null;

    try {
        cached = await nativeCacheGet(url);
    } catch(e) {}

    if (!forceRefresh && cached) return cached;

    try {
        const fresh = await nativeFetch(url);
        nativeCachePut(url,fresh);
        return fresh;
    } catch(e) {
        if (cached) return cached;
        throw e;
    }
}

function esc(value) {
    return String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c => ({
        '&':'&amp;',
        '<':'&lt;',
        '>':'&gt;',
        '"':'&quot;',
        "'":'&#39;'
    })[c]);
}
