    private void createTvLogo() {
        if (!shouldShowTvLogo()) return;

        try {
            tvLogo = new ImageView(this);

            try (java.io.InputStream input =
                    getAssets().open("isa-tv-hd/assets/logo.png")) {
                tvLogo.setImageBitmap(
                        BitmapFactory.decodeStream(input)
                );
            }

            tvLogo.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.FIT_CENTER);
            tvLogo.setPadding(dp(5), dp(5), dp(5), dp(5));
            tvLogo.setBackgroundColor(0x880F0F0F);
            tvLogo.setContentDescription("İSA TV HD");

            FrameLayout.LayoutParams params =
                    new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                            dp(145),
                            dp(90),
                            Gravity.TOP | Gravity.RIGHT
                    );

            params.setMargins(0, dp(16), dp(22), 0);
            root.addView(tvLogo, params);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "TV logosu yüklenemedi", e);
        }
    }

    private int dp(float value) {
        return (int) (
                value * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density
                + 0.5f
        );
    }

    private boolean shouldShowTvLogo() {
        Configuration c = getResources().getConfiguration();

        boolean landscape =
                c.orientation == Configuration.ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE;

        boolean television =
                (c.uiMode & Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_MASK)
                == Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_TELEVISION;

        boolean tablet = c.smallestScreenWidthDp >= 600;

        return landscape && (television || tablet);
    }

    public class ISATVBridge {

        @JavascriptInterface
        public void play(
                String name,
                String url,
                String headersJson,
                String queueJson,
                int selectedIndex) {

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (url == null ||
                        !url.matches("(?i)^https?://.*")) {
                    return;
                }

                Intent intent = new Intent(
                        MainActivity.this,
                        PlayerActivity.class
                );

                intent.putExtra("stream_url", url);
                intent.putExtra(
                        "channel_name",
                        name == null ? "İSA TV HD" : name
                );
                intent.putExtra(
                        "headers_json",
                        headersJson == null ? "{}" : headersJson
                );
                
try {
    java.io.File queueFile = new java.io.File(
            getCacheDir(),
            "isa-player-queue.json"
    );

    try (java.io.FileOutputStream output =
                 new java.io.FileOutputStream(queueFile, false)) {
        output.write(
                (queueJson == null ? "[]" : queueJson)
                        .getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
        );
        output.flush();
    }

    intent.putExtra("queue_file", queueFile.getAbsolutePath());
    intent.putExtra("selected_index", selectedIndex);
    startActivity(intent);

} catch (Exception e) {
    android.util.Log.e("ISATV", "Kanal kuyruğu aktarılamadı", e);
}

            });
        }


        // ISAFLIX_QUEUE_V2
        @JavascriptInterface
        public void playIsaflix(
                String name,
                String url,
                String headersJson,
                String queueJson,
                int selectedIndex) {

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                int targetIndex = selectedIndex;

                if (url == null ||
                        !url.matches("(?i)^https?://.*")) {
                    return;
                }

                try {
                    org.json.JSONArray queue = new org.json.JSONArray(
                            queueJson == null ? "[]" : queueJson
                    );

                    if (queue.length() == 0) {
                        org.json.JSONObject one = new org.json.JSONObject();
                        one.put("name", name == null ? "İSAFLIX" : name);
                        one.put("url", url);
                        one.put("headers", new org.json.JSONObject(
                                headersJson == null ? "{}" : headersJson
                        ));
                        one.put("is_live", false);
                        queue.put(one);
                        targetIndex = 0;
                    }

                    java.io.File queueFile = new java.io.File(
                            getCacheDir(),
                            "isaflix-player-queue.json"
                    );

                    try (java.io.FileOutputStream output =
                                 new java.io.FileOutputStream(queueFile, false)) {
                        output.write(queue.toString().getBytes(
                                java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                        ));
                        output.flush();
                    }

                    Intent intent = new Intent(
                            MainActivity.this,
                            IsaflixPlayerActivity.class
                    );
                    intent.putExtra("stream_url", url);
                    intent.putExtra(
                            "channel_name",
                            name == null ? "İSAFLIX" : name
                    );
                    intent.putExtra(
                            "headers_json",
                            headersJson == null ? "{}" : headersJson
                    );
                    intent.putExtra("queue_file", queueFile.getAbsolutePath());
                    intent.putExtra("selected_index", targetIndex);
                    startActivity(intent);

                } catch (Exception e) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "İSAFLIX kuyruğu aktarılamadı", e);
                    Toast.makeText(
                            MainActivity.this,
                            "İSAFLIX oynatma listesi hazırlanamadı",
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show();
                }
            });
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public String getFavorites() {
            return getSharedPreferences("isa_tv_data", MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .getString("favorites", "[]");
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public void setFavorite(String channelJson, boolean favorite) {
            try {
                JSONObject channel = new JSONObject(channelJson);
                String url = channel.optString("url", "");
                if (url.isEmpty()) return;

                android.content.SharedPreferences prefs =
                        getSharedPreferences("isa_tv_data", MODE_PRIVATE);

                JSONArray old = new JSONArray(prefs.getString("favorites", "[]"));
                JSONArray updated = new JSONArray();

                for (int i = 0; i < old.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject item = old.optJSONObject(i);
                    if (item == null) continue;
                    if (!url.equals(item.optString("url", ""))) {
                        updated.put(item);
                    }
                }

                if (favorite) updated.put(channel);

                prefs.edit().putString("favorites", updated.toString()).apply();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Favori kaydedilemedi", e);
            }
        }


        private void reportCatalogProgress(
            String callbackId, String stage, int percent
        ) {
            final String id = callbackId == null
                ? "0" : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");
            final int value = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent));

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (webView == null) return;
                webView.evaluateJavascript(
                    "if(window.__isaCatalogProgress)window.__isaCatalogProgress(" +
                    JSONObject.quote(id) + "," +
                    JSONObject.quote(stage) + "," + value + ");",
                    null
                );
            });
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public String readCatalogChunk(String offsetText, int requestedBytes) {
            try {
                long offset = Long.parseLong(offsetText);

                java.io.File file = new java.io.File(
                    getCacheDir(), "isaflix-web-katalog.json"
                );

                if (!file.isFile() || offset < 0 ||
                    offset >= file.length()) {
                    return "";
                }

                int size = Math.max(1024,
                    Math.min(65536, requestedBytes));

                int count = (int)Math.min(
                    (long) size, file.length() - offset
                );

                byte[] buffer = new byte[count];

                try (java.io.RandomAccessFile input =
                         new java.io.RandomAccessFile(file, "r")) {
                    input.seek(offset);
                    input.readFully(buffer);
                }

                return android.util.Base64.encodeToString(
                    buffer,
                    android.util.Base64.NO_WRAP
                );

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Catalog parça okuma hatası", e);
                return "";
            }
        }


        @JavascriptInterface
        public void loadCachedCatalogCatalog(String callbackId) {
            final String id = callbackId == null
                ? "0" : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");

            java.io.File cache = new java.io.File(
                getCacheDir(), "isaflix-web-katalog.json"
            );

            final boolean exists =
                cache.isFile() && cache.length() > 0;

            final long size = exists ? cache.length() : 0L;

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (webView == null) return;

                if (exists) {
                    webView.evaluateJavascript(
                        "window.__isaCatalogReady(" +
                        JSONObject.quote(id) + "," +
                        size + ",null,false);",
                        null
                    );
                } else {
                    webView.evaluateJavascript(
                        "window.__isaCatalogDone(" +
                        JSONObject.quote(id) +
                        ",null,'CACHE_EMPTY');",
                        null
                    );
                }
            });
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public void fetchCatalogCatalog(String callbackId) {
            networkExecutor.execute(() -> {
                String error = null;
                boolean notModified = false;

                HttpURLConnection connection = null;

                try {
                    java.io.File cache = new java.io.File(
                        getCacheDir(), "isaflix-web-katalog.json"
                    );

                    android.content.SharedPreferences prefs =
                        getSharedPreferences("isaflix_web_catalog", MODE_PRIVATE);

                    String etag = prefs.getString("etag", "");
                    String modified = prefs.getString("modified", "");

                    URL url = new URL(
                        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thechampisher/ISA-TV-HD/main/INCELEME/isaflix-web-katalog.json"
                    );

                    connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
                    connection.setConnectTimeout(20000);
                    connection.setReadTimeout(180000);
                    connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
                    connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
                    connection.setRequestProperty("Accept-Encoding", "identity");
                    connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "ISA-TV-HD/1.0");

                    if (!etag.isEmpty())
                        connection.setRequestProperty("If-None-Match", etag);

                    if (!modified.isEmpty())
                        connection.setRequestProperty("If-Modified-Since", modified);

                    int status = connection.getResponseCode();

                    if (status == 304 && cache.isFile() && cache.length() > 0) {
                        notModified = true;
                    } else if (status >= 200 && status < 300) {
                        java.io.File encrypted = new java.io.File(
                            getCacheDir(), "catalog-catalog.download"
                        );

                        long totalBytes = connection.getContentLengthLong();
                        long downloaded = 0;
                        int lastPercent = -1;
                        long lastReport = 0;

                        reportCatalogProgress(callbackId, "download", 0);

                        try (
                            java.io.InputStream in = connection.getInputStream();
                            java.io.FileOutputStream out =
                                new java.io.FileOutputStream(encrypted)
                        ) {
                            byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
                            int n;

                            while ((n = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                                out.write(buffer, 0, n);
                                downloaded += n;

                                int percent = totalBytes > 0
    ? (int)Math.min(70, downloaded * 70L / totalBytes)
    : 0;

                                long now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();

                                if (percent != lastPercent &&
                                    (now - lastReport >= 150 || percent == 100)) {
                                    reportCatalogProgress(
                                        callbackId, "download", percent
                                    );
                                    lastPercent = percent;
                                    lastReport = now;
                                }
                            }

                            out.getFD().sync();
                        }

                        reportCatalogProgress(callbackId, "load", 70);

                        decryptCatalogFile(encrypted, cache, callbackId);
                        encrypted.delete();

                        String newEtag = connection.getHeaderField("ETag");
                        String newModified = connection.getHeaderField("Last-Modified");

                        android.content.SharedPreferences.Editor edit = prefs.edit();
                        if (newEtag != null) edit.putString("etag", newEtag);
                        if (newModified != null) edit.putString("modified", newModified);
                        edit.apply();

                    } else {
                        throw new java.io.IOException("Catalog HTTP " + status);
                    }

                } catch (Exception ex) {
                    error = ex.getMessage() == null
                        ? "Catalog kataloğu alınamadı." : ex.getMessage();

                    Log.e(TAG, "Catalog katalog hatası", ex);
                } finally {
                    if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
                }

                final String failure = error;
                final boolean finalNotModified = notModified;
                final String id = callbackId == null
                    ? "0" : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");

                final java.io.File catalogFile = new java.io.File(
                    getCacheDir(), "isaflix-web-katalog.json"
                );

                final long catalogSize =
                    failure == null && catalogFile.isFile()
                    ? catalogFile.length() : 0L;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (webView == null) return;

                    webView.evaluateJavascript(
                        "window.__isaCatalogReady(" + id + "," +
                        catalogSize + "," +
                        JSONObject.quote(failure) + "," +
                        (finalNotModified ? "true" : "false") + ");",
                        null
                    );
                });
            });
        }

        private String readUtf8File(java.io.File file) throws Exception {
            StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
            try (
                java.io.BufferedReader reader = new java.io.BufferedReader(
                    new java.io.InputStreamReader(
                        new java.io.FileInputStream(file),
                        StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                    ), 65536
                )
            ) {
                char[] buffer = new char[32768];
                int n;
                while ((n = reader.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                    result.append(buffer, 0, n);
                }
            }
            return result.toString();
        }

        private void decryptCatalogFile(
            java.io.File source,
            java.io.File destination,
            String callbackId
        ) throws Exception {

            try (
                java.io.BufferedInputStream input =
                    new java.io.BufferedInputStream(
                        new java.io.FileInputStream(source), 65536
                    )
            ) {
                byte[] header = new byte[4];
                int count = 0;
                while (count < 4) {
                    int n = input.read(header, count, 4-count);
                    if (n < 0) throw new java.io.IOException("Dosya eksik.");
                    count += n;
                }

                boolean encrypted =
                    header[0] == 68 && header[1] == 84 &&
                    header[2] == 86 && header[3] == 49;

                java.io.InputStream plain = input;

                if (encrypted) {
                    byte[] iv = new byte[12];
                    int filled = 0;

                    while (filled < 12) {
                        int n = input.read(iv, filled, 12-filled);
                        if (n < 0)
                            throw new java.io.IOException("DTV1 IV eksik.");
                        filled += n;
                    }

                    byte[] digest = java.security.MessageDigest
                        .getInstance("SHA-256")
                        .digest(
                            (new String(new char[]{100,111,109,105,110,111}) + "|tv-cat|alog-v1|-2026")
                            .getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                        );

                    javax.crypto.Cipher cipher =
                        javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding");

                    cipher.init(
                        javax.crypto.Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE,
                        new javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(digest, "AES"),
                        new javax.crypto.spec.GCMParameterSpec(128, iv)
                    );

                    final long cipherTotal = Math.max(1L, source.length() - 16L);

                    plain = new javax.crypto.CipherInputStream(
                        new java.io.FilterInputStream(input) {
                            private long consumed = 0;
                            private int lastPercent = -1;
                            private long lastReport = 0;

                            private void updateProgress(long amount) {
                                consumed += amount;

                                int percent = (int)Math.min(
                                    90L, 70L + consumed * 20L / cipherTotal
                                );

                                long now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();

                                if (percent != lastPercent &&
                                    (now - lastReport >= 150 || percent == 99)) {
                                    reportCatalogProgress(
                                        callbackId, "load", percent
                                    );
                                    lastPercent = percent;
                                    lastReport = now;
                                }
                            }

                            @Override
                            public int read(byte[] b, int off, int len)
                                throws java.io.IOException {
                                int n = super.read(b, off, len);
                                if (n > 0) updateProgress(n);
                                return n;
                            }

                            @Override
                            public int read() throws java.io.IOException {
                                int value = super.read();
                                if (value != -1) updateProgress(1);
                                return value;
                            }
                        },
                        cipher
                    );
                } else {
                    java.io.PushbackInputStream push =
                        new java.io.PushbackInputStream(input, 4);
                    push.unread(header);
                    plain = push;
                }

                java.io.File temp = new java.io.File(
                    destination.getParentFile(),
                    destination.getName() + ".tmp"
                );

                try (
                    java.io.InputStream decoded = plain;
                    java.io.BufferedOutputStream output =
                        new java.io.BufferedOutputStream(
                            new java.io.FileOutputStream(temp), 65536
                        )
                ) {
                    byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
                    int n;

                    while ((n = decoded.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                        output.write(buffer, 0, n);
                    }

                    output.flush();
                }

                reportCatalogProgress(callbackId, "load", 90);

                if (!temp.renameTo(destination)) {
                    try (
                        java.io.InputStream in = new java.io.FileInputStream(temp);
                        java.io.OutputStream out =
                            new java.io.FileOutputStream(destination)
                    ) {
                        byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
                        int n;
                        while ((n = in.read(buffer)) != -1)
                            out.write(buffer, 0, n);
                    }
                    temp.delete();
                }
            }
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
public void fetchText(String address, String callbackId) {
    networkExecutor.execute(() -> {
        String result = null;
        String error = null;

        for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= 3; attempt++) {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                URL url = new URL(address);

                if (!"http".equalsIgnoreCase(url.getProtocol())
                        && !"https".equalsIgnoreCase(url.getProtocol())) {
                    throw new Exception("HTTP/HTTPS adresi gerekli.");
                }

                connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
                connection.setConnectTimeout(20000);
                connection.setReadTimeout(120000);
                connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
                connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
                connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "*/*");
                connection.setRequestProperty("Accept-Encoding", "identity");
                connection.setRequestProperty(
                    "User-Agent",
                    "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 11) AppleWebKit/537.36 "
                    + "(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Mobile Safari/537.36"
                );

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    throw new java.io.IOException("HTTP " + code);
                }

                StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();

                try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(
                        new InputStreamReader(
                            connection.getInputStream(),
                            StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {

                    String line;
                    while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                        output.append(line).append('\n');

                    if (output.length() > 64 * 1024 * 1024) {
                            throw new java.io.IOException("Kaynak 64 MB sınırını aştı.");
                        }
}
                }

                result = output.toString();
                error = null;
                break;

            } catch (Exception e) {
                error = e.getMessage();
                Log.w(TAG, "Kaynak indirme denemesi " + attempt + "/3", e);

                if (attempt < 3) {
                    try {
                        Thread.sleep(attempt * 1200L);
                    } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                        error = "İşlem iptal edildi.";
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        }

        final String response = result;
        final String failure = error;
        final String safeId = callbackId == null
                ? "0"
                : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");

        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (webView == null) return;

            String js = "window.__isaFetchDone("
                    + safeId + ","
                    + JSONObject.quote(response) + ","
                    + JSONObject.quote(failure) + ");";

            webView.evaluateJavascript(js, null);
        });
    });
}




        @JavascriptInterface
        public void fetchTextWithHeaders(String address, String headersJson, String callbackId) {
            networkExecutor.execute(() -> {
                String result = null;
                String error = null;
                HttpURLConnection connection = null;
                try {
                    URL url = new URL(address);
                    if (!"http".equalsIgnoreCase(url.getProtocol()) &&
                            !"https".equalsIgnoreCase(url.getProtocol())) {
                        throw new Exception("HTTP/HTTPS adresi gerekli.");
                    }
                    connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
                    connection.setConnectTimeout(20000);
                    connection.setReadTimeout(120000);
                    connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
                    connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
                    connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "*/*");
                    connection.setRequestProperty("Accept-Encoding", "identity");

                    JSONObject supplied = new JSONObject(headersJson == null ? "{}" : headersJson);
                    java.util.Iterator<String> keys = supplied.keys();
                    while (keys.hasNext()) {
                        String key = keys.next();
                        String value = supplied.optString(key, "");
                        if (key.matches("(?i)[a-z0-9-]+") &&
                                !key.matches("(?i)host|content-length|connection|transfer-encoding|accept-encoding") &&
                                !value.contains("\r") && !value.contains("\n")) {
                            connection.setRequestProperty(key, value);
                        }
                    }

                    int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                    if (code < 200 || code >= 300) throw new java.io.IOException("HTTP " + code);

                    StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();
                    try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(
                            new InputStreamReader(connection.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                        String line;
                        while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                            output.append(line).append('\n');
                            if (output.length() > 64 * 1024 * 1024) {
                                throw new Exception("Kaynak 64 MB sınırını aştı.");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    result = output.toString();
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    error = e.getMessage() == null ? "İstek başarısız." : e.getMessage();
                    Log.w(TAG, "Başlıklı kaynak isteği başarısız", e);
                } finally {
                    if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
                }

                final String response = result;
                final String failure = error;
                final String safeId = callbackId == null ? "0" : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (webView == null) return;
                    String callback = "window.__isaFetchDone(" + safeId + "," +
                            JSONObject.quote(response) + "," +
                            JSONObject.quote(failure) + ");";
                    webView.evaluateJavascript(callback, null);
                });
            });
        }

                @JavascriptInterface
        public void openPage(String address) {
            if (address == null || !(address.startsWith("https://") || address.startsWith("http://"))) return;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                try {
                    Intent browser = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(address));
                    MainActivity.this.startActivity(browser);
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "Kaynak sayfası açılamadı", e);
                }
            });
        }

@JavascriptInterface
        public void cachePut(String key, String value) {
            try {
                java.io.File directory = new java.io.File(
                        getFilesDir(),
                        "isa-source-cache"
                );

                if (!directory.exists()) {
                    directory.mkdirs();
                }

                String fileName = Integer.toHexString(
                        key == null ? 0 : key.hashCode()
                ) + ".cache";

                java.io.File file = new java.io.File(
                        directory,
                        fileName
                );

                try (java.io.FileOutputStream output =
                             new java.io.FileOutputStream(file, false)) {
                    output.write(
                            (value == null ? "" : value)
                                    .getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                    );
                    output.flush();
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                android.util.Log.e("ISATV", "Önbellek yazma hatası", e);
            }
        }

        @JavascriptInterface
        public void cacheGet(String key, String callbackId) {
            String result = null;
            String error = null;

            try {
                java.io.File directory = new java.io.File(
                        getFilesDir(),
                        "isa-source-cache"
                );

                java.io.File file = new java.io.File(
                        directory,
                        Integer.toHexString(
                                key == null ? 0 : key.hashCode()
                        ) + ".cache"
                );

                if (file.isFile()) {
                    StringBuilder content = new StringBuilder();

                    try (java.io.FileInputStream input =
                                 new java.io.FileInputStream(file)) {
                        byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                        int count;

                        while ((count = input.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                            content.append(
                                    new String(
                                            buffer,
                                            0,
                                            count,
                                            java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                                    )
                            );
                        }
                    }

                    result = content.toString();
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                error = e.getMessage();
            }

            final String finalResult = result;
            final String finalError = error;

            final String safeId = callbackId == null
                    ? "0"
                    : callbackId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (webView == null) return;

                String valueJson = finalResult == null
                        ? "null"
                        : org.json.JSONObject.quote(finalResult);

                String errorJson = finalError == null
                        ? "null"
                        : org.json.JSONObject.quote(finalError);

                webView.evaluateJavascript(
                        "window.__isaCacheDone(" +
                                safeId + "," +
                                valueJson + "," +
                                errorJson + ");",
                        null
                );
            });
        }

    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(
            int requestCode,
            int resultCode,
            Intent data) {

        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data);

        if (requestCode == FILE_REQUEST && fileCallback != null) {
            Uri[] result =
                    WebChromeClient.FileChooserParams.parseResult(
                            resultCode,
                            data
                    );

            fileCallback.onReceiveValue(result);
            fileCallback = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (webView != null) {
            webView.postDelayed(() -> {
                if (webView != null) {
                    webView.evaluateJavascript(
                        "if(window.homepage && typeof window.homepage.restoreLastPlayedChannel === 'function'){" +
                        "window.homepage.restoreLastPlayedChannel();}",
                        null
                    );
                }
            }, 250);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onBackPressed() {
        if (webView == null) {
            handleExitBack();
            return;
        }

        webView.evaluateJavascript(
                "(function(){return window.isaHandleBack ? window.isaHandleBack() : false;})()",
                value -> {
                    if ("true".equals(value)) {
                        backPressedAt = 0L;
                    } else {
                        handleExitBack();
                    }
                }
        );
    }

    private void handleExitBack() {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (now - backPressedAt < 2000L) {
            finish();
            return;
        }

        backPressedAt = now;
        Toast.makeText(
                this,
                "Çıkmak için geri tuşuna tekrar basın",
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
        ).show();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (fileCallback != null) {
            fileCallback.onReceiveValue(null);
            fileCallback = null;
        }

        networkExecutor.shutdownNow();

        if (webView != null) {
            webView.destroy();
            webView = null;
        }

        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

    private void loadQueue(String fallbackUrl) {
        String path = getIntent().getStringExtra("queue_file");
        boolean loaded = false;

        if (path != null) {
            try (java.io.FileInputStream input =
                         new java.io.FileInputStream(path);
                 java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream bytes =
                         new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()) {

                byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                int count;
                while ((count = input.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                    bytes.write(buffer, 0, count);
                }

                JSONArray array = new JSONArray(bytes.toString("UTF-8"));
                for (int i = 0; i < array.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject item = array.optJSONObject(i);
                    if (item == null) continue;

                    String itemUrl = item.optString("url", "");
                    if (itemUrl.matches("(?i)^https?://.*")) {
                        queue.add(item);
                    }
                }
                loaded = !queue.isEmpty();

            } catch (Exception e) {
                android.util.Log.e("ISAFLIX", "Kuyruk okunamadı", e);
            }
        }

        if (!loaded) {
            JSONObject one = new JSONObject();
            try {
                one.put("name", getIntent().getStringExtra("channel_name"));
                one.put("url", fallbackUrl);
                one.put("headers", new JSONObject(
                        getIntent().getStringExtra("headers_json") == null
                                ? "{}"
                                : getIntent().getStringExtra("headers_json")
                ));
                one.put("is_live", false);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            queue.add(one);
        }
    }

    private boolean isDirectMediaUrl(String value) {
        if (value == null) return false;
        String lower = value.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
        try {
            String path = Uri.parse(value).getPath();
            if (path != null && path.matches(
                    "(?i).*\\.(m3u8|mpd|mp4|m4v|webm|mkv|mov|3gp)$")) {
                return true;
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return lower.contains("format=m3u8")
                || lower.contains("type=hls")
                || lower.contains("format=mpd")
                || lower.contains("type=dash");
    }

    private void startWebsitePlayback(String pageUrl) {
        websitePlaybackMode = true;
        websiteMediaAccepted = false;
        resolvingCancelled = false;
        websitePageUrl = pageUrl;

        int selected = getIntent().getIntExtra("selected_index", 0);
        if (selected < 0 || selected >= queue.size()) selected = 0;
        JSONObject chosen = queue.isEmpty() ? new JSONObject() : queue.get(selected);
        queue.clear();
        queue.add(chosen);

        playerView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        loadingLabel.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        status.setVisibility(View.GONE);

        webView = new WebView(this);
        webView.setAlpha(0f);
        webView.setBackgroundColor(Color.BLACK);
        webView.setImportantForAccessibility(
                View.IMPORTANT_FOR_ACCESSIBILITY_NO);
        WebSettings settings = webView.getSettings();
        settings.setJavaScriptEnabled(true);
        settings.setDomStorageEnabled(true);
        settings.setDatabaseEnabled(true);
        settings.setMediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture(false);
        settings.setSupportMultipleWindows(false);
        settings.setJavaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically(false);
        settings.setAllowFileAccess(false);
        settings.setAllowContentAccess(false);
        settings.setMixedContentMode(WebSettings.MIXED_CONTENT_NEVER_ALLOW);

        CookieManager cookies = CookieManager.getInstance();
        cookies.setAcceptCookie(true);
        cookies.setAcceptThirdPartyCookies(webView, true);

        webView.addJavascriptInterface(new WebsiteBridge(), "ISAWebsiteBridge");

        final String initialHost;
        try {
            initialHost = Uri.parse(pageUrl).getHost();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            status.setText("İçerik şu anda oynatılamıyor.");
            status.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            return;
        }

        webView.setWebChromeClient(new WebChromeClient() {
            @Override
            public boolean onCreateWindow(
                    WebView view, boolean dialog, boolean userGesture,
                    android.os.Message resultMsg) {
                // Popup pencereleri ana WebView dışında açılmaz.
                return false;
            }
        });

        webView.setWebViewClient(new WebViewClient() {
            @Override
            public boolean shouldOverrideUrlLoading(
                    WebView view, String url) {
                try {
                    Uri target = Uri.parse(url);
                    if (!"http".equalsIgnoreCase(target.getScheme())
                            && !"https".equalsIgnoreCase(target.getScheme())) {
                        return true;
                    }
                    String host = target.getHost();
                    // Ana sayfadan farklı alana giden üst-seviye reklam
                    // yönlendirmelerini engelle.
                    return host == null || !host.equalsIgnoreCase(initialHost);
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            @Override
            public void onPageFinished(WebView view, String url) {
                super.onPageFinished(view, url);
                installWebsiteDetector();
            }
        });

        FrameLayout.LayoutParams params = new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT);
        root.addView(webView, 0, params);
        webView.loadUrl(pageUrl);
    }

    private void installWebsiteDetector() {
        if (webView == null) return;

        String script =
            "(function(){" +
            "if(window.__isaDetectorInstalled)return;" +
            "window.__isaDetectorInstalled=true;" +
            "var host=location.hostname;" +
            "window.open=function(){return null;};" +
            "document.addEventListener('click',function(e){" +
            "var a=e.target&&e.target.closest?e.target.closest('a[target=_blank]'):null;" +
            "if(!a)return;" +
            "e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();" +
            "},true);" +
            "setInterval(function(){" +
            "try{" +
            "var vids=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('video'));" +
            "for(var i=0;i<vids.length;i++){" +
            "var v=vids[i];" +
            "if(v.paused||v.currentTime<1||v.readyState<2)continue;" +
            "if(!isFinite(v.duration)||v.duration<180)continue;" +
            "var drm=!!v.mediaKeys||v.dataset.isaEncrypted==='1';" +
            "var urls=[];" +
            "if(v.currentSrc&&/^https?:/i.test(v.currentSrc))urls.push(v.currentSrc);" +
            "if(v.src&&/^https?:/i.test(v.src))urls.push(v.src);" +
            "Array.from(v.querySelectorAll('source[src]')).forEach(function(x){" +
            "if(/^https?:/i.test(x.src))urls.push(x.src);});" +
            "performance.getEntriesByType('resource').forEach(function(x){" +
            "if(/\\.(m3u8|mpd|mp4|webm)(\\?|$)/i.test(x.name))urls.push(x.name);});" +
            "var u=urls.find(function(x){return /^https?:/i.test(x)&&" +
            "/\\.(m3u8|mpd|mp4|webm)(\\?|$)/i.test(x);});" +
            "if(u&&window.ISAWebsiteBridge){" +
            "window.ISAWebsiteBridge.onMediaFound(u,drm);return;}" +
            "}" +
            "}catch(e){}" +
            "},1200);" +
            "document.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(function(v){" +
            "v.addEventListener('encrypted',function(){v.dataset.isaEncrypted='1';});" +
            "});" +
            "})();";

        webView.evaluateJavascript(script, null);
    }

    private class WebsiteBridge {
        @JavascriptInterface
        public void onMediaFound(String mediaUrl, boolean encrypted) {
            runOnUiThread(() -> acceptWebsiteMedia(mediaUrl, encrypted));
        }
    }

    private void acceptWebsiteMedia(String mediaUrl, boolean encrypted) {
        if (resolvingCancelled || websiteMediaAccepted || !websitePlaybackMode) return;

        if (encrypted) {
            // DRM içeriği sitenin kendi WebView oynatıcısında kalır.
            android.util.Log.i("ISAFLIX", "DRM algılandı; WebView oynatması korunuyor.");
            return;
        }

        if (!isDirectMediaUrl(mediaUrl)) return;

        websiteMediaAccepted = true;
        try {
            JSONObject item = queue.get(0);
            item.put("url", mediaUrl);

            JSONObject headers = item.optJSONObject("headers");
            if (headers == null) headers = new JSONObject();
            headers.put("Referer", websitePageUrl);

            String cookie = CookieManager.getInstance().getCookie(websitePageUrl);
            if (cookie != null && !cookie.isEmpty()) {
                headers.put("Cookie", cookie);
            }
            item.put("headers", headers);

            if (webView != null) {
                webView.stopLoading();
                root.removeView(webView);
                webView.destroy();
                webView = null;
            }

            websitePlaybackMode = false;
            loadingLabel.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            playerView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            initializePlayer();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            websiteMediaAccepted = false;
            android.util.Log.e("ISAFLIX", "Medya aktarımı başarısız", e);
        }
    }

    private MediaSource createMediaSource(JSONObject entry) {
        String url = entry.optString("url", "");
        JSONObject jsonHeaders = entry.optJSONObject("headers");

        Map<String, String> headers = new HashMap<>();
        String userAgent =
                "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 11) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/120 Safari/537.36";

        if (jsonHeaders != null) {
            Iterator<String> keys = jsonHeaders.keys();
            while (keys.hasNext()) {
                String key = keys.next();
                String value = jsonHeaders.optString(key, "");

                if (!key.matches("(?i)[a-z0-9-]+")
                        || key.matches("(?i)host|content-length|connection|transfer-encoding|accept-encoding")
                        || value.isEmpty()
                        || value.contains("\r")
                        || value.contains("\n")) {
                    continue;
                }

                if (key.equalsIgnoreCase("User-Agent")) {
                    userAgent = value;
                } else {
                    headers.put(key, value);
                }
            }
        }

        DefaultHttpDataSource.Factory factory =
                new DefaultHttpDataSource.Factory()
                        .setUserAgent(userAgent)
                        .setConnectTimeoutMs(20000)
                        .setReadTimeoutMs(60000)
                        .setAllowCrossProtocolRedirects(true)
                        .setDefaultRequestProperties(headers);

        MediaItem mediaItem = new MediaItem.Builder()
                .setUri(Uri.parse(url))
                .setMediaId(entry.optString("name", url))
                .build();

        String path = Uri.parse(url).getPath();
        path = path == null ? "" : path.toLowerCase();
        String lowerUrl = url.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
        boolean isHls = path.endsWith(".m3u8")
                || lowerUrl.matches("(?s).*\\.m3u8(?:[?#].*)?$")
                || lowerUrl.contains("format=m3u8")
                || lowerUrl.contains("type=hls");
        boolean isDash = path.endsWith(".mpd")
                || lowerUrl.matches("(?s).*\\.mpd(?:[?#].*)?$")
                || lowerUrl.contains("format=mpd")
                || lowerUrl.contains("type=dash");

        if (isHls) {
            return new HlsMediaSource.Factory(factory)
                    .setAllowChunklessPreparation(true)
                    .createMediaSource(mediaItem);
        }

        if (isDash) {
            return new DashMediaSource.Factory(factory)
                    .createMediaSource(mediaItem);
        }

        return new DefaultMediaSourceFactory(factory)
                .createMediaSource(mediaItem);
    }

    private void initializePlayer() {
        try {
            ArrayList<MediaSource> sources = new ArrayList<>();

            for (JSONObject item : queue) {
                sources.add(createMediaSource(item));
            }

            if (sources.isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Oynatma listesi boş.");
            }

            int index = getIntent().getIntExtra("selected_index", 0);
            if (index < 0 || index >= sources.size()) index = 0;

            player = new ExoPlayer.Builder(this).build();
            playerView.setPlayer(player);

            player.addListener(new Player.Listener() {
                @Override
                public void onPlaybackStateChanged(int state) {
                    if (state == Player.STATE_READY) {
                        loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        status.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        playerView.showController();
                    } else if (state == Player.STATE_BUFFERING) {
                        status.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    } else if (state == Player.STATE_ENDED) {
                        loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        status.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    }
                }

                @Override
                public void onMediaItemTransition(
                        MediaItem mediaItem, int reason) {
                    updateTitle();
                    updateFavoriteButton();
                }

                @Override
                public void onPlayerError(PlaybackException error) {
                    loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    status.setText("İçerik şu anda oynatılamıyor.");
                    status.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    android.util.Log.e(
                            "ISAFLIX", "Oynatma hatası", error
                    );
                }
            });

            MediaSource[] array = sources.toArray(new MediaSource[0]);
            ConcatenatingMediaSource playlist =
                    new ConcatenatingMediaSource(array);

            player.setMediaSource(playlist);
            player.seekTo(index, 0L);
            player.prepare();
            player.play();
            updateTitle();
            updateFavoriteButton();

        } catch (Exception e) {
            android.util.Log.e("ISAFLIX", "Oynatıcı başlatılamadı", e);
            if (loadingSpinner != null) loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            status.setText("İçerik şu anda oynatılamıyor.");
            status.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
    }


    private void updateTitle() {
        if (player == null || queue.isEmpty()) return;

        int index = player.getCurrentMediaItemIndex();
        if (index < 0 || index >= queue.size()) index = 0;

        JSONObject item = queue.get(index);
        String name = item.optString(
                "name",
                getIntent().getStringExtra("channel_name")
        );

        titleView.setText(name == null ? "İSAFLIX" : name);

        int season = item.optInt("season", 0);
        int episode = item.optInt("episode", 0);

        infoHandler.removeCallbacks(hideEpisodeInfo);

        if (season > 0 || episode > 0) {
            episodeView.animate().cancel();
            episodeView.setAlpha(1f);

            String episodeInfo;
            if (season > 0 && episode > 0) {
                episodeInfo = "Sezon " + season + "  ·  " + episode + ". Bölüm";
            } else if (season > 0) {
                episodeInfo = "Sezon " + season;
            } else {
                episodeInfo = episode + ". Bölüm";
            }

            episodeView.setText(episodeInfo);

            boolean landscape =
                    getResources().getConfiguration().orientation
                    == Configuration.ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE;

            episodeView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);

            if (landscape) {
                infoHandler.postDelayed(hideEpisodeInfo, 5000L);
            }
        } else {
            episodeView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }

    private String currentFavoriteId(JSONObject item) {
        boolean series = item.optBoolean("is_series", false)
                || "series".equalsIgnoreCase(item.optString("type", ""))
                || item.optInt("season", 0) > 0;

        String parentId = item.optString("series_id",
                item.optString("parent_id", ""));
        if (series) {
            String parentName = item.optString("series_name",
                    item.optString("name", "İSAFLIX dizisi"));
            return "series:" + (parentId.isEmpty() ? parentName : parentId);
        }

        String id = item.optString("id", "");
        return "movie:" + (id.isEmpty()
                ? item.optString("url", "") : id);
    }

    private void updateFavoriteButton() {
        if (favoriteButton == null || queue.isEmpty()) return;

        int index = player == null ? 0 : player.getCurrentMediaItemIndex();
        if (index < 0 || index >= queue.size()) index = 0;

        JSONObject item = queue.get(index);
        String favoriteId = currentFavoriteId(item);
        android.content.SharedPreferences prefs =
                getSharedPreferences("isa_tv_data", MODE_PRIVATE);

        boolean saved = false;
        try {
            JSONArray favorites = new JSONArray(
                    prefs.getString("isaflix_favorites", "[]"));
            for (int i = 0; i < favorites.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject favorite = favorites.optJSONObject(i);
                if (favorite != null
                        && favoriteId.equals(favorite.optString("favorite_id", ""))) {
                    saved = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            android.util.Log.e("ISAFLIX", "Favoriler okunamadı", e);
        }

        favoriteButton.setText(saved ? "♥" : "♡");
        favoriteButton.setTextColor(saved ? 0xFFFF3B55 : Color.WHITE);
        favoriteButton.setContentDescription(
                saved ? "Favorilerden çıkar" : "Favorilere ekle");
    }

    private void toggleCurrentFavorite() {
        if (queue.isEmpty()) return;

        int index = player == null ? 0 : player.getCurrentMediaItemIndex();
        if (index < 0 || index >= queue.size()) index = 0;

        JSONObject item = queue.get(index);
        String favoriteId = currentFavoriteId(item);
        boolean series = favoriteId.startsWith("series:");

        android.content.SharedPreferences prefs =
                getSharedPreferences("isa_tv_data", MODE_PRIVATE);

        try {
            JSONArray old = new JSONArray(
                    prefs.getString("isaflix_favorites", "[]"));
            JSONArray updated = new JSONArray();
            boolean existed = false;

            for (int i = 0; i < old.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject favorite = old.optJSONObject(i);
                if (favorite == null) continue;

                if (favoriteId.equals(favorite.optString("favorite_id", ""))) {
                    existed = true;
                } else {
                    updated.put(favorite);
                }
            }

            if (!existed) {
                JSONObject record = new JSONObject();
                record.put("favorite_id", favoriteId);
                record.put("name", series
                        ? item.optString("series_name",
                            item.optString("name", "İSAFLIX dizisi"))
                        : item.optString("name", "İSAFLIX filmi"));
                record.put("url", series
                        ? item.optString("series_url",
                            item.optString("url", ""))
                        : item.optString("url", ""));
                record.put("logo", item.optString("logo",
                        item.optString("poster", "")));
                record.put("type", series ? "series" : "movie");
                record.put("is_series", series);
                if (series) {
                    record.put("series_id",
                            item.optString("series_id",
                                item.optString("parent_id", "")));
                }
                updated.put(record);
            }

            prefs.edit().putString("isaflix_favorites",
                    updated.toString()).apply();
            updateFavoriteButton();

        } catch (Exception e) {
            android.util.Log.e("ISAFLIX", "Favori kaydedilemedi", e);
        }
    }

    private void createTvLogo() {
        Configuration c = getResources().getConfiguration();

        boolean landscape =
                c.orientation == Configuration.ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE;
        boolean television =
                (c.uiMode & Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_MASK)
                        == Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_TELEVISION;
        boolean tablet = c.smallestScreenWidthDp >= 600;

        if (!landscape || (!television && !tablet)) return;

        try {
            logo = new ImageView(this);

            try (java.io.InputStream input =
                         getAssets().open("isa-tv-hd/assets/logo.png")) {
                logo.setImageBitmap(BitmapFactory.decodeStream(input));
            }

            logo.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.FIT_CENTER);
            logo.setPadding(dp(5), dp(5), dp(5), dp(5));
            logo.setBackgroundColor(0x880F0F0F);
            logo.setContentDescription("İSA TV HD");

            FrameLayout.LayoutParams params =
                    new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                            dp(145),
                            dp(90),
                            Gravity.TOP | Gravity.RIGHT
                    );
            params.setMargins(0, dp(16), dp(22), 0);
            root.addView(logo, params);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            android.util.Log.e("ISAFLIX", "Logo yüklenemedi", e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        if (event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN
                && event.getRepeatCount() == 0
                && player != null) {

            int key = event.getKeyCode();

            if (key == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP
                    || key == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_CHANNEL_UP
                    || key == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_PAGE_UP) {
                if (player.hasNextMediaItem()) {
                    player.seekToNextMediaItem();
                }
                return true;
            }

            if (key == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN
                    || key == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_CHANNEL_DOWN
                    || key == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_PAGE_DOWN) {
                if (player.hasPreviousMediaItem()) {
                    player.seekToPreviousMediaItem();
                }
                return true;
            }
        }

        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    private int dp(float value) {
        return (int)(
                value * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density + 0.5f
        );
    }

    private void applyImmersiveMode() {
        getWindow().getDecorView().setSystemUiVisibility(
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
                | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN
                | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION
                | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN
                | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION
                | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE
        );
    }

    @Override
    public void onWindowFocusChanged(boolean hasFocus) {
        super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus);
        if (hasFocus) applyImmersiveMode();
    }

    @Override
    public void onBackPressed() {
        resolvingCancelled = true;
        websitePlaybackMode = false;
        websiteMediaAccepted = true;
        if (webView != null) {
            webView.stopLoading();
            webView.onPause();
        }
        finish();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onPause() {
        if (player != null) player.pause();
        if (webView != null) webView.onPause();
        super.onPause();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        infoHandler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);
        if (playerView != null) playerView.setPlayer(null);
        if (player != null) {
            player.release();
            player = null;
        }
        resolvingCancelled = true;
        websitePlaybackMode = false;
        if (webView != null) {
            webView.stopLoading();
            webView.destroy();
            webView = null;
        }
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

    <script>
        // Simple sidebar logic for about page
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const menuToggle = document.getElementById('home-menu-toggle');
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('home-sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('home-sidebar-overlay');
            const closeBtn = document.getElementById('home-sidebar-close');

            function toggleSidebar(show) {
                if (show) {
                    sidebar.classList.add('open');
                    overlay.classList.add('visible');
                    document.body.classList.add('home-sidebar-open');
                } else {
                    sidebar.classList.remove('open');
                    overlay.classList.remove('visible');
                    document.body.classList.remove('home-sidebar-open');
                }
            }

            if (menuToggle) menuToggle.addEventListener('click', () => toggleSidebar(true));
            if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => toggleSidebar(false));
            if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', () => toggleSidebar(false));
        });
    </script>
