                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
        ));

        // Ekrana dokunulduğunda yalnızca kanal listesi açılır.
        // Media3 oynatma kontrolleri devre dışıdır.
        View channelTapLayer = new View(this);
        channelTapLayer.setBackgroundColor(Color.TRANSPARENT);
        channelTapLayer.setOnTouchListener(new View.OnTouchListener() {
            private float startX;
            private float startY;
            private boolean dragging;
            private boolean horizontalDrag;
            private boolean ignoreHorizontal;

            @Override
            public boolean onTouch(View v, android.view.MotionEvent event) {
                boolean portrait =
                        getResources().getConfiguration().orientation
                        == Configuration.ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT;

                switch (event.getAction()) {
                    case android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                        startX = event.getX();
                        startY = event.getY();
                        dragging = false;
                        horizontalDrag = false;
                        ignoreHorizontal = false;
                        return true;

                    case android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE:
                        if (channelTransitioning) return true;

                        float dx = event.getX() - startX;
                        float dy = event.getY() - startY;

                        if (Math.abs(dx) > dp(10) && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
                            dragging = true;
                            horizontalDrag = true;
                            float width = Math.max(1, playerView.getWidth());
                            float offset = Math.max(-width, Math.min(width, dx));
                            playerView.setTranslationX(offset);
                            if (portraitPanel != null) portraitPanel.setTranslationX(offset);
                        } else if (Math.abs(dy) > dp(8) && Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) {
                            dragging = true;
                            horizontalDrag = false;
                            float height = Math.max(playerView.getHeight(), getResources().getDisplayMetrics().heightPixels);
                            float offset = Math.max(-height, Math.min(height, dy));
                            playerView.setTranslationY(offset);
                            if (portraitPanel != null) portraitPanel.setTranslationY(offset);
                        }
                        if (dragging) {
                            handler.removeCallbacks(hideChannelButton);
                            channelButton.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        }
                        return true;

                    case android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:

                        float moveY = event.getY() - startY;
                        float moveX = event.getX() - startX;

                        if (dragging) {
                            if (horizontalDrag) {
                                float threshold = Math.max(dp(70), playerView.getWidth() * 0.18f);
                                if (Math.abs(moveX) >= threshold) finishChannelSwipe(moveX < 0 ? 1 : -1, true);
                                else animateViewsBack(true);
                            } else {
                                float threshold = Math.max(dp(90), playerView.getHeight() * 0.22f);
                                if (Math.abs(moveY) >= threshold) finishChannelSwipe(moveY < 0 ? 1 : -1, false);
                                else animateViewsBack(false);
                            }
                        } else if (Math.abs(moveX) < dp(30) &&
                                   Math.abs(moveY) < dp(30)) {
                            // Dokunma ile kanal listesi açılmaz.
                            // Kanal değiştirme kaydırma hareketi korunur.
                            channelButton.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        }

                        dragging = false;
                        horizontalDrag = false;
                        return true;

                    case android.view.MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                        if (dragging) animateViewsBack(horizontalDrag);
                        dragging = false;
                        horizontalDrag = false;
                        return true;
                }
                return true;
            }
        });

        root.addView(channelTapLayer, new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
        ));

        status = new TextView(this);
        status.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        status.setTextSize(15);
        status.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);

        status.setVisibility(View.GONE);

        root.addView(status, new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(

        ));

        loadingSpinner = new android.widget.ProgressBar(

        root.addView(loadingSpinner, spinnerParams);

        channelButton = new Button(this);
        channelButton.setText("KANAL LİSTESİ");
        channelButton.setTextSize(12);
        channelButton.setAllCaps(false);

        channelButton.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        channelButton.setPadding(dp(18), dp(8), dp(18), dp(8));

        android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable buttonBackground =

        buttonBackground.setColor(0xCC18263A);

        channelButton.setBackground(buttonBackground);

        channelButton.setOnClickListener(v -> showChannelList());
        channelButton.setVisibility(View.GONE);

                        -2, dp(46),

    private void initializePlayer() {
        player = createManagedPlayer(false);
        playerView.setPlayer(player);
    }


    private ExoPlayer createManagedPlayer(boolean preload) {
        DefaultLoadControl loadControl =
                new DefaultLoadControl.Builder()
                        .setBufferDurationsMs(
                                15000,
                                60000,
                                1000,
                                3000
                        )
                        .setPrioritizeTimeOverSizeThresholds(true)
                        .build();

        ExoPlayer p = new ExoPlayer.Builder(this)
                .setLoadControl(loadControl)
                .build();

        p.setVolume(preload ? 0f : 1f);

        p.setTrackSelectionParameters(
                p.getTrackSelectionParameters()
                        .buildUpon()
                        .setMaxVideoBitrate(
                                preload ? 1500000 : Integer.MAX_VALUE
                        )
                        .build()
        );

        Handler retryHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
        final int[] retryCount = {0};

        Runnable[] retryTask = new Runnable[1];

        retryTask[0] = () -> {
            if (p != player || p.isReleased()) return;

            if (retryCount[0] >= 5) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Canlı yayın yeniden bağlanma denemeleri tükendi.");
                return;
            }

            retryCount[0]++;
            Log.w(TAG, "Yayın yeniden hazırlanıyor. Deneme: "
                    + retryCount[0]);

            p.prepare();
            p.play();
        };

        p.addListener(new Player.Listener() {
            @Override
            public void onPlaybackStateChanged(int state) {
                if (p != player) return;

                if (state == Player.STATE_READY) {
                    retryCount[0] = 0;
                    retryHandler.removeCallbacks(retryTask[0]);
                    status.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.GONE);

                } else if (state == Player.STATE_BUFFERING) {
                    loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);

                } else if (state == Player.STATE_IDLE) {
                    loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.GONE);

                } else if (state == Player.STATE_ENDED) {
                    MediaItem current = p.getCurrentMediaItem();

                    if (current != null
                            && current.localConfiguration != null) {
                        String uri = current.localConfiguration.uri
                                .toString().toLowerCase();

                        if (uri.contains(".m3u8")) {
                            retryHandler.removeCallbacks(retryTask[0]);
                            retryHandler.postDelayed(retryTask[0], 1500);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            @Override
            public void onPlayerError(PlaybackException error) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Oynatıcı hatası: "
                        + error.getErrorCodeName(), error);

                if (p == player) {
                    status.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);

                    retryHandler.removeCallbacks(retryTask[0]);

                    long delay = Math.min(
                            1500L * (retryCount[0] + 1),
                            10000L
                    );

                    retryHandler.postDelayed(retryTask[0], delay);
                }
            }
        });

        return p;
    }

    private void prepareChannel(ExoPlayer target, int index,
                                boolean preload) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= channels.size()) return;

        Channel channel = channels.get(index);

        try {
            DefaultHttpDataSource.Factory factory =
                    new DefaultHttpDataSource.Factory()
                            .setUserAgent(
                                    channel.headers.containsKey("User-Agent")
                                    ? channel.headers.get("User-Agent")
                                    : "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 11) "
                                    + "AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/120 Safari/537.36"
                            )
                            .setConnectTimeoutMs(20000)
                            .setReadTimeoutMs(60000)
                            .setAllowCrossProtocolRedirects(true)
                            .setDefaultRequestProperties(channel.headers);

            String url = channel.url;
            String lowerUrl = url.toLowerCase();
            boolean isHls = lowerUrl.contains(".m3u8");

            MediaItem.Builder itemBuilder = new MediaItem.Builder()
                    .setUri(Uri.parse(url))
                    .setMediaId(channel.name == null
                            ? url : channel.name);

            if (isHls) {
                itemBuilder.setLiveConfiguration(
                        new MediaItem.LiveConfiguration.Builder()
                                .setTargetOffsetMs(15000)
                                .setMinPlaybackSpeed(0.97f)
                                .setMaxPlaybackSpeed(1.03f)
                                .build()
                );
            }

            MediaItem item = itemBuilder.build();

            target.stop();
            target.clearMediaItems();

            target.setVolume(preload ? 0f : 1f);

            target.setTrackSelectionParameters(
                    target.getTrackSelectionParameters()
                            .buildUpon()
                            .setMaxVideoBitrate(
                                    preload ? 1500000 : Integer.MAX_VALUE
                            )
                            .build()
            );

            androidx.media3.exoplayer.source.MediaSource mediaSource;

            if (isHls) {
                mediaSource = new HlsMediaSource.Factory(factory)
                        .setAllowChunklessPreparation(true)
                        .createMediaSource(item);
            } else {
                mediaSource =
                        new androidx.media3.exoplayer.source.DefaultMediaSourceFactory(
                                factory
                        ).createMediaSource(item);
            }

            target.setMediaSource(mediaSource);
            target.prepare();
            target.setPlayWhenReady(!preload);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Kanal hazırlanamadı: " + index, e);
        }
    }

    

    private ExoPlayer obtainStandbyPlayer() {
        if (!standbyPlayers.isEmpty()) {
            return standbyPlayers.remove(standbyPlayers.size() - 1);
        }

        return createManagedPlayer(true);
    }

    private void recyclePlayer(ExoPlayer p) {
        if (p == null || p == player) return;

        p.setPlayWhenReady(false);
        p.stop();
        p.clearMediaItems();
        p.setVolume(0f);

        if (!standbyPlayers.contains(p) && standbyPlayers.size() < 2) {
            standbyPlayers.add(p);
        } else if (!standbyPlayers.contains(p)) {
            p.release();
        }
    }

    private void prepareNeighborChannels() {
        if (channels.size() < 2 || player == null) return;

        int previous = (selectedIndex - 1 + channels.size())
                % channels.size();

        int next = (selectedIndex + 1) % channels.size();

        java.util.HashSet<Integer> wanted = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        wanted.add(previous);
        wanted.add(next);
        wanted.remove(selectedIndex);

        java.util.Iterator<Map.Entry<Integer, ExoPlayer>> iterator =
                preloadedPlayers.entrySet().iterator();

        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
            Map.Entry<Integer, ExoPlayer> entry = iterator.next();

            if (!wanted.contains(entry.getKey())) {
                ExoPlayer old = entry.getValue();
                iterator.remove();
                recyclePlayer(old);
            }
        }

        for (Integer index : wanted) {
            if (!preloadedPlayers.containsKey(index)) {
                ExoPlayer standby = obtainStandbyPlayer();

                preloadedPlayers.put(index, standby);
                prepareChannel(standby, index, true);
            }
        }
    }


    private void animateViewsBack(boolean horizontal) {
        if (playerView == null) return;

        playerView.animate().cancel();
        playerView.animate()
                .translationX(horizontal ? 0f : playerView.getTranslationX())
                .translationY(horizontal ? playerView.getTranslationY() : 0f)
                .setDuration(180)
                .start();

        if (portraitPanel != null) {
            portraitPanel.animate().cancel();
            portraitPanel.animate()
                    .translationX(horizontal ? 0f : portraitPanel.getTranslationX())
                    .translationY(horizontal ? portraitPanel.getTranslationY() : 0f)
                    .setDuration(180)
                    .start();
        }
    }

    private void finishChannelSwipe(int direction) {
        finishChannelSwipe(direction, false);
    }

    private void finishChannelSwipe(int direction, boolean horizontal) {
        if (channels.isEmpty() || channelTransitioning ||
                playerView == null) return;

        channelTransitioning = true;

        final int distance = horizontal ? Math.max(1, playerView.getWidth()) : Math.max(
                playerView.getHeight(), getResources().getDisplayMetrics().heightPixels);
        final float exit = direction > 0 ? -distance : distance;
        final float enter = -exit;

        playerView.animate().cancel();

        if (portraitPanel != null) {
            portraitPanel.animate().cancel();
        }

        playerView.animate()
                .translationX(horizontal ? exit : 0f)
                .translationY(horizontal ? 0f : exit)
                .setDuration(150)
                .withEndAction(() -> {
                    selectedIndex += direction;

                    if (selectedIndex >= channels.size()) selectedIndex = 0;
                    if (selectedIndex < 0) selectedIndex = channels.size() - 1;

                    playSelected();

                    playerView.setTranslationX(horizontal ? enter : 0f);
                    playerView.setTranslationY(horizontal ? 0f : enter);

                    if (portraitPanel != null) {
                        portraitPanel.setTranslationX(horizontal ? enter : 0f);
                        portraitPanel.setTranslationY(horizontal ? 0f : enter);
                    }

                    playerView.animate()
                            .translationX(0f)
                            .translationY(0f)
                            .setDuration(220)
                            .withEndAction(() -> {
                                channelTransitioning = false;
                            })
                            .start();

                    if (portraitPanel != null) {
                        portraitPanel.animate()
                                .translationX(0f)
                                .translationY(0f)
                                .setDuration(220)
                                .start();
                    }
                })
                .start();

        if (portraitPanel != null) {
            portraitPanel.animate()
                    .translationX(horizontal ? exit : 0f)
                    .translationY(horizontal ? 0f : exit)
                    .setDuration(150)
                    .start();
        }
    }

    
    private void playSelected() {
        if (player == null || selectedIndex < 0 ||
                selectedIndex >= channels.size()) return;

        Channel channel = channels.get(selectedIndex);

        updatePortraitOverlay();

        if (loadingSpinner != null) {
            loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        if (status != null) {
            status.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        ExoPlayer oldActive = player;
        ExoPlayer readyPlayer = preloadedPlayers.remove(selectedIndex);

        try {
            if (readyPlayer != null) {
                // Hazırlanmış komşu oynatıcıyı aktif hale getir.
                player = readyPlayer;
                playerView.setPlayer(player);

                player.setVolume(1f);
                player.setTrackSelectionParameters(
                        player.getTrackSelectionParameters()
                                .buildUpon()
                                .setMaxVideoBitrate(Integer.MAX_VALUE)
                                .build()
                );

                player.setPlayWhenReady(true);

                recyclePlayer(oldActive);

            } else {
                // Hazır değilse mevcut aktif oynatıcıyla aç.
                prepareChannel(player, selectedIndex, false);
            }

            setTitle(channel.name);
            status.setVisibility(View.GONE);

            // Önceden hazırlanmış oynatıcı READY olmuş olabilir.
            int activeState = player.getPlaybackState();

            if (activeState == Player.STATE_READY) {
                loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            } else if (activeState == Player.STATE_BUFFERING ||
                       activeState == Player.STATE_IDLE) {
                loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            }

            applyPreloadPolicy();

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Kanal başlatılamadı", e);
            loadingSpinner.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }



    


private boolean isPortraitMode() {
    return getResources().getConfiguration().orientation
            == Configuration.ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT;
}

private boolean isTelevisionDevice() {
    int type = getResources().getConfiguration().uiMode
            & Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_MASK;

    return type == Configuration.UI_MODE_TYPE_TELEVISION
            || getPackageManager().hasSystemFeature(
                    android.content.pm.PackageManager.FEATURE_LEANBACK
            );
}

private boolean isPhoneDevice() {
    if (isTelevisionDevice()) return false;

    int smallestWidth =
            getResources().getConfiguration().smallestScreenWidthDp;

    if (smallestWidth > 0) {
        return smallestWidth < 600;
    }

    float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
    float widthDp =
            getResources().getDisplayMetrics().widthPixels / density;

    return widthDp < 600;
}

private void stopNeighborPreloads() {
    Iterator<Map.Entry<Integer, ExoPlayer>> iterator =
            preloadedPlayers.entrySet().iterator();

    while (iterator.hasNext()) {
        ExoPlayer standby = iterator.next().getValue();
        iterator.remove();
        recyclePlayer(standby);
    }
}


    // Komşu yayınları aç ve altı saniyelik sayaç başlat.
    private void startNeighborPreloadsWithTimeout() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(neighborPreloadTimeout);

        neighborPreloadUnlocked = true;

        if (portraitWarning != null) {
            portraitWarning.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        if (player != null && channels.size() >= 2) {
            prepareNeighborChannels();
        } else {
            stopNeighborPreloads();
        }

        handler.postDelayed(neighborPreloadTimeout, 6000L);
    }

private void applyPreloadPolicy() {
        startNeighborPreloadsWithTimeout();
    }

private boolean isCurrentChannelFavorite() {
    if (selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= channels.size()) return false;

    String url = channels.get(selectedIndex).url;
    try {
        JSONArray favorites = new JSONArray(
                getSharedPreferences("isa_tv_data", MODE_PRIVATE)
                        .getString("favorites", "[]"));

        for (int i = 0; i < favorites.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject item = favorites.optJSONObject(i);
            if (item != null && url.equals(item.optString("url", ""))) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    } catch (Exception e) {
        Log.e(TAG, "Favoriler okunamadı", e);
    }
    return false;
}

private void updatePortraitOverlay() {
    if (portraitChannelName == null || favoriteButton == null) return;

    boolean portrait = isPortraitMode();
    if (portraitPanel != null) portraitPanel.setVisibility(portrait ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);

    portraitChannelName.setVisibility(portrait ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
    boolean liveItem = selectedIndex >= 0 && selectedIndex < channels.size()
            && channels.get(selectedIndex).isLive;
    portraitLiveBadge.setVisibility(portrait && liveItem ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
    if (portraitEpisodeInfo != null) portraitEpisodeInfo.setVisibility(portrait ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
    favoriteButton.setVisibility(portrait ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);

    if (!portrait) return;

    if (selectedIndex >= 0 && selectedIndex < channels.size()) {
        Channel channel = channels.get(selectedIndex);
        portraitChannelName.setText(
                channel.name == null ? "İSA TV HD" : channel.name);
        if (portraitEpisodeInfo != null) {
            if (channel.season > 0 || channel.episode > 0) {
                String label = (channel.season > 0 ? "Sezon " + channel.season : "") +
                        (channel.episode > 0 ? "  ·  " + channel.episode + ". Bölüm" : "");
                portraitEpisodeInfo.setText(label.trim());
                portraitEpisodeInfo.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            } else portraitEpisodeInfo.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }

    favoriteButton.setText(isCurrentChannelFavorite() ? "♥" : "♡");
    favoriteButton.setContentDescription(
            isCurrentChannelFavorite()
                    ? "Favorilerden çıkar"
                    : "Favorilere ekle");
}

private void toggleCurrentFavorite() {
    if (selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= channels.size()) return;

    Channel channel = channels.get(selectedIndex);
    boolean add = !isCurrentChannelFavorite();

    try {
        JSONObject item = new JSONObject();
        item.put("name", channel.name == null ? "İsimsiz kanal" : channel.name);
        item.put("url", channel.url);
        item.put("group", channel.group == null ? "Genel" : channel.group);
        item.put("logo", channel.logo == null ? "" : channel.logo);
        item.put("is_live", channel.isLive);
        item.put("season", channel.season);
        item.put("episode", channel.episode);

        android.content.SharedPreferences prefs =
                getSharedPreferences("isa_tv_data", MODE_PRIVATE);

        JSONArray old = new JSONArray(prefs.getString("favorites", "[]"));
        JSONArray updated = new JSONArray();

        for (int i = 0; i < old.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject existing = old.optJSONObject(i);
            if (existing == null) continue;

            if (!channel.url.equals(existing.optString("url", ""))) {
                updated.put(existing);
            }
        }

        if (add) updated.put(item);

        prefs.edit().putString("favorites", updated.toString()).apply();
        updatePortraitOverlay();

    } catch (Exception e) {
        Log.e(TAG, "Favori değiştirilemedi", e);
    }
}

private void showChannelList() {
    if (channels.isEmpty()) return;
    if (channelDialog != null && channelDialog.isShowing()) return;

    final Dialog dialog = new Dialog(this);
    channelDialog = dialog;

    final java.util.ArrayList<String> groups = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
    final java.util.LinkedHashMap<String, java.util.ArrayList<Integer>> grouped =
            new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();

    for (int i = 0; i < channels.size(); i++) {
        Channel c = channels.get(i);
        String g = c.group == null || c.group.trim().isEmpty()
                ? "Genel" : c.group.trim();

        if (!grouped.containsKey(g)) {
            grouped.put(g, new java.util.ArrayList<Integer>());
            groups.add(g);
        }
        grouped.get(g).add(i);
    }

    final int[] groupIndex = {0};

    // Açık kanalın grubunu başlangıç grubu yap.
    if (selectedIndex >= 0 && selectedIndex < channels.size()) {
        String selectedGroup = channels.get(selectedIndex).group;
        if (selectedGroup == null || selectedGroup.trim().isEmpty()) {
            selectedGroup = "Genel";
        } else {
            selectedGroup = selectedGroup.trim();
        }

        int foundGroup = groups.indexOf(selectedGroup);
        if (foundGroup >= 0) groupIndex[0] = foundGroup;
    }

    final java.util.ArrayList<Integer> visibleItems = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

    LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
    root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
    root.setPadding(
            dp(isPortraitMode() ? 14 : 8),
            dp(isPortraitMode() ? 14 : 8),
            dp(isPortraitMode() ? 14 : 8),
            dp(isPortraitMode() ? 12 : 8));
    root.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(17, 21, 29));

    TextView title = new TextView(this);
    title.setText("İSA TV HD  •  KANALLAR");
    title.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
    title.setTextSize(18);
    title.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
    title.setPadding(dp(8), dp(8), dp(8), dp(14));
    root.addView(title);

    LinearLayout groupBar = new LinearLayout(this);
    groupBar.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
    groupBar.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
    groupBar.setPadding(dp(4), dp(8), dp(4), dp(8));
    groupBar.setBackgroundColor(0xFF252E3C);

    TextView previous = new TextView(this);
    previous.setText("‹");
    previous.setTextSize(30);
    previous.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
    previous.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
    previous.setMinWidth(dp(48));

    TextView groupName = new TextView(this);
    groupName.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
    groupName.setTextSize(14);
    groupName.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
    groupName.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
    groupName.setMaxLines(2);

    TextView next = new TextView(this);
    next.setText("›");
    next.setTextSize(30);
    next.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
    next.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
    next.setMinWidth(dp(48));

    groupBar.addView(previous);
    groupBar.addView(groupName, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
            0, dp(48), 1f));
    groupBar.addView(next);
    root.addView(groupBar);

    EditText search = new EditText(this);
    search.setSingleLine(true);
    search.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
    search.setHintTextColor(0xFFAAAAAA);
    search.setHint("Bu grupta kanal ara...");
    search.setTextSize(14);
    search.setPadding(dp(12), 0, dp(12), 0);
    search.setBackgroundColor(0xFF252E3C);

    LinearLayout.LayoutParams searchParams =
            new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(isPortraitMode() ? 46 : 36));
    searchParams.topMargin = dp(10);
    searchParams.bottomMargin = dp(8);
    root.addView(search, searchParams);

    ListView list = new ListView(this);
    list.setDivider(new android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable(0x22FFFFFF));
    list.setDividerHeight(dp(1));
    list.setCacheColorHint(Color.TRANSPARENT);

    TextView count = new TextView(this);
    count.setTextColor(0xFFAAAAAA);
    count.setTextSize(12);
    count.setPadding(dp(8), dp(8), dp(8), dp(8));
    root.addView(count);

    BaseAdapter adapter = new BaseAdapter() {
        @Override public int getCount() {
            return visibleItems.size();
        }

        @Override public Object getItem(int position) {
            return channels.get(visibleItems.get(position));
        }

        @Override public long getItemId(int position) {
            return visibleItems.get(position);
        }

        @Override public View getView(int position, View recycled,
                                      android.view.ViewGroup parent) {
            LinearLayout row;
            ImageView icon;
            LinearLayout texts;
            TextView name;
            TextView subtitle;

            if (recycled instanceof LinearLayout) {
                row = (LinearLayout) recycled;
                icon = (ImageView) row.getChildAt(0);
                texts = (LinearLayout) row.getChildAt(1);
                name = (TextView) texts.getChildAt(0);
                subtitle = (TextView) texts.getChildAt(1);
            } else {
                row = new LinearLayout(PlayerActivity.this);
                row.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
                row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
                row.setPadding(dp(10), dp(8), dp(10), dp(8));
                row.setMinimumHeight(dp(isPortraitMode() ? 60 : 32));

                icon = new ImageView(PlayerActivity.this);
                icon.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.FIT_CENTER);
                row.addView(icon, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        dp(isPortraitMode() ? 46 : 26),
                        dp(isPortraitMode() ? 46 : 26)));

                texts = new LinearLayout(PlayerActivity.this);
                texts.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
                texts.setPadding(dp(12), 0, 0, 0);

                name = new TextView(PlayerActivity.this);
                name.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
                name.setTextSize(isPortraitMode() ? 14 : 12);
                name.setMaxLines(1);
                name.setEllipsize(android.text.TextUtils.TruncateAt.END);

                subtitle = new TextView(PlayerActivity.this);
                subtitle.setTextColor(0xFFAAAAAA);
                subtitle.setTextSize(isPortraitMode() ? 11 : 9);

                texts.addView(name);
                texts.addView(subtitle);
                row.addView(texts, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        0, -2, 1f));
            }

            int actual = visibleItems.get(position);
            Channel c = channels.get(actual);

            name.setText((actual == selectedIndex ? "●  " : "")
                    + (c.name == null ? "İsimsiz kanal" : c.name));
            subtitle.setText(actual == selectedIndex ? "ŞU ANDA OYNUYOR" : "CANLI YAYIN");
            row.setBackgroundColor(actual == selectedIndex
                    ? 0xFF303D50 : Color.TRANSPARENT);

            icon.setImageDrawable(null);
            if (c.logo != null && !c.logo.isEmpty()) {
                try {
                    new android.os.AsyncTask<Void, Void, android.graphics.Bitmap>() {
                        @Override
                        protected android.graphics.Bitmap doInBackground(Void... v) {
                            try {
                                return android.graphics.BitmapFactory.decodeStream(
                                        new java.net.URL(c.logo).openStream());
                            } catch (Exception e) {
                                return null;
                            }
                        }
                        @Override
                        protected void onPostExecute(android.graphics.Bitmap bitmap) {
                            if (bitmap != null && icon.getParent() != null) {
                                icon.setImageBitmap(bitmap);
                            }
                        }
                    }.execute();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            return row;
        }
    };

    Runnable updateList = () -> {
        String group = groups.get(groupIndex[0]);
        java.util.ArrayList<Integer> source = grouped.get(group);
        visibleItems.clear();

        String term = search.getText().toString().toLowerCase(
                java.util.Locale.forLanguageTag("tr"));

        for (Integer index : source) {
            String name = channels.get(index).name;
            if (name == null) name = "";
            if (name.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.forLanguageTag("tr"))
                    .contains(term)) {
                visibleItems.add(index);
            }
        }

        groupName.setText(group + "\n" + source.size() + " KANAL");
        count.setText(visibleItems.size() + " kanal gösteriliyor");
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
    };

    previous.setOnClickListener(v -> {
        groupIndex[0] = (groupIndex[0] - 1 + groups.size()) % groups.size();
        search.setText("");
        updateList.run();
    });

    next.setOnClickListener(v -> {
        groupIndex[0] = (groupIndex[0] + 1) % groups.size();
        search.setText("");
        updateList.run();
    });

    search.addTextChangedListener(new android.text.TextWatcher() {
        @Override public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int st, int c, int a) {}
        @Override public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int st, int before, int count) {
            updateList.run();
        }
        @Override public void afterTextChanged(android.text.Editable e) {}
    });

    list.setAdapter(adapter);
    list.setOnItemClickListener((parent, view, position, id) -> {
        if (position < 0 || position >= visibleItems.size()) return;
        selectedIndex = visibleItems.get(position);
        dialog.dismiss();
        playSelected();
    });

    root.addView(list, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f));

    TextView close = new TextView(this);
    close.setText("KAPAT");
    close.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
    close.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
    close.setTextSize(13);
    close.setBackgroundColor(0xFF303D50);
    close.setPadding(0, dp(12), 0, dp(12));
    close.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());

    LinearLayout.LayoutParams closeParams =
            new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(isPortraitMode() ? 46 : 34));
    closeParams.topMargin = dp(4);
    root.addView(close, closeParams);

    updateList.run();

    int selectedPosition = visibleItems.indexOf(selectedIndex);
    if (selectedPosition >= 0) {
        list.setSelection(selectedPosition);
    }

    dialog.setContentView(root);
    dialog.setCancelable(true);
    dialog.setOnDismissListener(d -> {
        if (channelDialog == dialog) channelDialog = null;
    });
    dialog.show();

    if (dialog.getWindow() != null) {
        dialog.getWindow().setBackgroundDrawableResource(
                android.R.color.transparent);
        int screenWidth = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().widthPixels;
        int screenHeight = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().heightPixels;
        int panelWidth = isPortraitMode()
                ? (int)(screenWidth * 0.94f)
                : Math.min(dp(430), (int)(screenWidth * 0.42f));

        dialog.getWindow().setLayout(
                panelWidth,
                (int)(screenHeight * 0.96f));
        dialog.getWindow().setGravity(
                Gravity.LEFT | Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        dialog.getWindow().addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DIM_BEHIND);
        WindowManager.LayoutParams params = dialog.getWindow().getAttributes();
        params.dimAmount = 0.72f;
        dialog.getWindow().setAttributes(params);
    }
}



    private boolean shouldShowTvLogo() {
        return true;
    }

    private int dp(float value) {
        return (int) (
                value * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density
                + 0.5f
        );
    }

    @Override
    public void onBackPressed() {
        super.onBackPressed();
    }

    

    

    

    @Override
    protected void onSaveInstanceState(Bundle outState) {
        outState.putInt("isa_saved_channel_index", selectedIndex);
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
    }

    @Override
    public void onConfigurationChanged(Configuration newConfig) {
        super.onConfigurationChanged(newConfig);

        // Mevcut ExoPlayer ve video yüzeyini değiştirme.
        // Böylece yayın bağlantısı yeniden kurulmaz.
        if (channelDialog != null && channelDialog.isShowing()) {
            channelDialog.dismiss();
        }

        if (logo != null &&
                logo.getLayoutParams() instanceof FrameLayout.LayoutParams) {
            boolean portrait = isPortraitMode();

            FrameLayout.LayoutParams lp =
                    (FrameLayout.LayoutParams) logo.getLayoutParams();

            lp.width = dp(portrait ? 68 : 130);
            lp.height = dp(portrait ? 42 : 80);
            lp.gravity = Gravity.TOP | Gravity.RIGHT;
            lp.setMargins(
                    0,
                    dp(portrait ? 8 : 12),
                    dp(portrait ? 8 : 12),
                    0);

            logo.setLayoutParams(lp);
            logo.setPadding(
                    portrait ? 0 : dp(5),
                    portrait ? 0 : dp(5),
                    portrait ? 0 : dp(5),
                    portrait ? 0 : dp(5));
            logo.setBackgroundColor(
                    portrait ? Color.TRANSPARENT : 0x880F0F0F);
        }

        updatePortraitOverlay();

        applyPreloadPolicy();

        if (channelButton != null) {
            channelButton.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
        applyImmersiveMode();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onPause() {
        super.onPause();

        handler.removeCallbacks(neighborPreloadTimeout);
        stopNeighborPreloads();

        if (player != null) player.pause();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();

        if (player != null) {
            applyPreloadPolicy();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);

        if (playerView != null) {
            playerView.setPlayer(null);
        }

        java.util.HashSet<ExoPlayer> allPlayers =
                new java.util.HashSet<>();

        if (player != null) allPlayers.add(player);
        allPlayers.addAll(preloadedPlayers.values());
        allPlayers.addAll(standbyPlayers);

        preloadedPlayers.clear();
        standbyPlayers.clear();

        for (ExoPlayer p : allPlayers) {
            try {
                p.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }

        player = null;

        super.onDestroy();
    }

}

package com.isatvhd.player;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.animation.ValueAnimator;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.widget.FrameLayout;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.content.Intent;

public class SplashActivity extends Activity {

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        getWindow().setBackgroundDrawableResource(android.R.color.transparent);
        getWindow().setStatusBarColor(Color.TRANSPARENT);
        getWindow().setNavigationBarColor(Color.TRANSPARENT);

        FrameLayout splash = new FrameLayout(this);
        splash.setBackgroundColor(Color.TRANSPARENT);

        ImageView logo = new ImageView(this);
        logo.setImageResource(R.drawable.logo);
        logo.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.FIT_CENTER);
        logo.setAlpha(0.05f);
        logo.setScaleX(0.86f);
        logo.setScaleY(0.86f);

        float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        logo.setTranslationX(18 * density);

        FrameLayout.LayoutParams params = new FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                (int)(300 * density),
                (int)(200 * density),
                Gravity.CENTER
        );

        splash.addView(logo, params);
        setContentView(splash);

        ValueAnimator animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f);
        animator.setDuration(6000);

        animator.addUpdateListener(animation -> {
            float progress = (float) animation.getAnimatedValue();

            // İlk 3 saniyede tamamen görünür ve aydınlık.
            float alpha = 0.05f + Math.min(1f, progress * 2f) * 0.95f;
            logo.setAlpha(alpha);

            // 6 saniye boyunca kesintisiz yakınlaşma.
            float scale = 0.86f + progress * 0.34f;
            logo.setScaleX(scale);
            logo.setScaleY(scale);
        });

        animator.start();

        new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed(() -> {
            startActivity(new Intent(SplashActivity.this, MainActivity.class));
            overridePendingTransition(0, 0);
            finish();
        }, 6000);
    }
}

async function openMediaSeries(series,source,root,kind,category) {
    root.innerHTML='<p class="isa-loading">Sezonlar yükleniyor...</p>';
    try {
        const info=await xtreamAPI(source,'get_series_info',{series_id:series.raw.series_id});
        const raw=info.episodes||{}, all=[];
        if(Array.isArray(raw)) { for(const ep of raw) all.push(ep); }
        else for(const key of Object.keys(raw)) if(Array.isArray(raw[key])) for(const ep of raw[key]) all.push(ep);
        const seasons=new Map();
        for(const ep of all) {
            const sn=Number(ep.season||ep.season_number||1);
            if(!seasons.has(sn)) seasons.set(sn,[]);
            const ext=ep.container_extension||'mp4';
            seasons.get(sn).push({name:(Number(ep.episode_num||ep.episode_number||seasons.get(sn).length+1))+'. Bölüm',season:sn,episode:Number(ep.episode_num||ep.episode_number||seasons.get(sn).length+1),url:source.host.replace(/\/+$/,'')+'/series/'+encodeURIComponent(source.username)+'/'+encodeURIComponent(source.password)+'/'+ep.id+'.'+ext});
        }
        const nums=Array.from(seasons.keys()).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
        root.innerHTML=`<div class="isa-vod-toolbar"><button class="isa-back" data-series-back>Kategoriler</button><h2>${esc(series.name)}</h2></div><div class="isa-provider-grid">${nums.map((n,i)=>`<button class="isa-provider-card" data-season="${i}"><strong>Sezon ${n}</strong><small>${seasons.get(n).length} bölüm</small></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
        root.querySelector('[data-series-back]').onclick=()=>openMediaSource(source,kind,root);
        root.querySelectorAll('[data-season]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
            const episodes=seasons.get(nums[Number(b.dataset.season)]);
            root.innerHTML=`<div class="isa-vod-toolbar"><button class="isa-back" data-episode-back>Sezonlar</button><h2>${esc(series.name)} · Sezon ${nums[Number(b.dataset.season)]}</h2></div><div class="isa-provider-grid">${episodes.map((ep,i)=>`<button class="isa-provider-card" data-ep="${i}"><i class="fas fa-circle-play" style="font-size:28px;padding:14px"></i><strong>${esc(ep.name)}</strong><small>Bölümü oynat</small></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
            root.querySelector('[data-episode-back]').onclick=()=>openMediaSeries(series,source,root,kind,category);
            root.querySelectorAll('[data-ep]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{const ep=episodes[Number(x.dataset.ep)];const queue=episodes.map((e,i)=>({name:cleanMediaTitle(series.name),url:e.url,group:category,season:e.season,episode:e.episode,headers:{}})); const idx=Number(x.dataset.ep); play(queue[idx],queue,idx,false);});
        });
        if(!nums.length) root.innerHTML+='<p class="isa-vod-note">Bu dizide bölüm bulunamadı.</p>';
    } catch(e) { root.innerHTML=`<p class="isa-vod-note">Dizi bilgileri alınamadı: ${esc(e.message)}</p>`; }
}

function initScrollArrows() {
    if (document.getElementById('isa-scroll-arrows')) return;
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.id = 'isa-scroll-arrows';
    box.innerHTML = '<button type="button" aria-label="Yukarı çık">▲</button><button type="button" aria-label="Sayfanın sonuna in">▼</button>';
    document.body.appendChild(box);
    const buttons = box.querySelectorAll('button');
    buttons[0].onclick = () => window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
    buttons[1].onclick = () => window.scrollTo({top:document.documentElement.scrollHeight,behavior:'smooth'});
    let lastY = window.scrollY, lastT = performance.now(), hideTimer = 0;
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
        const now = performance.now(), y = window.scrollY;
        const speed = Math.abs(y-lastY) / Math.max(1,now-lastT);
        lastY=y; lastT=now;
        const canScroll = document.documentElement.scrollHeight > window.innerHeight + 120;
        if (canScroll && speed > 0.22) {
            box.classList.add('visible');
            buttons[0].style.visibility = y > 180 ? 'visible' : 'hidden';
            buttons[1].style.visibility = y < document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight-100 ? 'visible' : 'hidden';
            clearTimeout(hideTimer); hideTimer=setTimeout(()=>box.classList.remove('visible'),950);
        } else if (speed <= 0.22) {
            clearTimeout(hideTimer); hideTimer=setTimeout(()=>box.classList.remove('visible'),500);
        }
    },{passive:true});
}

const ISAFLIX_WEB_CACHE_KEY = 'isaflix-web-discovery-v1';

function isaFlixCatalog() {
    return window.__ISAFLIX_WEB_CATALOG || {movies:[],series:[]};
}

function isaFlixNormalizeTitle(value) {
    return String(value || '')
        .replace(/<[^>]*>/g,' ')
        .replace(/&nbsp;|&#160;/gi,' ')
        .replace(/&amp;/gi,'&')
        .replace(/&#39;|&apos;/gi,"'")
        .replace(/&quot;/gi,'"')
        .replace(/\s+/g,' ')
        .trim();
}

function isaFlixDiscoverType(text, sourceKind) {
    const value = String(text || '').toLocaleLowerCase('tr');
    if (/dizi|series|sezon|season|episode|bölüm|bolum|tv-show/.test(value))
        return 'series';
    if (/film|movie|sinema|full-hd/.test(value))
        return 'movie';
    return sourceKind === 'series' ? 'series' :
           sourceKind === 'movie' ? 'movie' : '';
}

function isaFlixPosterFromAnchor(anchor, baseUrl) {
    const image = anchor.querySelector('img') ||
        (anchor.parentElement && anchor.parentElement.querySelector('img'));
    if (!image) return '';
    const raw = image.getAttribute('data-src') ||
        image.getAttribute('data-lazy-src') ||
        image.getAttribute('data-original') ||
        image.getAttribute('src') || '';
    try {
        const url = new URL(raw, baseUrl);
        return /^https?:$/.test(url.protocol) ? url.href : '';
    } catch (e) {
        return '';
    }
}

async function isaFlixDiscoverOneSource(source) {
    const html = await nativeFetch(source.url);
    if (!html || html.length < 100) return [];

    const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
    const base = new URL(source.url);
    const found = [];
    const seen = new Set();

    for (const anchor of Array.from(doc.querySelectorAll('a[href]')).slice(0, 1200)) {
        try {
            const page = new URL(anchor.getAttribute('href'), base.href);
            if (!/^https?:$/.test(page.protocol) || page.origin !== base.origin)
                continue;

            const path = page.pathname.toLocaleLowerCase('tr');
            if (path === '/' || path.length < 3 ||
                /login|register|uye-ol|giris|search|arama|category|kategori|tag|etiket|page\/\d+/i.test(path))
                continue;

            const image = isaFlixPosterFromAnchor(anchor, base.href);
            const title = isaFlixNormalizeTitle(
                anchor.getAttribute('title') ||
                anchor.getAttribute('aria-label') ||
                (anchor.querySelector('img') &&
                 anchor.querySelector('img').getAttribute('alt')) ||
                anchor.textContent
            );

            if (!title || title.length < 2 || title.length > 140)
                continue;

            const type = source.kind === 'movie'
                ? 'movie'
                : source.kind === 'series'
                    ? 'series'
                    : isaFlixDiscoverType(
                        path + ' ' + title + ' ' + (anchor.className || ''),
                        source.kind
                    );
            if (!type) continue;

            if (/^(izle|watch|detay|details|fragman|trailer|ana sayfa)$/i.test(title))
                continue;

            const key = type + '|' + page.href;
            if (seen.has(key)) continue;
            seen.add(key);

            found.push({
                id:'web-' + source.id + '-' + found.length,
                name:title,
                title:title,
                type:type,
                category_name:type === 'series' ? 'Diziler' : 'Filmler',
                platform_name:type === 'series' ? 'Diziler' : 'Filmler',
                poster_url:image,
                image_url:image,
                page_url:page.href,
                source_id:source.id,
                source_url:base.origin,
                episodes:[]
            });
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    return found;
}

async function isaFlixDiscoverWebCatalog() {
    const empty = {movies:[],series:[]};

    try {
        const cached = localStorage.getItem(ISAFLIX_WEB_CACHE_KEY);
        if (cached) {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
            if (parsed && Array.isArray(parsed.movies) &&
                Array.isArray(parsed.series)) {
                window.__ISAFLIX_WEB_CATALOG = parsed;
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(
                    'isa:catalog-catalog-updated', {detail:parsed}
                ));
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {}

    const collected = [];
    let cursor = 0;
    const workers = Array.from({length:2}, async () => {
        while (cursor < ISAFLIX_WEB_SOURCES.length) {
            const source = ISAFLIX_WEB_SOURCES[cursor++];
            try {
                const items = await isaFlixDiscoverOneSource(source);
                collected.push(...items);
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('İSAFLIX kaynak taraması tamamlanamadı:', source.id);
            }
        }
    });

    await Promise.all(workers);

    const unique = new Map();
    for (const item of collected) {
        const key = item.type + '|' +
            item.title.toLocaleLowerCase('tr')
                .replace(/[^a-z0-9çğıöşü]/gi,'');
        if (!unique.has(key)) unique.set(key, item);
        else {
            const previous = unique.get(key);
            if (!previous.poster_url && item.poster_url)
                previous.poster_url = item.poster_url;
        }
    }

    const all = Array.from(unique.values());
    const catalog = {
        movies:all.filter(x => x.type === 'movie'),
        series:all.filter(x => x.type === 'series')

===== KATEGORI VE ICERIK KESFI =====
        series:all.filter(x => x.type === 'series')
    };

    if (catalog.movies.length || catalog.series.length) {
        window.__ISAFLIX_WEB_CATALOG = catalog;
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(ISAFLIX_WEB_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(catalog));
        } catch (e) {}
    } else if (!window.__ISAFLIX_WEB_CATALOG) {
        window.__ISAFLIX_WEB_CATALOG = empty;
    }

    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(
        'isa:catalog-catalog-updated',
        {detail:window.__ISAFLIX_WEB_CATALOG}
    ));
}

function isaFlixArray(value) {
    return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
}

function isaFlixText(value, fallback='') {
    return String(value == null ? fallback : value);
}

function isaFlixHeaders(item) {
    const headers = {...(item.headers || {})};
    if (item.referer) headers.Referer = item.referer;
    if (item.user_agent) headers['User-Agent'] = item.user_agent;
    return headers;
}

function isaFlixModeItems(data, mode) {
    if (mode === 'live') return isaFlixArray(data.live_channels);
    if (mode === 'movies') return isaFlixArray(data.movies);
    return isaFlixArray(data.series);
}

function isaFlixCategory(item, mode) {
    if (mode === 'live') return isaFlixText(item.category_name, 'Genel');
    if (mode === 'movies') return isaFlixText(item.category_name, 'Diğer');
    return isaFlixText(item.platform_name || item.category_name, 'Diğer');
}

function isaFlixCategories(data, mode) {
    let source = [];
    if (mode === 'live') source = isaFlixArray(data.live_categories);
    if (mode === 'movies') source = isaFlixArray(data.movie_categories);
    if (mode === 'series') source = isaFlixArray(data.series_platforms);

    let names = source.map(x => isaFlixText(x.name).trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!names.length) {
        names = [...new Set(isaFlixModeItems(data, mode).map(x =>
            isaFlixCategory(x, mode)
        ))];
    }
    return [...new Set(names)];
}

function isaFlixRoot() {
    return document.getElementById('isa-flix-app');
}

function isaFlixOpen() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('isa-flix-panel');
    return !!(panel && panel.classList.contains('active'));
}

function isaFlixRender() {
    const root = isaFlixRoot();
    if (!root) return;

    const data = isaFlixCatalog();
    const modes = [
        ['movies', 'Filmler', 'fa-film'],
        ['series', 'Diziler', 'fa-clapperboard']
    ];

    const totalMovies = isaFlixArray(data.movies).length;
    const totalSeries = isaFlixArray(data.series).length;

    root.innerHTML = `
        <div class="isaf-header">
            <div class="isaf-brand"><span>İSA</span> FLIX</div>
            <div class="isaf-count">
                ${totalMovies.toLocaleString('tr-TR')} film ·
                ${totalSeries.toLocaleString('tr-TR')} dizi
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="isaf-tabs">
            ${modes.map(([id,label,icon]) => `
                <button type="button" data-isaf-mode="${id}"
                    class="${isaFlixState.mode===id?'active':''}">
                    <i class="fas ${icon}"></i> ${label}
                </button>
            `).join('')}
        </div>
        <div class="isaf-tools">
            <input id="isaf-search" type="search"
                placeholder="İçerik ara..." value="${esc(isaFlixState.query)}">
            <select id="isaf-category">
                <option value="">Bütün kategoriler</option>
                ${isaFlixCategories(data,isaFlixState.mode).map(name => `
                    <option value="${esc(name)}"
                        ${isaFlixState.category===name?'selected':''}>
                        ${esc(name)}
                    </option>
                `).join('')}
            </select>
        </div>
        <div id="isaf-status" class="isaf-status"></div>
        <div id="isaf-grid" class="isaf-grid"></div>
        <button id="isaf-more" class="isaf-more" type="button">
            Daha fazla içerik yükle
        </button>
    `;

    root.querySelectorAll('[data-isaf-mode]').forEach(button => {
        button.onclick = () => {
            isaFlixState.mode = button.dataset.isafMode;
            isaFlixState.category = '';
            isaFlixState.query = '';
            isaFlixState.series = null;
            isaFlixRender();
        };
    });

    const search = document.getElementById('isaf-search');
    const category = document.getElementById('isaf-category');

    search.oninput = () => {
        isaFlixState.query = search.value;
        isaFlixRenderItems();
    };

    category.onchange = () => {
        isaFlixState.category = category.value;
        isaFlixRenderItems();
    };

    isaFlixRenderItems();
}

function isaFlixRenderItems() {
    const data = isaFlixCatalog();
    const grid = document.getElementById('isaf-grid');
    const status = document.getElementById('isaf-status');
    const more = document.getElementById('isaf-more');
    if (!grid || !status || !more) return;

    const mode = isaFlixState.mode;
    const query = isaFlixState.query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase('tr');
    const category = isaFlixState.category;

    let items = isaFlixModeItems(data, mode);

    items = items.filter(item => {
        if (category && isaFlixCategory(item,mode) !== category) return false;
        if (!query) return true;

        const text = [
            item.name, item.title, item.category_name,
            item.platform_name, item.description, item.year
        ].join(' ').toLocaleLowerCase('tr');

        return text.includes(query);
    });

    isaFlixState.items = items;
    isaFlixState.shown = 0;
    grid.innerHTML = '';

    status.textContent =
        items.length.toLocaleString('tr-TR') + ' içerik bulundu.';

    if (!items.length) {
        grid.innerHTML = '<p class="isa-vod-note">Bu aramada içerik bulunamadı.</p>';
        more.hidden = true;
        return;
    }

    more.hidden = false;
    more.onclick = isaFlixLoadMore;
    isaFlixLoadMore();
}

function isaFlixLoadMore() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('isaf-grid');
    const more = document.getElementById('isaf-more');
    const status = document.getElementById('isaf-status');
    if (!grid || !more) return;

    const items = isaFlixState.items;
    const start = isaFlixState.shown;
    const end = Math.min(start + isaFlixState.batch, items.length);
    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();

    for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
        const item = items[i];
        const mode = isaFlixState.mode;
        const title = item.title || item.name || 'İsimsiz içerik';
        const image = item.poster_url || item.logo_url ||
            item.image_url || item.poster || item.image || '';
        const detail = mode === 'live'
            ? isaFlixCategory(item,mode)
            : [item.year, isaFlixCategory(item,mode)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');

        const card = document.createElement('button');
        card.type = 'button';
        card.className = 'isaf-card';

        const img = document.createElement('img');
        img.loading = 'lazy';
        img.decoding = 'async';
        img.alt = '';
        img.src = image;
        img.onerror = () => { img.style.display = 'none'; };

        const name = document.createElement('strong');
        name.textContent = cleanMediaTitle(title);

        const small = document.createElement('small');
        small.textContent = detail;

        if (image) card.appendChild(img);
        else {
            const icon = document.createElement('i');
            icon.className = 'fas ' + (mode==='live'?'fa-tv':'fa-film');
            card.appendChild(icon);
        }

        card.append(name,small);
        card.onclick = () => isaFlixOpenItem(item, i);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
    }

    grid.appendChild(fragment);
    isaFlixState.shown = end;

    status.textContent =
        end.toLocaleString('tr-TR') + ' / ' +
        items.length.toLocaleString('tr-TR') + ' içerik gösteriliyor.';

    more.hidden = end >= items.length;
}

async function openIsaFlixVODItem(item) {
    const candidates = [
        item.videoUrl,
        item.video_url,
        item.playUrl,
        item.stream,
        item.file,
        item.url,
        item.link,
        item.embedUrl
    ].filter(Boolean);

    const name = item.title || item.name || 'İSAFLIX';
    const headers = {...(item.headers || {})};

    const media = candidates.find(isDirectMedia);

    if (media) {
        playIsaFlix(name, media, headers, item.queue || [], item.queueIndex || 0);
        return;
    }

    const page = candidates.find(isHttp);

    if (!page) {
        alert('Bu içerik için geçerli bağlantı bulunamadı.');
        return;
    }

    const root = isaFlixRoot();
    const note = document.createElement('p');

    note.className = 'isa-vod-note';
    note.textContent = 'Video kaynağı aranıyor...';

    if (root) root.prepend(note);

    try {
        const resolved = await resolveStaticMedia(page);

        note.remove();

        headers.Referer = page;
        const playbackUrl = resolved || page;

        playIsaFlix(
            name,
            playbackUrl,
            headers,
            item.queue || [],
            item.queueIndex || 0
        );

    } catch (error) {
        note.remove();
        console.error('İSAFLIX video çözümleme:', error);
        alert('Video açılamadı: ' + error.message);
    }
}

window.__isaCatalogProgress = function(id, stage, percent) {
    if (catalogHasCache) return;

    const root = isaCatalogProgressElement();
    const value = Math.max(
        0, Math.min(100, Number(percent) || 0)
    );

    root.querySelector('#isa-catalog-fill').style.width =
        value + '%';

    root.querySelector('#isa-catalog-percent').textContent =
        value + '%';
};

window.__isaCatalogDone = function(id, value, error) {
    const callback = window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];
    if (!callback) return;

    delete window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];

    if (error) {
        isaCatalogHideProgress();
        callback.reject(new Error(error));
    } else {
        callback.resolve(value);
    }
};

window.__isaCatalogReady = function(id, totalBytes, error, notModified) {
    if (error) {
        window.__isaCatalogDone(id, null, error);
        return;
    }

    const callback = window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];

    if (!callback) return;

    if (notModified && catalogLastData &&
        typeof catalogLastData === 'object') {
        window.__isaCatalogDone(id, catalogLastData, null);
        return;
    }

    if (!window.ISATV ||
        typeof window.ISATV.readCatalogChunk !== 'function') {
        window.__isaCatalogDone(
            id, null, 'Java Catalog parça bağlantısı bulunamadı.'
        );
        return;
    }

    if (!Number.isFinite(totalBytes) || totalBytes <= 0) {
        window.__isaCatalogDone(
            id, null, 'Catalog kataloğu boş.'
        );
        return;
    }

    let offset = 0;
    const chunkSize = 65536;
    let completeText = '';
    const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');

    function readNext() {
        try {
            const encoded = window.ISATV.readCatalogChunk(
                String(offset), chunkSize
            );

            if (!encoded) {
                throw new Error('Catalog veri parçası boş geldi.');
            }

            const binary = atob(encoded);
            const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);

            for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
                bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
            }

            offset += bytes.length;

            completeText += decoder.decode(
                bytes,
                {stream: offset < totalBytes}
            );

            const percent = Math.min(
                99,
                90 + Math.floor(offset * 9 / totalBytes)
            );

            window.__isaCatalogProgress(id, 'load', percent);

            if (offset < totalBytes) {
                setTimeout(readNext, 0);
                return;
            }

            completeText += decoder.decode();

            window.__isaCatalogDone(
                id, completeText, null
            );

        } catch (e) {
            completeText = '';

            window.__isaCatalogDone(
                id, null,
                'Catalog aktarım hatası: ' + e.message
            );
        }
    }

    readNext();
};


function loadCachedCatalogCatalog() {
    if (!window.ISATV ||
        typeof window.ISATV.loadCachedCatalogCatalog !== 'function') {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
    }

    catalogHasCache = true;

    return new Promise(resolve => {
        const id = ++catalogRequestId;

        window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id] = {
            resolve: value => {
                try {
                    const parsed =
                        (value && typeof value === 'object')
                        ? value : JSON.parse(value);

                    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') {
                        throw new Error('Gecersiz veri');
                    }

                    catalogLastData = parsed;
                    window.ISA_Catalog_CATALOG = parsed;
                    catalogHasCache = true;
                    resolve(parsed);

                } catch (e) {
                    catalogHasCache = false;
                    resolve(null);
                }
            },

            reject: () => {
                catalogHasCache = false;
                resolve(null);
            }
        };

        try {
            window.ISATV.loadCachedCatalogCatalog(String(id));
        } catch (e) {
            delete window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];
            catalogHasCache = false;
            resolve(null);
        }
    });
}

function fetchCatalogCatalog() {
    if (catalogInFlight) return catalogInFlight;

    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.fetchCatalogCatalog) {
        return Promise.reject(
            new Error('Catalog native bağlantısı kullanılamıyor.')
        );
    }

    catalogLoading = true;

    catalogInFlight = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const id = ++catalogRequestId;

        window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id] = {
            resolve: value => {
                try {
                    const parsed = (value && typeof value === 'object')
                        ? value : JSON.parse(value);
                    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') {
                        throw new Error('Boş veya geçersiz katalog.');
                    }
                    catalogLastData = parsed;
                    window.__isaCatalogProgress(id, "parse", 100);
                    setTimeout(isaCatalogHideProgress, 180);
                    catalogHasCache = true;
                    resolve(parsed);
                } catch (e) {
                    reject(new Error('Catalog JSON doğrulaması başarısız: ' + e.message));
                } finally {
                    catalogLoading = false;
                    catalogInFlight = null;
                }
            },
            reject: error => {
                catalogLoading = false;
                catalogInFlight = null;
                reject(error);
            }
        };

        try {
            window.ISATV.fetchCatalogCatalog(String(id));
        } catch (e) {
            delete window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];
            catalogLoading = false;
            catalogInFlight = null;
            reject(e);
        }
    });

    return catalogInFlight;
}

async function refreshCatalogCatalog(silent=false) {
    try {
        const previousData = catalogLastData;
        const data = await fetchCatalogCatalog();

        if (data === previousData) return data;

        window.ISA_Catalog_CATALOG = data;
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(
            'isa:catalog-catalog-updated',
            {detail:data}
        ));

        if (!silent) {
            const status = document.getElementById('isa-live-status');
            if (status) status.textContent = 'Catalog kataloğu güncellendi.';
        }

        return data;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Catalog katalog güncellemesi:', error);

        if (!silent) {
            const status = document.getElementById('isa-live-status');
            if (status) status.textContent =
                'Catalog güncellenemedi: ' + error.message;
        }

        return catalogLastData;
    }
}


function startCatalogAutoUpdate() {
    if (catalogTimerStarted) return;
    catalogTimerStarted = true;

    loadCachedCatalogCatalog().then(cached => {
        if (cached) {

        }

        refreshCatalogCatalog(true);
    });

    window.setInterval(() => {
        if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
            refreshCatalogCatalog(true);
        }
    }, 60000);
}

function nativeCacheGet(key) {
    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.cacheGet) {
        try {
            return Promise.resolve(localStorage.getItem('isa-cache:'+key));
        } catch(e) {
            return Promise.resolve(null);
        }
    }

    return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
        const id = ++cacheCounter;
        window.__isaCacheCallbacks[id] = {resolve,reject};
        window.ISATV.cacheGet(key,String(id));
    });
}

function nativeCachePut(key,value) {
    if (window.ISATV && window.ISATV.cachePut) {
        window.ISATV.cachePut(key,value);
    } else {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem('isa-cache:'+key,value);
        } catch(e) {}
    }
}

function nativeFetch(url) {
    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.fetchText) {
        return fetch(url).then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
            return response.text();
        });
    }
    return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
        const id = ++fetchCounter;
        window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id] = {resolve,reject};
        window.ISATV.fetchText(url,String(id));
    });
}

function nativeFetchWithHeaders(url,headers={}) {
    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.fetchTextWithHeaders) {
        return fetch(url,{headers}).then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
            return response.text();
        });
    }
    return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
        const id = ++fetchCounter;
        window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id] = {resolve,reject};
        window.ISATV.fetchTextWithHeaders(url,JSON.stringify(headers || {}),String(id));
    });
}

function getTextWithHeaders(url,headers={}) {
    return nativeFetchWithHeaders(url,headers);
}

async function getText(url,forceRefresh=false) {
    let cached = null;

    try {
        cached = await nativeCacheGet(url);
    } catch(e) {}

    if (!forceRefresh && cached) return cached;

    try {
        const fresh = await nativeFetch(url);
        nativeCachePut(url,fresh);
        return fresh;
    } catch(e) {
        if (cached) return cached;
        throw e;
    }
}

        '&':'&amp;',
        '<':'&lt;',
        '>':'&gt;',
        '"':'&quot;',
        "'":'&#39;'
    })[c]);
}
