async function loadVOD(forceRefresh=false) {
    vodProviders = [];

    for (const source of playlists) {
        if (source.type === 'xtream') {
            vodProviders.push({
                ...source,
                type:'xtream',
                title:source.name
            });
        }
    }

    const grid = document.getElementById('isa-vod-grid');
    const status = document.getElementById('isa-vod-status');

    if (grid) {
        grid.innerHTML = vodProviders.map((provider,index) => `
            <button class="isa-provider-card"
                    data-xtream-provider="${index}">
                <i class="fas fa-server" style="font-size:32px;padding:20px"></i>
                <strong>${esc(provider.name)}</strong>
                <small>Xtream Codes</small>
            </button>
        `).join('');

        grid.querySelectorAll('[data-xtream-provider]').forEach(button => {
            button.onclick = () => openVODProvider(
                vodProviders[Number(button.dataset.xtreamProvider)]
            );
        });
    }

    if (status) {
        status.textContent = vodProviders.length +
            ' Xtream VOD kaynağı hazır.';
    }
}


/*
 * JSON nesnelerini düzleştirmeden korur.
 * Dizi nesnesinin episodes/seasons yapısı kaybolmaz.
 */

function normalizeVOD(data,result=[]) {
    if (Array.isArray(data)) {
        data.forEach(item => normalizeVOD(item,result));
        return result;
    }

    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return result;

    const title = data.title || data.name || data.baslik ||
                  data.titleName || data.filename || data.original_title;

    const url = data.url || data.link || data.file ||
                data.stream || data.playUrl || data.video ||
                data.videoUrl || data.video_url || data.embedUrl || '';

    const episodes = Array.isArray(data.episodes) ? data.episodes : [];
    const seasons = Array.isArray(data.seasons) ? data.seasons : [];
    const items = Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : [];

    if (title && (url || episodes.length || seasons.length || items.length ||
                  String(data.type || '').toLowerCase().includes('dizi') ||
                  String(data.type || '').toLowerCase().includes('series'))) {
        result.push({
            type:String(data.type || '').toLowerCase(),
            name:String(title),
            title:String(title),
            url:url,
            videoUrl:data.videoUrl || data.video_url || '',
            logo:data.poster || data.image || data.cover ||
                 data.thumbnail || data.thumb || '',
            poster:data.poster || data.image || data.cover ||
                   data.thumbnail || '',
            description:data.description || '',
            category:data.category || '',
            genres:Array.isArray(data.genres) ? data.genres : [],
            year:data.year || '',
            platform:data.platform || '',
            episodes:episodes,
            seasons:seasons,
            items:items,
            raw:data
        });
        return result;
    }

    Object.values(data).forEach(value => {
        if (value && typeof value === 'object') normalizeVOD(value,result);
    });

    return result;
}




function itemIsSeries(item) {
    return (Array.isArray(item.episodes) && item.episodes.length > 0) ||
           (Array.isArray(item.seasons) && item.seasons.length > 0) ||
           String(item.type || '').includes('dizi') ||
           String(item.type || '').includes('series');
}



function showVODProviders() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('isa-vod-grid');
    const area = document.getElementById('isa-vod-items');
    const heading = document.querySelector('#isa-vod-panel .isa-section-heading');

    grid.style.display = '';
    area.innerHTML = '';

    if (heading) heading.style.display = '';

    document.getElementById('isa-vod-status').textContent =
        vodProviders.length + ' VOD kaynağı hazır.';
}


function renderVODItems(items,provider) {
    const area = document.getElementById('isa-vod-items');

    const films = [];
    const series = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        const entry = {item:items[i], index:i};

        if (itemIsSeries(items[i])) series.push(entry);
        else films.push(entry);
    }

    area.innerHTML = `
        <div class="isa-vod-toolbar">
            <button class="isa-back" id="isa-vod-back">
                <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i> Kaynaklar
            </button>
            <h2>${esc(providerName(provider))}</h2>
        </div>
        ${series.length ? '<h3>Diziler</h3><div id="isa-series-grid" class="isa-provider-grid"></div>' : ''}
        ${films.length ? '<h3 style="margin-top:25px">Filmler ve diğer içerikler</h3><div id="isa-films-grid" class="isa-provider-grid"></div>' : ''}
        ${!items.length ? '<p class="isa-vod-note">Bu kaynakta gösterilebilir içerik bulunamadı.</p>' : ''}
    `;

    document.getElementById('isa-vod-back').onclick = showVODProviders;

    const renderBatch = (entries, gridId) => {
        const grid = document.getElementById(gridId);
        if (!grid) return;

        let offset = 0;
        const batchSize = 100;

        const next = () => {
            if (!grid.isConnected) return;

            const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
            const limit = Math.min(offset + batchSize, entries.length);

            for (; offset < limit; offset++) {
                const entry = entries[offset];
                const item = entry.item;
                const kind = itemIsSeries(item) ? 'series' : 'film';

                const holder = document.createElement('div');
                holder.innerHTML = vodCard(item,kind,entry.index);

                const button = holder.firstElementChild;
                button.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    if (kind === 'series') {
                        if (provider.type === 'xtream' && item.xtream)
                            openXtreamSeries(item,provider);
                        else
                            showSeries(item,provider);
                    } else {
                        openVODItem(item);
                    }
                });

                fragment.appendChild(button);
            }

            grid.appendChild(fragment);

            if (offset < entries.length) {
                requestAnimationFrame(next);
            }
        };

        requestAnimationFrame(next);
    };

    renderBatch(series,'isa-series-grid');
    renderBatch(films,'isa-films-grid');
}

function vodCard(item,kind,index) {
    return `
        <button class="isa-provider-card" data-vod-kind="${kind}" data-vod-index="${index}">
            ${item.logo ? `<img src="${esc(item.logo)}" alt="" onerror="this.style.display='none'">` : '<i class="fas fa-film" style="font-size:35px;padding:25px"></i>'}
            <strong>${esc(item.name)}</strong>
            <small>${esc(item.year)} ${esc(item.category)}</small>
        </button>
    `;
}


async function openVODProvider(provider) {
    const area = document.getElementById('isa-vod-items');
    const grid = document.getElementById('isa-vod-grid');
    const heading = document.querySelector('#isa-vod-panel .isa-section-heading');

    currentProvider = provider;
    if (grid) grid.style.display = 'none';
    if (heading) heading.style.display = 'none';
    area.innerHTML = '<p class="isa-loading">İçerikler yükleniyor...</p>';

    try {
        let items = [];
        if (provider.type === 'xtream') {
            const [films,series,filmCategories,seriesCategories] = await Promise.all([
                xtreamAPI(provider,'get_vod_streams'),
                xtreamAPI(provider,'get_series'),
                xtreamAPI(provider,'get_vod_categories').catch(() => []),
                xtreamAPI(provider,'get_series_categories').catch(() => [])
            ]);

            const filmMap = new Map();
            for (const category of (Array.isArray(filmCategories) ? filmCategories : [])) {
                filmMap.set(String(category.category_id),category.category_name || 'Filmler');
            }
            const seriesMap = new Map();
            for (const category of (Array.isArray(seriesCategories) ? seriesCategories : [])) {
                seriesMap.set(String(category.category_id),category.category_name || 'Diziler');
            }

            for (const item of (Array.isArray(films) ? films : [])) {
                items.push({
                    ...item,
                    type:'film',
                    name:item.name || 'Film',
                    title:item.name || 'Film',
                    category:filmMap.get(String(item.category_id)) || 'Filmler',
                    url:provider.host.replace(/\/+$/,'') +
                        '/movie/' + encodeURIComponent(provider.username) + '/' +
                        encodeURIComponent(provider.password) + '/' +
                        item.stream_id + '.' + (item.container_extension || 'mp4'),
                    logo:item.stream_icon || item.cover || '',
                    raw:item
                });
            }

            for (const item of (Array.isArray(series) ? series : [])) {
                items.push({
                    ...item,
                    type:'series',
                    name:item.name || 'Dizi',
                    title:item.name || 'Dizi',
                    category:seriesMap.get(String(item.category_id)) || 'Diziler',
                    url:'',
                    logo:item.cover || item.stream_icon || '',
                    raw:item,
                    xtream:true
                });
            }
        } else {
            const text = await getText(provider.url);
            if (text.trim().startsWith('#EXTM3U') || text.includes('#EXTINF:')) {
                items = parseM3U(text,'vod').map(item => ({
                    ...item,title:item.name,logo:item.logo,episodes:[],seasons:[],type:'film'
                }));
            } else {
                items = normalizeVOD(JSON.parse(text));
            }
        }
        renderVODItems(items,provider);
    } catch(error) {
        area.innerHTML = `
            <div class="isa-vod-toolbar">
                <button class="isa-back" id="isa-vod-error-back">Geri</button>
                <h2>${esc(providerName(provider))}</h2>
            </div>
            <p class="isa-vod-note">İçerik alınamadı: ${esc(error.message)}</p>
        `;
        const back = document.getElementById('isa-vod-error-back');
        if (back) back.onclick = showVODProviders;
    }
}

async function openXtreamSeries(series,provider) {
    const area = document.getElementById('isa-vod-items');
    area.innerHTML = '<p class="isa-loading">Dizi bölümleri alınıyor...</p>';

    try {
        const info = await xtreamAPI(provider, 'get_series_info', {
            series_id:series.series_id
        });

        const rawEpisodes = info.episodes || {};
        const seasons = info.seasons || [];
        const episodes = [];

        if (Array.isArray(rawEpisodes)) {
            for (const episode of rawEpisodes) episodes.push(episode);
        } else {
            Object.values(rawEpisodes).forEach(list => {
                if (Array.isArray(list)) { for (const episode of list) episodes.push(episode); }
            });
        }

        const grouped = new Map();

        for (const episode of episodes) {
            const season = Number(
                episode.season || episode.season_number || 1
            );

            if (!grouped.has(season)) grouped.set(season, []);

            const ext = episode.container_extension || 'mp4';

            grouped.get(season).push({
                ...episode,
                name:episode.title || episode.name || 'Bölüm',
                title:episode.title || episode.name || 'Bölüm',
                url:provider.host.replace(/\/+$/, '') +
                    '/series/' +
                    encodeURIComponent(provider.username) + '/' +
                    encodeURIComponent(provider.password) + '/' +
                    episode.id + '.' + ext
            });
        }

        const seasonNumbers = Array.from(grouped.keys()).sort((a,b) => a-b);

        area.innerHTML = `
            <div class="isa-vod-toolbar">
                <button class="isa-back" id="isa-xtream-series-back">
                    <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i> Geri
                </button>
                <h2>${esc(series.name)}</h2>
            </div>
            <div class="isa-provider-grid">
                ${seasonNumbers.map((number,index) => `
                    <button class="isa-provider-card"
                            data-xseason="${index}">
                        <i class="fas fa-layer-group"
                           style="font-size:32px;padding:20px"></i>
                        <strong>Sezon ${number}</strong>
                        <small>${grouped.get(number).length} bölüm</small>
                    </button>
                `).join('')}
            </div>
        `;

        document.getElementById('isa-xtream-series-back').onclick =
            () => openVODProvider(provider);

        area.querySelectorAll('[data-xseason]').forEach(button => {
            button.onclick = () => showEpisodes(
                grouped.get(seasonNumbers[
                    Number(button.dataset.xseason)
                ]),
                series,
                provider
            );
        });

        if (!seasonNumbers.length) {
            area.innerHTML +=
                '<p class="isa-vod-note">Bu dizide bölüm bulunamadı.</p>';
        }

    } catch(error) {
        area.innerHTML =
            '<p class="isa-vod-note">Dizi bilgileri alınamadı: ' +
            esc(error.message) + '</p>';
    }
}

function seasonNumber(item) {
    const explicit = item.season_number ?? item.season;
    if (explicit !== undefined && explicit !== null &&
        Number.isFinite(Number(explicit))) {
        return Number(explicit);
    }

    const title = String(item.title || item.name || '');
    const patterns = [
        /(?:^|\b)(\d+)\s*\.?\s*(?:sezon|season)\b/i,
        /(?:season|sezon)\s*0*(\d+)/i,
        /\bS0*(\d+)E0*\d+\b/i,
        /\b0*(\d+)x0*\d+\b/i
    ];

    for (const pattern of patterns) {
        const match = title.match(pattern);
        if (match) return Number(match[1]);
    }
    return 1;
}



function showSeries(series,provider) {
    const area = document.getElementById('isa-vod-items');
    let episodes = series.episodes || [];
    const seasons = series.seasons || [];

    if (seasons.length) {
        const grouped = seasons.map((season,index) => ({
            number:season.number||season.season||index+1,
            episodes:season.episodes||[]
        }));

        area.innerHTML = `
            <div class="isa-vod-toolbar">
                <button class="isa-back" id="isa-series-back"><i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i> Geri</button>
                <h2>${esc(series.name)}</h2>
            </div>
            ${series.poster ? `<img src="${esc(series.poster)}" style="width:130px;max-height:180px;object-fit:contain">` : ''}
            <div class="isa-provider-grid">
                ${grouped.map((season,index) => `
                    <button class="isa-provider-card" data-season="${index}">
                        <i class="fas fa-layer-group" style="font-size:32px;padding:20px"></i>
                        <strong>${esc('Sezon '+season.number)}</strong>
                        <small>${season.episodes.length} bölüm</small>
                    </button>
                `).join('')}
            </div>
        `;

        document.getElementById('isa-series-back').onclick = () => openVODProvider(provider);

        area.querySelectorAll('[data-season]').forEach(button => {
            button.onclick = () => showEpisodes(
                grouped[Number(button.dataset.season)].episodes,
                series,
                provider
            );
        });

        return;
    }

    if (!episodes.length) episodes = series.items || [];

    if (!episodes.length) {
        area.innerHTML = `
            <div class="isa-vod-toolbar">
                <button class="isa-back" id="isa-series-back">Geri</button>
                <h2>${esc(series.name)}</h2>
            </div>
            <p class="isa-vod-note">Bu dizinin JSON kaynağında bölüm listesi bulunmuyor.</p>
        `;
        document.getElementById('isa-series-back').onclick = () => openVODProvider(provider);
        return;
    }

    const grouped = new Map();

    episodes.forEach(episode => {
        const number = seasonNumber(episode);
        if (!grouped.has(number)) grouped.set(number,[]);
        grouped.get(number).push(episode);
    });

    if (grouped.size >= 1) {
        area.innerHTML = `
            <div class="isa-vod-toolbar">
                <button class="isa-back" id="isa-series-back">Geri</button>
                <h2>${esc(series.name)}</h2>
            </div>
            <div class="isa-provider-grid">
                ${Array.from(grouped.entries()).map(([number,eps],index) => `
                    <button class="isa-provider-card" data-season="${index}">
                        <i class="fas fa-layer-group" style="font-size:32px;padding:20px"></i>
                        <strong>Sezon ${number}</strong>
                        <small>${eps.length} bölüm</small>
                    </button>
                `).join('')}
            </div>
        `;

        const values = Array.from(grouped.values());
        document.getElementById('isa-series-back').onclick = () => openVODProvider(provider);

        area.querySelectorAll('[data-season]').forEach(button => {
            button.onclick = () => showEpisodes(values[Number(button.dataset.season)],series,provider);
        });
    } else {
        showEpisodes(episodes,series,provider);
    }
}

function showEpisodes(episodes,series,provider) {
    const area = document.getElementById('isa-vod-items');

    area.innerHTML = `
        <div class="isa-vod-toolbar">
            <button class="isa-back" id="isa-episodes-back">
                <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i> Geri
            </button>
            <h2>${esc(series.name)}</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="isa-provider-grid">
            ${episodes.map((episode,index) => `
                <button class="isa-provider-card" data-episode="${index}">
                    <i class="fas fa-circle-play" style="font-size:35px;padding:20px"></i>
                    <strong>${esc(episode.title||episode.name||('Bölüm '+(index+1)))}</strong>
                    <small>${esc(episode.date||'Bölümü aç')}</small>
                </button>
            `).join('')}
        </div>
    `;

    document.getElementById('isa-episodes-back').onclick = () => showSeries(series,provider);

    area.querySelectorAll('[data-episode]').forEach(button => {
        button.onclick = () => openVODItem(episodes[Number(button.dataset.episode)]);
    });
}


async function resolveStaticMedia(page, depth=0, visited=new Set()) {
    if (!isHttp(page) || depth > 2 || visited.has(page)) return null;
    visited.add(page);

    let html;
    try {
        html = await nativeFetch(page);
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('VOD sayfası okunamadı:', e);
        return null;
    }

    if (!html) return null;

    const patterns = [
        /<source[^>]+src=["']([^"']+\.(?:m3u8|mp4|webm)(?:\?[^"']*)?)["']/ig,
        /<video[^>]+src=["']([^"']+\.(?:m3u8|mp4|webm)(?:\?[^"']*)?)["']/ig,
        /(?:file|source|src|hls|playlist)\s*[:=]\s*["']([^"']+\.(?:m3u8|mp4|webm)(?:\?[^"']*)?)["']/ig,
        /<meta[^>]+property=["']og:video["'][^>]+content=["']([^"']+)["']/ig
    ];

    for (const pattern of patterns) {
        let match;
        while ((match = pattern.exec(html)) !== null) {
            try {
                const candidate = new URL(
                    match[1].replace(/&amp;/g,'&'),
                    page
                ).href;

                if (isDirectMedia(candidate)) {
                    return candidate;
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }
    }

    // Yalnızca sayfada açıkça belirtilmiş iframe adreslerini kontrol et.
    const iframePattern = /<iframe[^>]+src=["']([^"']+)["']/ig;
    let iframe;

    while ((iframe = iframePattern.exec(html)) !== null) {
        try {
            const child = new URL(iframe[1],page).href;
            if (!isHttp(child)) continue;

            const found = await resolveStaticMedia(
                child,
                depth+1,
                visited
            );

            if (found) return found;
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    return null;
}

async function openVODItem(item) {
    const candidates = [
        item.videoUrl,
        item.video_url,
        item.playUrl,
        item.stream,
        item.file,
        item.url,
        item.link,
        item.embedUrl
    ].filter(Boolean);

    const media = candidates.find(isDirectMedia);

    if (media) {
        play({
            name:item.title||item.name||'İSA Flix',
            url:media,
            logo:item.poster||item.logo||'',
            group:'İSA Flix',
            headers:item.headers||{}
        },[],0);
        return;
    }

    const page = candidates.find(isHttp);

    if (!page) {
        alert('Bu içerik için geçerli bir bağlantı bulunamadı.');
        return;
    }

    const area = document.getElementById('isa-vod-items');
    const note = document.createElement('p');
    note.className = 'isa-vod-note';
    note.textContent = 'Video kaynağı aranıyor...';
    area.prepend(note);

    try {
        const resolved = await resolveStaticMedia(page);

        note.remove();

        if (!resolved) {
            alert(
                'Bu kaynağın sayfasında doğrudan ve erişilebilir ' +
                'bir video adresi bulunamadı. Kaynak dinamik oynatıcı ' +
                'veya erişim koruması kullanıyor olabilir.'
            );
            return;
        }

        play({
            name:item.title||item.name||'İSA Flix',
            url:resolved,
            logo:item.poster||item.logo||'',
            group:'İSA Flix',
            headers:{
                ...(item.headers||{}),
                Referer:page
            }
        },[],0);

    } catch (error) {
        note.remove();
        console.error('VOD çözümleme hatası:',error);
        alert('Video kaynağı çözümlenemedi: '+error.message);
    }
}

async function refreshAll(forceRefresh=false) {
    const status = document.getElementById('isa-live-status');
    status.textContent = forceRefresh
        ? 'Kaynaklar güncelleniyor...'
        : 'Önbellek ve kayıtlı listeler yükleniyor...';

    let live = [];
    let user = [];

    try {
        live = await loadLiveChannels(forceRefresh);
    } catch(error) {
        console.error('Güneş TV:',error);
    }

    try {
        user = await loadUserLists(forceRefresh);
    } catch(error) {
        console.error('Kullanıcı listeleri:',error);
    }

    channels = [];
    for (const channel of live) channels.push(channel);
    for (const channel of user) channels.push(channel);
    renderChannels();
    renderSavedLists();

    status.textContent = '';
    playlists.forEach(p => { if (p.type === 'xtream' && !p.lastCount) p.lastCount = user.length; });
    renderSavedLists();

    // Film ve dizi panelleri kaynakları hesap bazında ayrı tutar.
    renderMediaPanel('film');
    renderMediaPanel('series');
    // İSA Flix bu sürümde bilerek boş bırakılmıştır.
}


function renderSourceFields() {
    const type = document.getElementById('isa-source-type').value;
    const box = document.getElementById('isa-source-fields');

    if (!box) return;

    if (type === 'm3u') {
        box.innerHTML = `
            <label class="isa-field-label">M3U URL</label>
            <input id="isa-new-m3u-url" class="isa-source-input"
                   type="url" placeholder="https://site.com/list.m3u">
            <small class="isa-field-hint">
                İsim girmeniz gerekmez. Liste otomatik adlandırılır.
            </small>
        `;
    } else if (type === 'xtream') {
        box.innerHTML = `
            <label class="isa-field-label">Host adresi</label>
            <input id="isa-xt-host" class="isa-source-input"
                   placeholder="http://sunucu.com veya http://sunucu.com:8080">

            <div id="isa-xt-port-wrap">
                <label class="isa-field-label">Port</label>
                <input id="isa-xt-port" class="isa-source-input"
                       inputmode="numeric" placeholder="8080">
            </div>

            <label class="isa-field-label">Kullanıcı adı</label>
            <input id="isa-xt-user" class="isa-source-input"
                   autocomplete="username" placeholder="Kullanıcı adı">

            <label class="isa-field-label">Şifre</label>
            <input id="isa-xt-pass" class="isa-source-input"
                   type="password" autocomplete="current-password"
                   placeholder="Şifre">

            <small class="isa-field-hint">
                Host içinde port varsa ayrı port alanı otomatik gizlenir.
            </small>
        `;

        const host = document.getElementById('isa-xt-host');
        host.addEventListener('input', () => {
            try {
                const parsed = sourceHost(host.value);
                document.getElementById('isa-xt-port-wrap')
                    .style.display = parsed.hasPort ? 'none' : '';
            } catch(error) {
                document.getElementById('isa-xt-port-wrap')
                    .style.display = '';
            }
        });

    } else if (type === 'mag') {
        box.innerHTML = `
            <label class="isa-field-label">Portal host adresi</label>
            <input id="isa-mag-host" class="isa-source-input"
                   placeholder="http://portal.site.com">

            <label class="isa-field-label">MAC adresi</label>
            <input id="isa-mag-mac" class="isa-source-input"
                   placeholder="00:1A:79:XX:XX:XX">

            <small class="isa-field-hint">
                MAG portalı MAC adresiyle yetkilendirmeyi desteklemelidir.
            </small>
        `;
    } else {
        box.innerHTML = '';
    }
}

async function addXtreamSource(host,user,pass) {
    const source = {
        host,
        username:user,
        password:pass
    };

    sourceLoading(true, 'Xtream hesabı kontrol ediliyor...');

    const auth = await xtreamAPI(source, 'get_live_categories');

    if (!Array.isArray(auth)) {
        throw new Error('Xtream API yanıtı geçersiz.');
    }

    playlists.push({
        ...source,
        type:'xtream',
        name:nextSourceName('xtream'),
        text:''
    });

    saveLists();
    await refreshAll(false);
}

async function addSource() {
    const type = document.getElementById('isa-source-type').value;
    if (!type) {
        alert('Önce kaynak türünü seçin.');
        return;
    }

    sourceLoading(true, 'Kaynak kontrol ediliyor...');

    try {
        if (type === 'm3u') {
            const url = document.getElementById(
                'isa-new-m3u-url'
            ).value.trim();

            if (!isHttp(url)) {
                throw new Error('Geçerli HTTP/HTTPS M3U adresi girin.');
            }

            await addM3UUrl(url);

        } else if (type === 'xtream') {
            const hostInput = document.getElementById('isa-xt-host').value;
            const user = document.getElementById('isa-xt-user').value.trim();
            const pass = document.getElementById('isa-xt-pass').value;

            if (!hostInput.trim() || !user || !pass) {
                throw new Error('Host, kullanıcı adı ve şifre zorunludur.');
            }

            let parsed = sourceHost(hostInput);

            if (!parsed.hasPort) {
                const port = document.getElementById('isa-xt-port').value.trim();
                if (!port || !/^\d{1,5}$/.test(port) ||
                    Number(port) < 1 || Number(port) > 65535) {
                    throw new Error('Geçerli bir port girin.');
                }

                parsed.host = parsed.host.replace(/\/+$/, '') +
                    ':' + port;
            }

            await addXtreamSource(parsed.host,user,pass);

        } else if (type === 'mag') {
            const host = sourceHost(
                document.getElementById('isa-mag-host').value
            ).host;

            const mac = document.getElementById(
                'isa-mag-mac'
            ).value.trim().toUpperCase();

            if (!/^([0-9A-F]{2}:){5}[0-9A-F]{2}$/.test(mac)) {
                throw new Error('MAC adresini 00:1A:79:XX:XX:XX biçiminde girin.');
            }

            const source = {
                host,
                mac,
                type:'mag',
                name:nextSourceName('mag')
            };

            await loadMagChannels(source);

            playlists.push(source);
            saveLists();
            await refreshAll(false);
        }

        document.getElementById('isa-upload-status').textContent =
            'Kaynak başarıyla eklendi.';

        document.getElementById('isa-source-type').value = '';
        renderSourceFields();
        const form=document.getElementById('isa-source-form'); if(form) form.hidden=true;
        const toggle=document.getElementById('isa-toggle-source-form'); if(toggle) toggle.textContent='＋ Liste ekle';

    } catch(error) {
        document.getElementById('isa-upload-status').textContent =
            error.message || 'Kaynak eklenemedi.';
        console.error(error);
    } finally {
        sourceLoading(false);
    }
}

function bindControls() {
    document.getElementById('isa-source-type').onchange =
        renderSourceFields;

    document.getElementById('isa-source-add').onclick = addSource;

    document.getElementById('isa-m3u-file').onchange = async event => {
        const file = event.target.files[0];
        if (!file) return;

        sourceLoading(true, 'M3U dosyası okunuyor...');

        try {
            const text = await file.text();

            if (!text.includes('#EXTM3U') &&
                !text.includes('#EXTINF:')) {
                throw new Error('Geçerli M3U dosyası değil.');
            }

            playlists.push({
                name:nextSourceName('m3u'),
                type:'file',
                text
            });

            saveLists();
            await refreshAll(false);

            document.getElementById('isa-upload-status').textContent =
                'M3U listesi eklendi.';

        } catch(error) {
            document.getElementById('isa-upload-status').textContent =
                error.message;
        } finally {
            sourceLoading(false);
            event.target.value = '';
        }
    };

    const sourceToggle = document.getElementById('isa-toggle-source-form');
    const sourceForm = document.getElementById('isa-source-form');
    if (sourceToggle && sourceForm) sourceToggle.onclick = () => {
        sourceForm.hidden = !sourceForm.hidden;
        sourceToggle.textContent = sourceForm.hidden ? '＋ Liste ekle' : '− Kapat';
    };

    document.getElementById('isa-refresh').onclick = () =>
        refreshAll(true);

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(button => {
        button.onclick = () => {
            document.querySelectorAll('.isa-tab').forEach(tab =>
                tab.classList.remove('active')
            );

            document.querySelectorAll('.isa-panel').forEach(panel =>
                panel.classList.remove('active')
            );

            button.classList.add('active');
            document.getElementById(button.dataset.tab)
                .classList.add('active');

            window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
            renderSavedLists();
            if (button.dataset.tab === 'isa-films-panel') renderMediaPanel('film');
            if (button.dataset.tab === 'isa-series-panel') renderMediaPanel('series');
        };
    });
}



// === İSA TV HD: bağımsız film/dizi kaynakları ve kategori gezintisi ===
const isaMediaMemory = { film: new Map(), series: new Map() };
function mediaSourceKey(source) { return [source.type,source.host||source.url||source.name||'',source.username||'',source.name||''].join('|'); }
async function renderMediaPanel(kind) {
    const root = document.getElementById(
        kind === 'film' ? 'isa-films-content' : 'isa-series-content'
    );
    if (!root) return;

    const source = playlists.length ? playlists[playlists.length - 1] : null;

    if (!source) {
        root.innerHTML = '<p class="isa-empty-state">Henüz giriş yapılmış bir kaynak bulunamadı.</p>';
        return;
    }

    if (!['xtream', 'file', 'url', 'm3u-url'].includes(source.type)) {
        root.innerHTML = '<p class="isa-empty-state">Aktif hesap film ve dizi içeriklerini desteklemiyor.</p>';
        return;
    }

    await openMediaSource(source, kind, root);
}

function renderMediaGroups(groups,source,kind,root) {
    root.innerHTML = `<div class="isa-vod-toolbar"><h2>${esc(source.name||'Liste')}</h2></div><div class="isa-provider-grid">${Array.from(groups.keys()).map((g,i)=>`<button class="isa-provider-card" data-media-cat="${i}"><i class="fas ${kind==='film'?'fa-folder-open':'fa-folder'}"></i><strong>${esc(cleanGroupTitle(g))}</strong><small>${groups.get(g).length} içerik</small></button>`).join('')}</div>${groups.size?'':'<p class="isa-vod-note">Bu kaynakta bu türde içerik bulunamadı.</p>'}`;
    const names = Array.from(groups.keys());
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-media-cat]').forEach(b =>
        b.onclick = () => renderMediaItems(
            groups.get(names[Number(b.dataset.mediaCat)]),
            kind, source, root, names[Number(b.dataset.mediaCat)]
        )
    );
}

async function openMediaSource(source,kind,root) {
    localStorage.setItem('isa-active-media-'+kind,mediaSourceKey(source));
    const cacheKey=mediaSourceKey(source);
    if (isaMediaMemory[kind].has(cacheKey)) { renderMediaGroups(isaMediaMemory[kind].get(cacheKey),source,kind,root); return; }
    root.innerHTML = '<p class="isa-loading">Kaynak içerikleri yükleniyor...</p>';
    try {
        let items = [], categories = new Map();
        if (source.type === 'xtream') {
            const action = kind === 'film' ? 'get_vod_streams' : 'get_series';
            const catAction = kind === 'film' ? 'get_vod_categories' : 'get_series_categories';
            const [data,cats] = await Promise.all([xtreamAPI(source,action),xtreamAPI(source,catAction).catch(()=>[])]);
            for (const c of (Array.isArray(cats)?cats:[])) categories.set(String(c.category_id),c.category_name || 'Genel');
            items = (Array.isArray(data)?data:[]).map(x => ({
                name:x.name || (kind==='film'?'Film':'Dizi'),
                logo:x.stream_icon || x.cover || '',
                category:categories.get(String(x.category_id)) || 'Genel',
                raw:x, source, kind,
                url:kind==='film' ? source.host.replace(/\/+$/,'')+'/movie/'+encodeURIComponent(source.username)+'/'+encodeURIComponent(source.password)+'/'+x.stream_id+'.'+(x.container_extension||'mp4') : ''
            }));
        } else {
            let text = source.text;
            if (!text && source.url) text = await getText(source.url,true);
            const parsed = parseM3U(text || '', 'media');
            items = parsed.filter(x => {
                const g=String(x.group||'').toLocaleLowerCase('tr');
                const n=String(x.name||'').toLocaleLowerCase('tr');
                return kind==='film' ? /film|movie|sinema/.test(g+' '+n) : /dizi|series|season|sezon|episode|bölüm/.test(g+' '+n);
            }).map(x=>({...x,category:x.group||'Genel',kind,source}));
        }
        const groups = new Map();
        for (const item of items) { const c=cleanGroupTitle(item.category||'Genel'); item.category=c; if (!groups.has(c)) groups.set(c,[]); groups.get(c).push(item); }
        isaMediaMemory[kind].set(cacheKey,groups);
        renderMediaGroups(groups,source,kind,root);
    } catch(e) {
        root.innerHTML=`<button class="isa-back" data-media-back>Tekrar dene</button><p class="isa-vod-note">Kaynak yüklenemedi: ${esc(e.message)}</p>`;
        root.querySelector('[data-media-back]').onclick=()=>renderMediaPanel(kind);
    }
}

const isaSeriesMetaCache = new Map();

async function isaGetSeriesMeta(item) {
    const id = item.raw && item.raw.series_id;
    if (!id) return null;
    const key = [item.source.host,item.source.username,id].join('|');
    if (isaSeriesMetaCache.has(key)) return isaSeriesMetaCache.get(key);
    const info = await xtreamAPI(item.source,'get_series_info',{series_id:id});
    const eps = info && info.episodes ? info.episodes : {};
    const seasonKeys = Array.isArray(eps) ? ['1'] : Object.keys(eps);
    let total = 0, maxSeason = 0;
    for (const k of seasonKeys) {
        const list = Array.isArray(eps) ? eps : (Array.isArray(eps[k]) ? eps[k] : []);
        total += list.length;
        const n = Number(k);
        if (Number.isFinite(n)) maxSeason = Math.max(maxSeason,n);
        for (const ep of list) maxSeason = Math.max(maxSeason,Number(ep.season||ep.season_number||0)||0);
    }
    const seasons = Array.isArray(info.seasons) ? info.seasons : [];
    for (const season of seasons) maxSeason = Math.max(maxSeason,Number(season.season_number||season.season||0)||0);
    const result = {maxSeason,total};
    isaSeriesMetaCache.set(key,result);
    return result;
}

async function isaFillSeriesMeta(items,root) {
    const cards = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('[data-media-item]'));
    let cursor = 0;
    const workers = Array.from({length:Math.min(3,items.length)},async()=>{
        while(cursor < items.length) {
            const i=cursor++;
            const item=items[i], card=cards[i];
            if (!card || !item || !item.raw || !item.raw.series_id) continue;
            const small=card.querySelector('small');
            if (small) small.textContent='Dizi bilgileri alınıyor...';
            try {
                const meta=await isaGetSeriesMeta(item);
                if (small && card.isConnected && meta) {
                    const seasonText=meta.maxSeason ? `Sezon ${meta.maxSeason}` : 'Sezon bilgisi yok';
                    const strong=card.querySelector('strong');
                    if (strong) strong.textContent=cleanMediaTitle(item.name);
                    small.textContent='Dizi';
                }
            } catch(e) { if(small && card.isConnected) small.textContent='Bölüm bilgisi alınamadı'; }
        }
    });
    await Promise.all(workers);
}

function renderMediaItems(items,kind,source,root,category) {
    root.innerHTML=`<div class="isa-vod-toolbar"><button class="isa-back" data-media-back>Kategoriler</button><h2>${esc(cleanGroupTitle(category))}</h2></div><div class="isa-provider-grid">${
        items.map((item,i)=>`<button class="isa-provider-card" data-media-item="${i}">${item.logo?`<img src="${esc(item.logo)}" alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" onerror="this.style.display='none'">`:'<i class="fas '+(kind==='film'?'fa-film':'fa-tv')+'" style="font-size:30px;padding:16px"></i>'}<strong>${esc(cleanMediaTitle(item.name))}</strong><small>${kind==='film'?'Filmi oynat':(source.type==='xtream'?'Dizi bilgileri alınıyor...':'Diziyi aç')}</small></button>`).join('')
    }</div>`;
    root.querySelector('[data-media-back]').onclick=()=>openMediaSource(source,kind,root);
    if (kind==='series' && source.type==='xtream') isaFillSeriesMeta(items,root);
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-media-item]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
        const item=items[Number(b.dataset.mediaItem)];
        if(kind==='film') {
            if(!isHttp(item.url)) { alert('Bu film için geçerli yayın bağlantısı bulunamadı.'); return; }
            const queue=items.filter(x=>isHttp(x.url)).map(x=>({name:cleanMediaTitle(x.name),url:x.url,logo:x.logo||'',group:category,headers:x.headers||{}}));
            const idx=queue.findIndex(x=>x.url===item.url); play(queue[idx],queue,Math.max(0,idx),false);
        } else if(source.type==='xtream') {
            openMediaSeries(item,source,root,kind,category);
        } else {
            if(isHttp(item.url)) { const queue=items.filter(x=>isHttp(x.url)).map((x,i)=>({name:cleanMediaTitle(x.name),url:x.url,logo:x.logo||'',group:category,season:x.season||0,episode:i+1,headers:x.headers||{}})); const idx=queue.findIndex(x=>x.url===item.url); play(queue[idx],queue,Math.max(0,idx),false); }
            else alert('Bu dizi kaynağında bölüm bağlantısı bulunamadı.');
        }
    });
}

async function openMediaSeries(series,source,root,kind,category) {
    root.innerHTML='<p class="isa-loading">Sezonlar yükleniyor...</p>';
    try {
        const info=await xtreamAPI(source,'get_series_info',{series_id:series.raw.series_id});
        const raw=info.episodes||{}, all=[];
        if(Array.isArray(raw)) { for(const ep of raw) all.push(ep); }
        else for(const key of Object.keys(raw)) if(Array.isArray(raw[key])) for(const ep of raw[key]) all.push(ep);
        const seasons=new Map();
        for(const ep of all) {
            const sn=Number(ep.season||ep.season_number||1);
            if(!seasons.has(sn)) seasons.set(sn,[]);
            const ext=ep.container_extension||'mp4';
            seasons.get(sn).push({name:(Number(ep.episode_num||ep.episode_number||seasons.get(sn).length+1))+'. Bölüm',season:sn,episode:Number(ep.episode_num||ep.episode_number||seasons.get(sn).length+1),url:source.host.replace(/\/+$/,'')+'/series/'+encodeURIComponent(source.username)+'/'+encodeURIComponent(source.password)+'/'+ep.id+'.'+ext});
        }
        const nums=Array.from(seasons.keys()).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
        root.innerHTML=`<div class="isa-vod-toolbar"><button class="isa-back" data-series-back>Kategoriler</button><h2>${esc(series.name)}</h2></div><div class="isa-provider-grid">${nums.map((n,i)=>`<button class="isa-provider-card" data-season="${i}"><strong>Sezon ${n}</strong><small>${seasons.get(n).length} bölüm</small></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
        root.querySelector('[data-series-back]').onclick=()=>openMediaSource(source,kind,root);
        root.querySelectorAll('[data-season]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
            const episodes=seasons.get(nums[Number(b.dataset.season)]);
            root.innerHTML=`<div class="isa-vod-toolbar"><button class="isa-back" data-episode-back>Sezonlar</button><h2>${esc(series.name)} · Sezon ${nums[Number(b.dataset.season)]}</h2></div><div class="isa-provider-grid">${episodes.map((ep,i)=>`<button class="isa-provider-card" data-ep="${i}"><i class="fas fa-circle-play" style="font-size:28px;padding:14px"></i><strong>${esc(ep.name)}</strong><small>Bölümü oynat</small></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
            root.querySelector('[data-episode-back]').onclick=()=>openMediaSeries(series,source,root,kind,category);
            root.querySelectorAll('[data-ep]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{const ep=episodes[Number(x.dataset.ep)];const queue=episodes.map((e,i)=>({name:cleanMediaTitle(series.name),url:e.url,group:category,season:e.season,episode:e.episode,headers:{}})); const idx=Number(x.dataset.ep); play(queue[idx],queue,idx,false);});
        });
        if(!nums.length) root.innerHTML+='<p class="isa-vod-note">Bu dizide bölüm bulunamadı.</p>';
    } catch(e) { root.innerHTML=`<p class="isa-vod-note">Dizi bilgileri alınamadı: ${esc(e.message)}</p>`; }
}

function initScrollArrows() {
    if (document.getElementById('isa-scroll-arrows')) return;
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.id = 'isa-scroll-arrows';
    box.innerHTML = '<button type="button" aria-label="Yukarı çık">▲</button><button type="button" aria-label="Sayfanın sonuna in">▼</button>';
    document.body.appendChild(box);
    const buttons = box.querySelectorAll('button');
    buttons[0].onclick = () => window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
    buttons[1].onclick = () => window.scrollTo({top:document.documentElement.scrollHeight,behavior:'smooth'});
    let lastY = window.scrollY, lastT = performance.now(), hideTimer = 0;
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
        const now = performance.now(), y = window.scrollY;
        const speed = Math.abs(y-lastY) / Math.max(1,now-lastT);
        lastY=y; lastT=now;
        const canScroll = document.documentElement.scrollHeight > window.innerHeight + 120;
        if (canScroll && speed > 0.22) {
            box.classList.add('visible');
            buttons[0].style.visibility = y > 180 ? 'visible' : 'hidden';
            buttons[1].style.visibility = y < document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight-100 ? 'visible' : 'hidden';
            clearTimeout(hideTimer); hideTimer=setTimeout(()=>box.classList.remove('visible'),950);
        } else if (speed <= 0.22) {
            clearTimeout(hideTimer); hideTimer=setTimeout(()=>box.classList.remove('visible'),500);
        }
    },{passive:true});
}




// ============================================================
// İSA FLIX - DOMINO TAM KATALOG
// Canlı TV + Filmler + Diziler
// ============================================================

const isaFlixState = {
    mode: 'live',
    category: '',
    query: '',
    items: [],
    shown: 0,
    batch: 100,
    series: null,
    season: null
};

function isaFlixCatalog() {
    return window.ISA_DOMINO_CATALOG || dominoLastData || {};
}

function isaFlixArray(value) {
    return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
}

function isaFlixText(value, fallback='') {
    return String(value == null ? fallback : value);
}

function isaFlixHeaders(item) {
    const headers = {...(item.headers || {})};
    if (item.referer) headers.Referer = item.referer;
    if (item.user_agent) headers['User-Agent'] = item.user_agent;
    return headers;
}

function isaFlixModeItems(data, mode) {
    if (mode === 'live') return isaFlixArray(data.live_channels);
    if (mode === 'movies') return isaFlixArray(data.movies);
    return isaFlixArray(data.series);
}

function isaFlixCategory(item, mode) {
    if (mode === 'live') return isaFlixText(item.category_name, 'Genel');
    if (mode === 'movies') return isaFlixText(item.category_name, 'Diğer');
    return isaFlixText(item.platform_name || item.category_name, 'Diğer');
}

function isaFlixCategories(data, mode) {
    let source = [];
    if (mode === 'live') source = isaFlixArray(data.live_categories);
    if (mode === 'movies') source = isaFlixArray(data.movie_categories);
    if (mode === 'series') source = isaFlixArray(data.series_platforms);

    let names = source.map(x => isaFlixText(x.name).trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!names.length) {
        names = [...new Set(isaFlixModeItems(data, mode).map(x =>
            isaFlixCategory(x, mode)
        ))];
    }
    return [...new Set(names)];
}

function isaFlixRoot() {
    return document.getElementById('isa-flix-app');
}

function isaFlixOpen() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('isa-flix-panel');
    return !!(panel && panel.classList.contains('active'));
}

function isaFlixRender() {
    const root = isaFlixRoot();
    if (!root) return;

    const data = isaFlixCatalog();
    const modes = [
        ['live', 'Canlı TV', 'fa-tv'],
        ['movies', 'Filmler', 'fa-film'],
        ['series', 'Diziler', 'fa-clapperboard']
    ];

    const totalLive = isaFlixArray(data.live_channels).length;
    const totalMovies = isaFlixArray(data.movies).length;
    const totalSeries = isaFlixArray(data.series).length;

    root.innerHTML = `
        <div class="isaf-header">
            <div class="isaf-brand"><span>İSA</span> FLIX</div>
            <div class="isaf-count">
                ${totalLive.toLocaleString('tr-TR')} kanal ·
                ${totalMovies.toLocaleString('tr-TR')} film ·
                ${totalSeries.toLocaleString('tr-TR')} dizi
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="isaf-tabs">
            ${modes.map(([id,label,icon]) => `
                <button type="button" data-isaf-mode="${id}"
                    class="${isaFlixState.mode===id?'active':''}">
                    <i class="fas ${icon}"></i> ${label}
                </button>
            `).join('')}
        </div>
        <div class="isaf-tools">
            <input id="isaf-search" type="search"
                placeholder="İçerik ara..." value="${esc(isaFlixState.query)}">
            <select id="isaf-category">
                <option value="">Bütün kategoriler</option>
                ${isaFlixCategories(data,isaFlixState.mode).map(name => `
                    <option value="${esc(name)}"
                        ${isaFlixState.category===name?'selected':''}>
                        ${esc(name)}
                    </option>
                `).join('')}
            </select>
        </div>
        <div id="isaf-status" class="isaf-status"></div>
        <div id="isaf-grid" class="isaf-grid"></div>
        <button id="isaf-more" class="isaf-more" type="button">
            Daha fazla içerik yükle
        </button>
    `;

    root.querySelectorAll('[data-isaf-mode]').forEach(button => {
        button.onclick = () => {
            isaFlixState.mode = button.dataset.isafMode;
            isaFlixState.category = '';
            isaFlixState.query = '';
            isaFlixState.series = null;
            isaFlixRender();
        };
    });

    const search = document.getElementById('isaf-search');
    const category = document.getElementById('isaf-category');

    search.oninput = () => {
        isaFlixState.query = search.value;
        isaFlixRenderItems();
    };

    category.onchange = () => {
        isaFlixState.category = category.value;
        isaFlixRenderItems();
    };

    isaFlixRenderItems();
}

function isaFlixRenderItems() {
    const data = isaFlixCatalog();
    const grid = document.getElementById('isaf-grid');
    const status = document.getElementById('isaf-status');
    const more = document.getElementById('isaf-more');
    if (!grid || !status || !more) return;

    const mode = isaFlixState.mode;
    const query = isaFlixState.query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase('tr');
    const category = isaFlixState.category;

    let items = isaFlixModeItems(data, mode);

    items = items.filter(item => {
        if (category && isaFlixCategory(item,mode) !== category) return false;
        if (!query) return true;

        const text = [
            item.name, item.title, item.category_name,
            item.platform_name, item.description, item.year
        ].join(' ').toLocaleLowerCase('tr');

        return text.includes(query);
    });

    isaFlixState.items = items;
    isaFlixState.shown = 0;
    grid.innerHTML = '';

    status.textContent =
        items.length.toLocaleString('tr-TR') + ' içerik bulundu.';

    if (!items.length) {
        grid.innerHTML = '<p class="isa-vod-note">Bu aramada içerik bulunamadı.</p>';
        more.hidden = true;
        return;
    }

    more.hidden = false;
    more.onclick = isaFlixLoadMore;
    isaFlixLoadMore();
}

function isaFlixLoadMore() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('isaf-grid');
    const more = document.getElementById('isaf-more');
    const status = document.getElementById('isaf-status');
    if (!grid || !more) return;

    const items = isaFlixState.items;
    const start = isaFlixState.shown;
    const end = Math.min(start + isaFlixState.batch, items.length);
    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();

    for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
        const item = items[i];
        const mode = isaFlixState.mode;
        const title = item.title || item.name || 'İsimsiz içerik';
        const image = item.poster_url || item.logo_url ||
            item.image_url || item.poster || item.image || '';
        const detail = mode === 'live'
            ? isaFlixCategory(item,mode)
            : [item.year, isaFlixCategory(item,mode)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');

        const card = document.createElement('button');
        card.type = 'button';
        card.className = 'isaf-card';

        const img = document.createElement('img');
        img.loading = 'lazy';
        img.decoding = 'async';
        img.alt = '';
        img.src = image;
        img.onerror = () => { img.style.display = 'none'; };

        const name = document.createElement('strong');
        name.textContent = cleanMediaTitle(title);

        const small = document.createElement('small');
        small.textContent = detail;

        if (image) card.appendChild(img);
        else {
            const icon = document.createElement('i');
            icon.className = 'fas ' + (mode==='live'?'fa-tv':'fa-film');
            card.appendChild(icon);
        }

        card.append(name,small);
        card.onclick = () => isaFlixOpenItem(item, i);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
    }

    grid.appendChild(fragment);
    isaFlixState.shown = end;

    status.textContent =
        end.toLocaleString('tr-TR') + ' / ' +
        items.length.toLocaleString('tr-TR') + ' içerik gösteriliyor.';

    more.hidden = end >= items.length;
}

function isaFlixOpenItem(item) {
    const mode = isaFlixState.mode;

    if (mode === 'live') {
        const data = isaFlixCatalog();
        const category = isaFlixCategory(item,'live');
        const queue = isaFlixArray(data.live_channels)
            .filter(x => isaFlixCategory(x,'live') === category)
            .filter(x => /^https?:\/\//i.test(String(x.stream_url||'')))
            .map(x => ({
                name:x.name || 'Kanal',
                url:x.stream_url,
                logo:x.logo_url || x.image_url || x.poster_url || '',
                group:category,
                headers:isaFlixHeaders(x),
                is_live:true
            }));

        const index = queue.findIndex(x => x.url === item.stream_url);
        if (index >= 0) play(queue[index],queue,index,true);
        else alert('Bu kanal için geçerli yayın bağlantısı bulunamadı.');
        return;
    }

    if (mode === 'movies') {
        const url = item.stream_url || '';
        if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) {
            alert('Bu film için geçerli yayın bağlantısı bulunamadı.');
            return;
        }

        openVODItem({
            name:item.title || item.name || 'Film',
            title:item.title || item.name || 'Film',
            url,
            videoUrl:url,
            poster:item.poster_url || item.image_url || '',
            logo:item.poster_url || item.image_url || '',
            headers:isaFlixHeaders(item),
            referer:item.referer || ''
        });
        return;
    }

    isaFlixShowSeries(item);
}

function isaFlixShowSeries(series) {
    const root = isaFlixRoot();
    if (!root) return;

    const episodes = isaFlixArray(series.episodes);
    const seasons = new Map();

    episodes.forEach((episode,index) => {
        const number = Number(episode.season_number || 1);
        if (!seasons.has(number)) seasons.set(number,[]);
        seasons.get(number).push({...episode,__index:index});
    });

    const seasonNumbers = [...seasons.keys()].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
    const poster = series.poster_url || series.image_url || '';

    root.innerHTML = `
        <div class="isaf-detail">
            <button class="isa-back" id="isaf-back">
                <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i> Dizilere dön
            </button>
            ${poster ? `<img class="isaf-detail-poster" src="${esc(poster)}" alt="">` : ''}
            <h2>${esc(series.title || series.name || 'Dizi')}</h2>
            <p>${esc(series.description || '')}</p>
            <div class="isaf-season-grid">
                ${seasonNumbers.map((number,index) => `
                    <button class="isaf-season" data-isaf-season="${index}">
                        <strong>Sezon ${number}</strong>
                        <small>${seasons.get(number).length} bölüm</small>
                    </button>
                `).join('')}
            </div>
            ${episodes.length ? '' : '<p class="isa-vod-note">Bu dizide bölüm bulunamadı.</p>'}
        </div>
    `;

    document.getElementById('isaf-back').onclick = () => {
        isaFlixState.mode = 'series';
        isaFlixRender();
    };

    root.querySelectorAll('[data-isaf-season]').forEach(button => {
        button.onclick = () => {
            const number = seasonNumbers[Number(button.dataset.isafSeason)];
            isaFlixShowEpisodes(series,number,seasons.get(number));
        };
    });
}

function isaFlixShowEpisodes(series,number,episodes) {
    const root = isaFlixRoot();
    if (!root) return;

    root.innerHTML = `
        <div class="isaf-detail">
            <button class="isa-back" id="isaf-season-back">
                <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i> Sezonlara dön
            </button>
            <h2>${esc(series.title || series.name || 'Dizi')} · Sezon ${number}</h2>
            <div class="isaf-season-grid">
                ${episodes.map((episode,index) => `
                    <button class="isaf-season" data-isaf-episode="${index}">
                        <i class="fas fa-circle-play"></i>
                        <strong>${esc(episode.title || ('Bölüm '+(episode.episode_number || index+1)))}</strong>
                    </button>
                `).join('')}
            </div>
        </div>
    `;

    document.getElementById('isaf-season-back').onclick =
        () => isaFlixShowSeries(series);

    root.querySelectorAll('[data-isaf-episode]').forEach(button => {
        button.onclick = () => {
            const episode = episodes[Number(button.dataset.isafEpisode)];
            const url = episode.stream_url || '';

            if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) {
                alert('Bu bölüm için geçerli yayın bağlantısı bulunamadı.');
                return;
            }

            const queue = episodes
                .filter(ep => /^https?:\/\//i.test(String(ep.stream_url||'')))
                .map(ep => ({
                    name:(series.title || series.name || 'Dizi') +
                        ' - ' + (ep.title || 'Bölüm'),
                    url:ep.stream_url,
                    logo:ep.image_url || series.poster_url || '',
                    group:series.platform_name || 'Diziler',
                    headers:isaFlixHeaders(ep),
                    is_live:false
                }));

            const index = queue.findIndex(x => x.url === url);
            if (index >= 0) play(queue[index],queue,index,false);
        };
    });
}

window.addEventListener('isa:domino-catalog-updated', event => {
    const data = event.detail;
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
    if (isaFlixOpen()) isaFlixRender();
});

function isaFlixInit() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('isa-flix-panel');
    if (!panel) return;

    if (!document.getElementById('isa-flix-app')) {
        panel.innerHTML = '<div id="isa-flix-app"></div>';
    }

    const data = isaFlixCatalog();
    if (data && Object.keys(data).length) {
        isaFlixRender();
    } else {
        const root = isaFlixRoot();
        if (root) {
            window.__isaDominoProgress('0', 'download', 0);
        }
    }
}

window.isaHandleBack = function() {
    const films = document.getElementById('isa-films-panel');
    const series = document.getElementById('isa-series-panel');

    if ((films && films.classList.contains('active')) ||
        (series && series.classList.contains('active'))) {
        const homeTab = document.querySelector('[data-tab="isa-live-panel"]');
        if (homeTab) homeTab.click();
        return true;
    }

    return false;
};

function start() {
    initScrollArrows();
    isaFlixInit();
    loadSaved();
    bindControls();
    renderSavedLists();
    renderSourceFields();
    refreshAll(false);
    startDominoAutoUpdate();
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',start);
} else {
    start();
}

})();

// Debug APK başarılı derlemeden sonra İndirilenler klasörüne kopyalanır.
tasks.register("copyDebugApkToDownload") {
    doLast {
        def apk = layout.buildDirectory.file("outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk").get().asFile
        def destination = new File("/sdcard/Download/ISA-TV-HD.apk")
        if (!apk.isFile()) throw new GradleException("APK bulunamadı: " + apk)
        destination.parentFile.mkdirs()
        java.nio.file.Files.copy(apk.toPath(), destination.toPath(),
            java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
        println("APK kopyalandı: " + destination)
    }
}
tasks.matching { it.name == "assembleDebug" }.configureEach {
    finalizedBy("copyDebugApkToDownload")
}

        // Simple sidebar logic for about page
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const menuToggle = document.getElementById('home-menu-toggle');
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('home-sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('home-sidebar-overlay');
            const closeBtn = document.getElementById('home-sidebar-close');

            function toggleSidebar(show) {
                if (show) {
                    sidebar.classList.add('open');
                    overlay.classList.add('visible');
                    document.body.classList.add('home-sidebar-open');
                } else {
                    sidebar.classList.remove('open');
                    overlay.classList.remove('visible');
                    document.body.classList.remove('home-sidebar-open');
                }
            }

            if (menuToggle) menuToggle.addEventListener('click', () => toggleSidebar(true));
            if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => toggleSidebar(false));
            if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', () => toggleSidebar(false));
        });
    </script>

DOSYA: app/src/main/assets/isa-tv-hd/sw.js
================================================================================
const CACHE_NAME = 'isa-tv-hd-shell-v5';
const APP_SHELL = [
  './index.html',
  './player.html',
  './css/netflix-style.css',
  './js/homepage.js',
  './js/netflix-player.js',
  './js/pwa-register.js',
  './assets/favicon.ico',
  './assets/favicon-16x16.png',
  './assets/favicon-32x32.png',
  './assets/apple-touch-icon.png',
  './assets/android-chrome-192x192.png',
  './assets/android-chrome-512x512.png',
  './manifest.webmanifest'
];

self.addEventListener('install', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(async (cache) => {
      await Promise.all(
        APP_SHELL.map(async (asset) => {
          const response = await fetch(asset, { cache: 'no-cache' });
          if (response.ok && !response.redirected && response.type === 'basic') {
            await cache.put(asset, response.clone());
          }
        })
      );
    })
  );
  self.skipWaiting();
});

self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then((keys) =>
      Promise.all(
        keys
          .filter((key) => key !== CACHE_NAME)
          .map((key) => caches.delete(key))
      )
    )
  );
  self.clients.claim();
});

self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  const { request } = event;
  if (request.method !== 'GET') {
    return;
  }

  const url = new URL(request.url);

  // Do not cache external IPTV playlists/streams; keep live requests fresh.
  if (url.origin !== self.location.origin) {
    return;
  }

  // Never cache API relay responses (stream chunks/manifests must stay fresh).
  if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) {
    return;
  }

  if (request.mode === 'navigate') {
    event.respondWith(networkFirstNavigation(request));
    return;
  }

  if (isVersionedStaticAsset(url.pathname)) {
    event.respondWith(staleWhileRevalidateAsset(request));
    return;
  }

  event.respondWith(networkFirstAsset(request));
});

async function networkFirstNavigation(request) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(request);
    await maybeCacheResponse(request, response);
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    const cachedPage = await caches.match(request);
    if (cachedPage) {
      return cachedPage;
    }
    const fallback = await caches.match('./index.html');
    if (fallback) {
      return fallback;
    }
    return Response.error();
  }
}

async function maybeCacheResponse(request, response) {
  if (!response || !response.ok) return;
  if (response.redirected || response.type !== 'basic') return;

  const cache = await caches.open(CACHE_NAME);
  await cache.put(request, response.clone());
}

function isVersionedStaticAsset(pathname) {
  return (
    pathname.endsWith('.css') ||
    pathname.endsWith('.js') ||
    pathname.endsWith('.png') ||
    pathname.endsWith('.ico') ||
    pathname.endsWith('.webmanifest') ||
    pathname.endsWith('.json')
  );
}

async function staleWhileRevalidateAsset(request) {
  const cached = await caches.match(request);
  const networkFetch = fetch(request)
    .then(async (response) => {
      await maybeCacheResponse(request, response);
      return response;
    })
    .catch(() => null);

  if (cached) {
    return cached;
  }

  const networkResponse = await networkFetch;
  if (networkResponse) {
    return networkResponse;
  }

  return Response.error();
}

async function networkFirstAsset(request) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(request);
    await maybeCacheResponse(request, response);
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    const cached = await caches.match(request);
    if (cached) {
      return cached;
    }
    return Response.error();
  }
}
