class StreamFlixHomepage {
    constructor() {
        this.appMode = this.detectAppMode();
        this.isDesktopApp = this.appMode === 'desktop';
        this.channels = [];
        this.featuredChannels = [];
        this.continueWatching = [];
        this.popularChannels = [];
        this.allChannelsSource = [];
        this.allChannelsVisibleCount = 0;
        this.allChannelsPageSize = 0;
        this.allChannelsChunkSize = 50;
        this.channelStatusCacheKey = 'streamflix-channel-status-v1';
        this.channelStatusTtlMs = 10 * 60 * 1000;
        this.channelStatusCache = this.loadChannelStatusCache();
        this.statusProbeQueue = [];
        this.statusProbeInFlight = new Set();
        this.statusProbeWorkers = 0;
        this.maxStatusProbeWorkers = 4;
        this.relayProbeBase = this.resolveRelayProbeBase();
        this.playlists = {
            global: '',
            india: ''
        };
        this.selectedPlaylist = localStorage.getItem('streamflix-preferred-playlist') || 'global';
        
        this.initializeElements();
        this.applyAppMode();
        this.bindEvents();
        this.loadChannels();
        this.setupSlideshow();
    }

    detectAppMode() {
        const fromDesktopBridge = (window.streamflixDesktop && window.streamflixDesktop.appMode) || '';
        const fromQuery = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('mode') || '';
        const normalized = (fromDesktopBridge || fromQuery || 'web').toLowerCase();
        return normalized === 'desktop' ? 'desktop' : 'web';
    }

    applyAppMode() {
        document.body.dataset.appMode = this.appMode;
        if (!this.isDesktopApp) {
            return;
        }
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-web-only]').forEach((element) => element.remove());
    }

    initializeElements() {
        this.watchNowBtn = document.getElementById('watch-now');
        this.browseChannelsBtn = document.getElementById('browse-channels');
        this.playCustomUrlBtn = document.getElementById('play-custom-url');
        this.browseChannelsTopBtn = document.getElementById('browse-channels-top');
        this.searchInput = document.getElementById('search-input');
        this.allChannelsGrid = document.getElementById('all-channels');
        this.loadMoreHomeBtn = document.getElementById('load-more-home');
        this.continueWatchingRow = document.getElementById('continue-watching');
        this.popularChannelsRow = document.getElementById('popular-channels');
        this.categoryCards = document.querySelectorAll('.category-card');
        this.homePlaylistSelect = document.getElementById('home-playlist-select');
        this.homeMenuToggle = document.getElementById('home-menu-toggle');
        this.homeSidebar = document.getElementById('home-sidebar');
        this.homeSidebarOverlay = document.getElementById('home-sidebar-overlay');
        this.homeSidebarClose = document.getElementById('home-sidebar-close');

        if (this.homePlaylistSelect) {
            this.homePlaylistSelect.value = this.selectedPlaylist;
        }
    }

    bindEvents() {
        if (this.watchNowBtn) {
            this.watchNowBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.startWatching());
        }
        
        if (this.browseChannelsBtn) {
            this.browseChannelsBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.scrollToChannels());
        }

        if (this.browseChannelsTopBtn) {
            this.browseChannelsTopBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.scrollToChannels());
        }

        if (this.playCustomUrlBtn) {
            this.playCustomUrlBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.promptForCustomUrl());
        }
        
        if (this.searchInput) {
            this.searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => this.filterChannels(e.target.value));
        }

        if (this.loadMoreHomeBtn) {
            this.loadMoreHomeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.loadMoreAllChannels());
        }

        if (this.homePlaylistSelect) {
            this.homePlaylistSelect.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                const nextPlaylist = e.target.value;
                this.setPreferredPlaylist(nextPlaylist);
                if (this.searchInput) {
                    this.searchInput.value = '';
                }
                this.loadChannels({ forceRefresh: true });
            });
        }

        if (this.homeMenuToggle) {
            this.homeMenuToggle.addEventListener('click', () => this.openHomeSidebar());
        }

        if (this.homeSidebarClose) {
            this.homeSidebarClose.addEventListener('click', () => this.closeHomeSidebar());
        }

        if (this.homeSidebarOverlay) {
            this.homeSidebarOverlay.addEventListener('click', () => this.closeHomeSidebar());
        }

        if (this.homeSidebar) {
            this.homeSidebar.querySelectorAll('a').forEach((link) => {
                link.addEventListener('click', () => this.closeHomeSidebar());
            });
        }
        
        // Category card clicks
        this.categoryCards.forEach(card => {
            card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const category = card.dataset.category;
                this.filterByCategory(category);
            });
        });
        
        // Setup row navigation
        this.setupRowNavigation();
        
        // Event delegation for play buttons
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.closest('.play-button')) {
                const button = e.target.closest('.play-button');
                const channelId = button.dataset.channelId;
                console.log('🎮 Play button clicked, channel ID:', channelId);
                if (channelId && window.homepage) {
                    window.homepage.playChannel(channelId);
                } else {
                    console.error('❌ Could not play channel - missing data or homepage object');
                }
            }
        });
    }

    getChannelCacheKey() {
        return `streamflix-channels-${this.selectedPlaylist}`;
    }

    setPreferredPlaylist(type) {
        if (!this.playlists[type]) return;
        this.selectedPlaylist = type;
        localStorage.setItem('streamflix-preferred-playlist', type);
    }

    async loadChannels(options = {}) {
        const { forceRefresh = false } = options;
        try {
            // Load from localStorage first
            const cacheKey = this.getChannelCacheKey();
            const cachedChannels = localStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
            if (cachedChannels && !forceRefresh) {
                this.channels = JSON.parse(cachedChannels);
                this.processChannels();
                return;
            }
            
            const playlistUrl = this.playlists[this.selectedPlaylist] || this.playlists.global;
            console.log(`📡 Loading ${this.selectedPlaylist} playlist from homepage...`);
            const response = await fetch(playlistUrl);
            const playlistText = await response.text();
            
            this.parsePlaylist(playlistText);
            localStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(this.channels));
            this.processChannels();
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error loading channels:', error);
            this.showErrorMessage('Failed to load channel list');
        }
    }

    parsePlaylist(playlistText) {
        const lines = playlistText.split('\n');
        this.channels = [];
        let currentChannel = null;

        for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            const line = lines[i].trim();
            
            if (line.startsWith('#EXTINF:')) {
                const metadata = this.parseChannelMetadata(line);
                currentChannel = {
                    ...metadata,
                    url: '',
                    id: this.channels.length
                };
            } else if (line.startsWith('http') && currentChannel) {
                currentChannel.url = line;
                if (this.isValidStreamUrl(line)) {
                    this.channels.push(currentChannel);
                }
                currentChannel = null;
            }
        }
    }

    parseChannelMetadata(extinfLine) {
        const metadata = {};
        
        // Extract channel name (everything after the last comma)
        const nameMatch = extinfLine.match(/,(.*)$/);
        metadata.name = nameMatch ? nameMatch[1].trim() : 'Unknown Channel';
        
        // Extract group/category
        const groupMatch = extinfLine.match(/group-title="([^"]*)"/i);
        metadata.group = groupMatch ? groupMatch[1] : 'General';
        
        // Extract tvg-logo
        const logoMatch = extinfLine.match(/tvg-logo="([^"]*)"/i);
        metadata.logo = logoMatch ? logoMatch[1] : '';
        
        return metadata;
    }

    isValidStreamUrl(url) {
        return url && (
            url.includes('.m3u8') || 
            url.includes('.mp4') || 
            url.includes('.ts') ||
            url.includes('youtube.com') ||
            url.includes('youtu.be')
        );
    }

    processChannels() {
        // Select featured channels (first 10)
        this.featuredChannels = this.channels.slice(0, 10);
        
        // Select popular channels (random selection)
        this.popularChannels = this.shuffleArray([...this.channels]).slice(0, 15);
        
        // Get continue watching (from localStorage or recent)
        this.continueWatching = this.getContinueWatching();
        
        this.renderAllSections();
    }

    getContinueWatching() {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem('continue-watching');
        if (saved) {
            return JSON.parse(saved);
        }
        return this.channels.slice(0, 5); // Default to first 5 channels
    }

    renderAllSections() {
        this.renderFeaturedShowcase();
        this.renderContinueWatching();
        this.renderPopularChannels();
        this.renderAllChannels();
    }

    renderFeaturedShowcase() {
        // Could implement a rotating banner here
        console.log('Featured channels ready:', this.featuredChannels.length);
    }

    renderContinueWatching() {
        if (!this.continueWatchingRow) return;
        
        this.continueWatchingRow.innerHTML = this.continueWatching
            .map(channel => this.createChannelCard(channel, 'horizontal'))
            .join('');
        this.queueVisibleChannelStatusChecks(this.continueWatching);
    }

    renderPopularChannels() {
        if (!this.popularChannelsRow) return;
        
        this.popularChannelsRow.innerHTML = this.popularChannels
            .map(channel => this.createChannelCard(channel, 'horizontal'))
            .join('');
        this.queueVisibleChannelStatusChecks(this.popularChannels);
    }

    renderAllChannels() {
        if (!this.allChannelsGrid) return;
        this.resetAllChannelsPagination(this.channels);
    }

    resetAllChannelsPagination(channels) {
        this.allChannelsSource = channels;
        this.allChannelsPageSize = channels.length > 0 ? this.allChannelsChunkSize : 0;
        this.allChannelsVisibleCount = Math.min(this.allChannelsPageSize, channels.length);
        this.renderAllChannelsPage();
    }

    renderAllChannelsPage() {
        if (!this.allChannelsGrid) return;

        if (this.allChannelsSource.length === 0) {
            this.allChannelsGrid.innerHTML = `
                <div class="no-channels-message">
                    <i class="fas fa-search"></i>
                    <p>No channels found</p>
                </div>
            `;
            this.updateHomeLoadMoreButton();
            return;
        }

        const visibleChannels = this.allChannelsSource.slice(0, this.allChannelsVisibleCount);
        this.allChannelsGrid.innerHTML = visibleChannels
            .map(channel => this.createChannelCard(channel))
            .join('');
        this.updateHomeLoadMoreButton();
        this.queueVisibleChannelStatusChecks(visibleChannels);
    }

    loadMoreAllChannels() {
        if (this.allChannelsVisibleCount >= this.allChannelsSource.length) return;
        this.allChannelsVisibleCount = Math.min(
            this.allChannelsVisibleCount + this.allChannelsPageSize,
            this.allChannelsSource.length
        );
        this.renderAllChannelsPage();
    }

    updateHomeLoadMoreButton() {
        if (!this.loadMoreHomeBtn) return;
        const hasMore = this.allChannelsVisibleCount < this.allChannelsSource.length;
        this.loadMoreHomeBtn.style.display = hasMore ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    }

    createChannelCard(channel, style = 'vertical') {
        const logo = channel.logo || this.getDefaultLogo(channel.group);
        const className = style === 'horizontal' ? 'channel-card-horizontal' : 'channel-card';
        const channelId = channel.id;
        const fallbackInitial = channel.name ? channel.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : 'TV';
        const status = this.getChannelStatus(channel.url);
        const statusLabel = status === 'live' ? 'LIVE' : status === 'dead' ? 'DEAD' : '...';
        const statusClass = status === 'live' ? 'status-live' : status === 'dead' ? 'status-dead' : 'status-checking';
        const channelKey = encodeURIComponent(channel.url || '');
        
        return `
            <div class="${className}" data-channel-id="${channelId}" data-channel-key="${channelKey}">
                <div class="channel-thumbnail">
                    <div class="channel-placeholder" style="background: ${this.getChannelColor(channel.group)}">
                        <i class="fas fa-tv"></i>
                        <span>${fallbackInitial}</span>
                    </div>
                    ${logo
                        ? `<img class="channel-thumb-img" src="${logo}" alt="${channel.name} logo" onerror="this.style.display='none'">`
                        : ''}
                    <span class="channel-live-badge ${statusClass}" data-channel-key="${channelKey}">${statusLabel}</span>
                    <div class="channel-overlay">
                        <button class="play-button" data-channel-id="${channelId}">
                            <i class="fas fa-play"></i>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="channel-info">
                    <h3 class="channel-name">${channel.name}</h3>
                    <p class="channel-group">${channel.group}</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    getChannelColor(group) {
        const colors = {
            'News': '#e50914',
            'Sports': '#00bfff',
            'Entertainment': '#ff6b6b',
            'Music': '#9b59b6',
            'Kids': '#2ecc71',
            'Movies': '#f39c12'
        };
        return colors[group] || '#6c757d';
    }

    getDefaultLogo(group) {
        // Could implement default logos based on category
        return '';
    }

    setupRowNavigation() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.row-arrow.prev').forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const row = e.target.closest('.row-section');
                this.scrollRow(row, 'left');
            });
        });
        
        document.querySelectorAll('.row-arrow.next').forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const row = e.target.closest('.row-section');
                this.scrollRow(row, 'right');
            });
        });
    }

    scrollRow(row, direction) {
        const content = row.querySelector('.row-content');
        const scrollAmount = 300;
        const scrollValue = direction === 'right' ? scrollAmount : -scrollAmount;
        content.scrollBy({ left: scrollValue, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    playChannel(channelId) {
        const channel = this.channels.find(c => c.id == channelId);

        if (!channel || !channel.url) {
            console.error('Kanal bulunamadı veya yayın adresi boş:', channelId);
            alert('Kanal bulunamadı veya yayın adresi mevcut değil.');
            return;
        }

        this.saveContinueWatching(channel);

        localStorage.setItem('isa-last-channel-id', String(channel.id));
        localStorage.setItem('isa-last-channel-group', channel.group || 'all');
        localStorage.setItem('isa-last-playlist', this.selectedPlaylist || '');

        const queue = this.channels
            .filter(c => c && c.url && /^https?:\/\//i.test(c.url))
            .map(c => ({
                name: c.name || 'Kanal',
                url: c.url,
                group: c.group || '',
                logo: c.logo || '',
                headers: c.headers || {}
            }));

        const selectedIndex = queue.findIndex(c =>
            c.url === channel.url && c.name === (channel.name || 'Kanal')
        );

        if (selectedIndex < 0) {
            alert('Kanal oynatma listesine eklenemedi.');
            return;
        }

        if (window.ISATV && typeof window.ISATV.play === 'function') {
            window.ISATV.play(
                channel.name || 'Kanal',
                channel.url,
                JSON.stringify(channel.headers || {}),
                JSON.stringify(queue),
                selectedIndex
            );
        } else {
            console.error('Android ISATV köprüsü bulunamadı.');
            alert('Android oynatıcı bağlantısı bulunamadı.');
        }
    }


    restoreLastPlayedChannel() {
        const channelId = localStorage.getItem('isa-last-channel-id');
        const savedGroup = localStorage.getItem('isa-last-channel-group');

        if (channelId === null || !this.channels || !this.channels.length) return;

        if (savedGroup && typeof this.filterByCategory === 'function') {
            this.filterByCategory(savedGroup);
        }

        let attempts = 0;
        const reveal = () => {
            const card = Array.from(
                document.querySelectorAll('.channel-card[data-channel-id]')
            ).find(el => el.dataset.channelId == channelId);

            if (card) {
                card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                return;
            }

            if (attempts++ < 20 && typeof this.loadMoreAllChannels === 'function') {
                this.loadMoreAllChannels();
                setTimeout(reveal, 150);
            }
        };

        setTimeout(reveal, 200);
    }

    saveContinueWatching(channel) {
        let continueList = this.getContinueWatching();
        // Remove if already exists, add to front
        continueList = continueList.filter(c => c.id !== channel.id);
        continueList.unshift(channel);
        // Keep only last 10
        continueList = continueList.slice(0, 10);
        localStorage.setItem('continue-watching', JSON.stringify(continueList));
    }

    startWatching() {
        // Open player without auto-selecting a channel.
        window.location.href = './player.html';
    }

    promptForCustomUrl() {
        const url = prompt('Enter a stream URL (YouTube, m3u8, mp4, etc.):');
        if (url && url.trim()) {
            const cleanUrl = url.trim();
            console.log('🔗 Playing custom URL:', cleanUrl);
            
            const query = new URLSearchParams({
                stream: cleanUrl,
                name: 'Custom Stream',
                group: 'User Input',
                playlist: this.selectedPlaylist
            });
            
            window.location.href = `./player.html?${query.toString()}`;
        }
    }

    scrollToChannels() {
        document.querySelector('.all-channels-section').scrollIntoView({
            behavior: 'smooth'
        });
    }

    filterChannels(searchTerm) {
        const filtered = this.channels.filter(channel =>
            channel.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
            channel.group.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
        );
        this.resetAllChannelsPagination(filtered);
    }

    filterByCategory(category) {
        const filtered = category === 'all' 
            ? this.channels 
            : this.channels.filter(channel => 
                channel.group.toLowerCase().includes(category.toLowerCase())
            );
        this.resetAllChannelsPagination(filtered);
    }

    shuffleArray(array) {
        const shuffled = [...array];
        for (let i = shuffled.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
            [shuffled[i], shuffled[j]] = [shuffled[j], shuffled[i]];
        }
        return shuffled;
    }

    showErrorMessage(message) {
        const errorDiv = document.createElement('div');
        errorDiv.className = 'error-message';
        errorDiv.innerHTML = `
            <div class="error-content">
                <i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle"></i>
                <p>${message}</p>
            </div>
        `;
        document.body.appendChild(errorDiv);
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            errorDiv.remove();
        }, 5000);
    }

    resolveRelayProbeBase() {
        const fromWindow = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (window.STREAMFLIX_RELAY_BASE || '').trim() : '';
        const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="isa-disabled-relay"]');
        const fromMeta = meta ? (meta.content || '').trim() : '';
        const raw = fromWindow || fromMeta || '';
        return raw.replace(/\/+$/, '');
    }

    loadChannelStatusCache() {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(this.channelStatusCacheKey);
            return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
        } catch (error) {
            return {};
        }
    }

    saveChannelStatusCache() {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(this.channelStatusCacheKey, JSON.stringify(this.channelStatusCache));
        } catch (error) {
            // Ignore storage errors.
        }
    }

    getChannelStatus(url = '') {
        const entry = this.channelStatusCache[url];
        if (!entry) return 'checking';
        if ((Date.now() - entry.checkedAt) > this.channelStatusTtlMs) return 'checking';
        return entry.state === 'live' ? 'live' : 'dead';
    }

    queueVisibleChannelStatusChecks(channels = []) {
        channels.forEach((channel) => {
            if (!channel || !channel.url) return;
            const cached = this.channelStatusCache[channel.url];
            const fresh = cached && ((Date.now() - cached.checkedAt) <= this.channelStatusTtlMs);
            if (fresh || this.statusProbeInFlight.has(channel.url)) return;
            this.statusProbeInFlight.add(channel.url);
            this.statusProbeQueue.push(channel.url);
        });
        this.runChannelStatusWorkers();
    }

    runChannelStatusWorkers() {
        while (this.statusProbeWorkers < this.maxStatusProbeWorkers && this.statusProbeQueue.length > 0) {
            const url = this.statusProbeQueue.shift();
            this.statusProbeWorkers += 1;
            this.probeChannelStatus(url)
                .catch(() => this.setChannelStatus(url, 'dead'))
                .finally(() => {
                    this.statusProbeWorkers -= 1;
                    this.statusProbeInFlight.delete(url);
                    this.runChannelStatusWorkers();
                });
        }
    }

    async probeChannelStatus(url) {
        const target = this.buildProbeUrl(url);
        if (!target) {
            this.setChannelStatus(url, 'dead');
            return;
        }
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort('timeout'), 6000);
        try {
            const response = await fetch(target, { cache: 'no-store', signal: controller.signal });
            if (response.ok) {
                this.setChannelStatus(url, 'live');
            } else if (this.relayEnabled && target.includes(this.relayEndpoint) && this.isHttpStreamUrl(url)) {
                // If relay probe fails for HTTP stream, try direct HTTPS upgrade probe as fallback
                const upgradedUrl = url.replace(/^http:\/\//i, 'https://');
                const directController = new AbortController();
                const directTimeout = setTimeout(() => directController.abort('timeout'), 5000);
                try {
                    const directResponse = await fetch(upgradedUrl, { method: 'HEAD', cache: 'no-store', signal: directController.signal });
                    this.setChannelStatus(url, directResponse.ok ? 'live' : 'dead');
                } catch (e) {
                    this.setChannelStatus(url, 'dead');
                } finally {
                    clearTimeout(directTimeout);
                }
            } else {
                this.setChannelStatus(url, 'dead');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            this.setChannelStatus(url, 'dead');
        } finally {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
        }
    }

    buildProbeUrl(url) {
        if (!url) return null;
        if (this.relayProbeBase) {
            const separator = this.relayProbeBase.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
            return `${this.relayProbeBase}${separator}url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`;
        }
        if (window.location.protocol === 'https:' && /^http:\/\//i.test(url)) {
            return null;
        }
        return url;
    }

    setChannelStatus(url, state) {
        this.channelStatusCache[url] = {
            state,
            checkedAt: Date.now()
        };
        this.saveChannelStatusCache();
        this.updateChannelStatusBadge(url, state);
    }

    updateChannelStatusBadge(url, state) {
        const key = encodeURIComponent(url || '');
        const badges = document.querySelectorAll(`.channel-live-badge[data-channel-key="${key}"]`);
        badges.forEach((badge) => {
            badge.classList.remove('status-live', 'status-dead', 'status-checking');
            if (state === 'live') {
                badge.classList.add('status-live');
                badge.textContent = 'LIVE';
            } else if (state === 'dead') {
                badge.classList.add('status-dead');
                badge.textContent = 'DEAD';
            } else {
                badge.classList.add('status-checking');
                badge.textContent = '...';
            }
        });
    }

    setupSlideshow() {
        // Could implement automatic slideshow rotation here
        console.log('Slideshow initialized');
    }

    openHomeSidebar() {
        if (!this.homeSidebar || !this.homeSidebarOverlay) return;
        this.homeSidebar.classList.add('open');
        this.homeSidebarOverlay.classList.add('visible');
        document.body.classList.add('home-sidebar-open');
    }

    closeHomeSidebar() {
        if (!this.homeSidebar || !this.homeSidebarOverlay) return;
        this.homeSidebar.classList.remove('open');
        this.homeSidebarOverlay.classList.remove('visible');
        document.body.classList.remove('home-sidebar-open');
    }
}

(function () {
'use strict';



const STORAGE_KEY = 'isa-tv-playlists-v3';

let channels = [];
let playlists = [];
let vodProviders = [];
let fetchCounter = 0;
let cacheCounter = 0;
let currentProvider = null;
let isaFavoritesOpen = false;
let isaFavoritesToggleBound = false;

window.__isaCacheCallbacks = {};
window.__isaFetchCallbacks = {};

window.__isaCacheDone = function(id,value,error) {
    const cb = window.__isaCacheCallbacks[id];
    if (!cb) return;
    delete window.__isaCacheCallbacks[id];
    if (error) cb.reject(new Error(error));
    else cb.resolve(value);
};

window.__isaFetchDone = function(id,value,error) {
    const cb = window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id];
    if (!cb) return;
    delete window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id];
    if (error) cb.reject(new Error(error));
    else cb.resolve(value);
};


let catalogRequestId = 0;
let catalogTimerStarted = false;
let catalogLastData = null;
let catalogHasCache = false;
let catalogLoading = false;
let catalogInFlight = null;

window.__isaCatalogCallbacks = {};



function isaCatalogProgressElement() {
    let element = document.getElementById(
        'isa-catalog-progress-overlay'
    );

    if (!element) {
        element = document.createElement('div');
        element.id = 'isa-catalog-progress-overlay';
        element.style.cssText =
            'position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;' +
            'height:3px;z-index:999999;' +
            'pointer-events:none;background:transparent;';

        element.innerHTML =
            '<div id="isa-catalog-fill" style="' +
            'height:3px;width:0;background:#16b978;' +
            'transition:width .12s linear"></div>' +
            '<div id="isa-catalog-percent" style="' +
            'position:absolute;right:8px;top:5px;' +
            'font-size:10px;color:#16b978;' +
            'background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);' +
            'padding:2px 5px;border-radius:4px">0%</div>';

        document.body.appendChild(element);
    }

    return element;
}

function isaCatalogHideProgress() {
    const element = document.getElementById(
        'isa-catalog-progress-overlay'
    );

    if (element) element.remove();
}

window.__isaCatalogProgress = function(id, stage, percent) {
    if (catalogHasCache) return;

    const root = isaCatalogProgressElement();
    const value = Math.max(
        0, Math.min(100, Number(percent) || 0)
    );

    root.querySelector('#isa-catalog-fill').style.width =
        value + '%';

    root.querySelector('#isa-catalog-percent').textContent =
        value + '%';
};

window.__isaCatalogDone = function(id, value, error) {
    const callback = window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];
    if (!callback) return;

    delete window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];

    if (error) {
        isaCatalogHideProgress();
        callback.reject(new Error(error));
    } else {
        callback.resolve(value);
    }
};

window.__isaCatalogReady = function(id, totalBytes, error, notModified) {
    if (error) {
        window.__isaCatalogDone(id, null, error);
        return;
    }

    const callback = window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];

    if (!callback) return;

    if (notModified && catalogLastData &&
        typeof catalogLastData === 'object') {
        window.__isaCatalogDone(id, catalogLastData, null);
        return;
    }

    if (!window.ISATV ||
        typeof window.ISATV.readCatalogChunk !== 'function') {
        window.__isaCatalogDone(
            id, null, 'Java Catalog parça bağlantısı bulunamadı.'
        );
        return;
    }

    if (!Number.isFinite(totalBytes) || totalBytes <= 0) {
        window.__isaCatalogDone(
            id, null, 'Catalog kataloğu boş.'
        );
        return;
    }

    let offset = 0;
    const chunkSize = 65536;
    let completeText = '';
    const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8');

    function readNext() {
        try {
            const encoded = window.ISATV.readCatalogChunk(
                String(offset), chunkSize
            );

            if (!encoded) {
                throw new Error('Catalog veri parçası boş geldi.');
            }

            const binary = atob(encoded);
            const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);

            for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
                bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
            }

            offset += bytes.length;

            completeText += decoder.decode(
                bytes,
                {stream: offset < totalBytes}
            );

            const percent = Math.min(
                99,
                90 + Math.floor(offset * 9 / totalBytes)
            );

            window.__isaCatalogProgress(id, 'load', percent);

            if (offset < totalBytes) {
                setTimeout(readNext, 0);
                return;
            }

            completeText += decoder.decode();

            window.__isaCatalogDone(
                id, completeText, null
            );

        } catch (e) {
            completeText = '';

            window.__isaCatalogDone(
                id, null,
                'Catalog aktarım hatası: ' + e.message
            );
        }
    }

    readNext();
};


function loadCachedCatalogCatalog() {
    if (!window.ISATV ||
        typeof window.ISATV.loadCachedCatalogCatalog !== 'function') {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
    }

    catalogHasCache = true;

    return new Promise(resolve => {
        const id = ++catalogRequestId;

        window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id] = {
            resolve: value => {
                try {
                    const parsed =
                        (value && typeof value === 'object')
                        ? value : JSON.parse(value);

                    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') {
                        throw new Error('Gecersiz veri');
                    }

                    catalogLastData = parsed;
                    window.ISA_Catalog_CATALOG = parsed;
                    catalogHasCache = true;
                    resolve(parsed);

                } catch (e) {
                    catalogHasCache = false;
                    resolve(null);
                }
            },

            reject: () => {
                catalogHasCache = false;
                resolve(null);
            }
        };

        try {
            window.ISATV.loadCachedCatalogCatalog(String(id));
        } catch (e) {
            delete window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];
            catalogHasCache = false;
            resolve(null);
        }
    });
}

function fetchCatalogCatalog() {
    if (catalogInFlight) return catalogInFlight;

    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.fetchCatalogCatalog) {
        return Promise.reject(
            new Error('Catalog native bağlantısı kullanılamıyor.')
        );
    }

    catalogLoading = true;

    catalogInFlight = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const id = ++catalogRequestId;

        window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id] = {
            resolve: value => {
                try {
                    const parsed = (value && typeof value === 'object')
                        ? value : JSON.parse(value);
                    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') {
                        throw new Error('Boş veya geçersiz katalog.');
                    }
                    catalogLastData = parsed;
                    window.__isaCatalogProgress(id, "parse", 100);
                    setTimeout(isaCatalogHideProgress, 180);
                    catalogHasCache = true;
                    resolve(parsed);
                } catch (e) {
                    reject(new Error('Catalog JSON doğrulaması başarısız: ' + e.message));
                } finally {
                    catalogLoading = false;
                    catalogInFlight = null;
                }
            },
            reject: error => {
                catalogLoading = false;
                catalogInFlight = null;
                reject(error);
            }
        };

        try {
            window.ISATV.fetchCatalogCatalog(String(id));
        } catch (e) {
            delete window.__isaCatalogCallbacks[id];
            catalogLoading = false;
            catalogInFlight = null;
            reject(e);
        }
    });

    return catalogInFlight;
}

async function refreshCatalogCatalog(silent=false) {
    try {
        const previousData = catalogLastData;
        const data = await fetchCatalogCatalog();

        if (data === previousData) return data;

        window.ISA_Catalog_CATALOG = data;
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(
            'isa:catalog-catalog-updated',
            {detail:data}
        ));

        if (!silent) {
            const status = document.getElementById('isa-live-status');
            if (status) status.textContent = 'Catalog kataloğu güncellendi.';
        }

        return data;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Catalog katalog güncellemesi:', error);

        if (!silent) {
            const status = document.getElementById('isa-live-status');
            if (status) status.textContent =
                'Catalog güncellenemedi: ' + error.message;
        }

        return catalogLastData;
    }
}


function startCatalogAutoUpdate() {
    if (catalogTimerStarted) return;
    catalogTimerStarted = true;

    loadCachedCatalogCatalog().then(cached => {
        if (cached) {
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(
                'isa:catalog-catalog-updated',
                {detail: cached}
            ));
        }

        refreshCatalogCatalog(true);
    });

    window.setInterval(() => {
        if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
            refreshCatalogCatalog(true);
        }
    }, 60000);
}

function nativeCacheGet(key) {
    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.cacheGet) {
        try {
            return Promise.resolve(localStorage.getItem('isa-cache:'+key));
        } catch(e) {
            return Promise.resolve(null);
        }
    }

    return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
        const id = ++cacheCounter;
        window.__isaCacheCallbacks[id] = {resolve,reject};
        window.ISATV.cacheGet(key,String(id));
    });
}

function nativeCachePut(key,value) {
    if (window.ISATV && window.ISATV.cachePut) {
        window.ISATV.cachePut(key,value);
    } else {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem('isa-cache:'+key,value);
        } catch(e) {}
    }
}

function nativeFetch(url) {
    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.fetchText) {
        return fetch(url).then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
            return response.text();
        });
    }
    return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
        const id = ++fetchCounter;
        window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id] = {resolve,reject};
        window.ISATV.fetchText(url,String(id));
    });
}

function nativeFetchWithHeaders(url,headers={}) {
    if (!window.ISATV || !window.ISATV.fetchTextWithHeaders) {
        return fetch(url,{headers}).then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
            return response.text();
        });
    }
    return new Promise((resolve,reject) => {
        const id = ++fetchCounter;
        window.__isaFetchCallbacks[id] = {resolve,reject};
        window.ISATV.fetchTextWithHeaders(url,JSON.stringify(headers || {}),String(id));
    });
}

function getTextWithHeaders(url,headers={}) {
    return nativeFetchWithHeaders(url,headers);
}

async function getText(url,forceRefresh=false) {
    let cached = null;

    try {
        cached = await nativeCacheGet(url);
    } catch(e) {}

    if (!forceRefresh && cached) return cached;

    try {
        const fresh = await nativeFetch(url);
        nativeCachePut(url,fresh);
        return fresh;
    } catch(e) {
        if (cached) return cached;
        throw e;
    }
}

function esc(value) {
    return String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c => ({
        '&':'&amp;',
        '<':'&lt;',
        '>':'&gt;',
        '"':'&quot;',
        "'":'&#39;'
    })[c]);
}

function isHttp(url) {
    return /^https?:\/\//i.test(String(url||''));
}


function isDirectMedia(url) {
    if (!isHttp(url)) return false;
    try {
        const path = new URL(url).pathname.toLowerCase();
        return /\.(m3u8|mp4|mpd|mp3|m4a|aac|ts|mkv|webm|m4v|mov|ogg|flv|mpeg|mpg|3gp|avi)$/i.test(path);
    } catch(e) {
        return false;
    }
}



function cleanMediaTitle(value) {
    let name = String(value || '').trim();
    name = name.replace(/^(.*?)\s+-\s+\1(?=\s|$)/i, '$1').trim();
    // Dil/ülke etiketlerini yalnızca baştaki etiket olarak kaldır; TRT 1 gibi adlara dokunma.
    name = name.replace(/^(?:TR(?:\s*[:/.-]\s*|\s*🇹🇷\s*|\s+)|DE(?:\s*[:/.-]\s*|\s+|🇩🇪\s*))/iu, '');
    name = name.replace(/^(?:🇹🇷|🇩🇪)\s*/u, '');
    // Bölüm/sezon numaraları içerik başlığında tekrarlanmaz; oynatıcı alt bilgisinde gösterilir.
    name = name.replace(/\s*(?:[-–|·]\s*)?(?:S\s*\d{1,2}\s*E\s*\d{1,3}|Sezon\s*\d+\s*[-–:]?\s*\d+\s*\.?(?:bölüm|bolum)|\d+\s*\.?\s*(?:bölüm|bolum|episode))\s*$/i, '');
    return name.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').replace(/[\s|–-]+$/, '').trim();
}
function cleanGroupTitle(value) { return cleanMediaTitle(value); }
function cleanEpisodeTitle(value, fallbackNumber) {
    const name = cleanMediaTitle(value);
    const match = name.match(/(?:^|\s)(\d+)\s*\.?\s*(?:bölüm|bolum|episode)\s*$/i);
    return match ? (Number(match[1]) + '. Bölüm') : (fallbackNumber ? fallbackNumber + '. Bölüm' : name);
}



function parseM3U(text,prefix) {
    text = String(text || '').replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');

    const result = [];
    let current = null;
    let headers = {};
    let position = 0;
    let index = 0;

    while (position < text.length) {
        let end = text.indexOf('\n', position);
        if (end < 0) end = text.length;

        let line = text.slice(position, end).trim();
        position = end + 1;

        if (!line) continue;

        if (line.startsWith('#EXTINF:')) {
            const comma = line.lastIndexOf(',');
            const name = cleanMediaTitle(
                comma >= 0 ? line.slice(comma + 1) : 'İsimsiz yayın'
            );

            const group =
                (line.match(/group-title="([^"]*)"/i) || [])[1] || 'Genel';

            const logo =
                (line.match(/tvg-logo="([^"]*)"/i) || [])[1] || '';

            current = {
                name,
                group,
                logo,
                url:'',
                headers:{},
                id:prefix + '-' + index
            };

            headers = {};
        }
        else if (line.startsWith('#EXTVLCOPT:') && current) {
            const option = line.substring(11);
            const i = option.indexOf('=');

            if (i > 0) {
                const key = option.substring(0,i).toLowerCase();
                const value = option.substring(i+1);

                if (key === 'http-user-agent')
                    headers['User-Agent'] = value;

                if (key === 'http-referrer' || key === 'http-referer')
                    headers['Referer'] = value;

                if (key === 'http-origin')
                    headers['Origin'] = value;
            }
        }
        else if (line.startsWith('#EXTHTTP:') && current) {
            try {
                Object.assign(headers, JSON.parse(line.substring(9)));
            } catch(e) {}
        }
        else if (current && !line.startsWith('#') && isHttp(line)) {
            current.url = line;
            current.headers = {...headers};

            result.push(current);
            current = null;
            headers = {};
            index++;
        }
    }

    return result;
}

function play(channel,queue=channels,index=-1,isLive=true) {
    if (!channel || !isHttp(channel.url)) return;

    if (window.ISATV && window.ISATV.play) {
        window.ISATV.play(
            cleanMediaTitle(channel.name || 'İSA TV HD'),
            channel.url,
            JSON.stringify(channel.headers||{}),
            JSON.stringify((queue||[channel]).map(item => ({...item, is_live:item.is_live !== undefined ? item.is_live : !!isLive, name:cleanMediaTitle(item.name || 'İSA TV HD')}))),
            index < 0 ? Math.max(0,(queue||[]).indexOf(channel)) : index
        );
        return;
    }

    const query = new URLSearchParams({
        stream:channel.url,
        name:cleanMediaTitle(channel.name||'İSA TV HD'),
        group:channel.group||'',
        logo:channel.logo||''
    });

    location.href = './player.html?'+query.toString();
}


/* ISAFLIX_QUEUE_V2 */
function playIsaFlix(name, url, headers={}, queue=[], index=0) {
    if (!isHttp(url)) {
        alert('Geçerli video bağlantısı bulunamadı.');
        return;
    }

    const list = Array.isArray(queue) && queue.length
        ? queue
        : [{
            name:name || 'İSAFLIX',
            url:url,
            headers:headers || {},
            season:0,
            episode:0,
            is_live:false
        }];

    let selected = Number(index);
    if (!Number.isInteger(selected) || selected < 0 || selected >= list.length) {
        selected = list.findIndex(x => x.url === url);
    }
    if (selected < 0) selected = 0;

    if (window.ISATV &&
        typeof window.ISATV.playIsaflix === 'function') {
        window.ISATV.playIsaflix(
            cleanMediaTitle(name || 'İSAFLIX'),
            url,
            JSON.stringify(headers || {}),
            JSON.stringify(list),
            selected
        );
        return;
    }

    play({
        name:name || 'İSAFLIX',
        url:url,
        logo:'',
        group:'İSAFLIX',
        headers:headers || {}
    }, list, selected, false);
}

function openPage(url) {
    if (!isHttp(url)) return;

    if (window.ISATV && window.ISATV.openPage) {
        window.ISATV.openPage(url);
        return;
    }

    window.open(url,'_blank','noopener');
}

function renderChannels() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('all-channels');
    if (!grid) return;

    grid.innerHTML = '';

    if (!channels.length) {
        grid.innerHTML = '<p class="isa-loading">Henüz kanal bulunamadı.</p>';
        renderFavorites();
        return;
    }

    const PAGE_SIZE = 500;
    const groupCounts = new Map();

    for (let i = 0; i < channels.length; i++) {
        const group = cleanGroupTitle(channels[i].group || 'Genel');
        groupCounts.set(group, (groupCounts.get(group) || 0) + 1);
    }

    const groupNodes = new Map();

    function getGroupGrid(group) {
        if (groupNodes.has(group)) return groupNodes.get(group);

        const details = document.createElement('details');
        details.className = 'isa-channel-category';

        const summary = document.createElement('summary');
        summary.textContent = group + ' (' + groupCounts.get(group) + ')';

        const list = document.createElement('div');
        list.className = 'channels-grid';

        details.appendChild(summary);
        details.appendChild(list);
        grid.appendChild(details);

        groupNodes.set(group, list);
        return list;
    }

    let shown = 0;
    let moreButton = null;

    function appendNextPage() {
        if (moreButton) {
            moreButton.remove();
            moreButton = null;
        }

        const end = Math.min(shown + PAGE_SIZE, channels.length);

        for (let index = shown; index < end; index++) {
            const channel = channels[index];
            const group = cleanGroupTitle(channel.group || 'Genel');
            const list = getGroupGrid(group);

            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'channel-card';
            card.dataset.isaIndex = String(index);

            const thumbnail = document.createElement('div');
            thumbnail.className = 'channel-thumbnail';

            if (channel.logo) {
                const img = document.createElement('img');
                img.src = channel.logo;
                img.alt = '';
                img.onerror = function () {
                    this.style.display = 'none';
                };
                thumbnail.appendChild(img);
            } else {
                const placeholder = document.createElement('div');
                placeholder.className = 'channel-placeholder';
                placeholder.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-tv"></i>';
                thumbnail.appendChild(placeholder);
            }

            const name = document.createElement('div');
            name.className = 'channel-name';
            name.textContent = cleanMediaTitle(channel.name || 'İsimsiz kanal');

            card.appendChild(thumbnail);
            card.appendChild(name);

            card.addEventListener('click', function () {
                play(channels[index], channels, index);
            });

            list.appendChild(card);
        }

        shown = end;

        if (shown < channels.length) {
            moreButton = document.createElement('button');
            moreButton.type = 'button';
            moreButton.className = 'isa-load-more';
            moreButton.textContent =
                'Daha Fazla Kanal Yükle (' + shown + ' / ' +
                channels.length + ')';

            moreButton.style.display = 'block';
            moreButton.style.width = '100%';
            moreButton.style.padding = '14px';
            moreButton.style.margin = '16px 0';
            moreButton.style.cursor = 'pointer';

            moreButton.addEventListener('click', appendNextPage);
            grid.appendChild(moreButton);
        }
    }

    appendNextPage();
    renderFavorites();
}
function renderFavorites() {
    const section = document.getElementById('isa-favorites-section');
    const grid = document.getElementById('isa-favorites-grid');
    const toggle = document.getElementById('isa-favorites-toggle');
    if (!section || !grid || !toggle) return;
    let favorites = [];
    try {
        if (window.ISATV && window.ISATV.getFavorites) favorites = JSON.parse(window.ISATV.getFavorites() || '[]');
    } catch(e) { console.warn('Favoriler okunamadı:', e); }
    if (!Array.isArray(favorites)) favorites = [];
    if (!favorites.length) {
        isaFavoritesOpen = false;
        section.hidden = true;
        toggle.hidden = true;
        toggle.style.display = 'none';
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
        grid.innerHTML = '';
        return;
    }
    toggle.hidden = false;
    toggle.style.display = 'block';
    if (!isaFavoritesToggleBound) {
        toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
            isaFavoritesOpen = !isaFavoritesOpen;
            section.hidden = !isaFavoritesOpen;
            toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isaFavoritesOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
            toggle.innerHTML = isaFavoritesOpen ? '♥ Favoriler ▴' : '♥ Favoriler ▾';
        });
        isaFavoritesToggleBound = true;
    }
    section.hidden = !isaFavoritesOpen;
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isaFavoritesOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
    toggle.innerHTML = isaFavoritesOpen ? '♥ Favoriler ▴' : '♥ Favoriler ▾';
    grid.innerHTML = favorites.map((item,index) => `
        <div class="channel-card isa-favorite-card" data-favorite-index="${index}">
            <div class="channel-thumbnail">${item.logo ? `<img src="${esc(item.logo)}" alt="" loading="lazy" onerror="this.style.display='none'">` : '<div class="channel-placeholder"><i class="fas fa-tv"></i></div>'}</div>
            <div class="channel-name">${esc(cleanMediaTitle(item.name || 'İsimsiz içerik'))}</div>
        </div>`).join('');
    grid.querySelectorAll('[data-favorite-index]').forEach(card => card.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const item = favorites[Number(card.dataset.favoriteIndex)];
        if (!item || !item.url) return;
        const index = channels.findIndex(c => c.url === item.url);
        if (index >= 0) play(channels[index],channels,index,true);
        else play(item,favorites,Number(card.dataset.favoriteIndex),item.is_live !== false);
    }));
}

function renderSavedLists() {
    const compact = document.getElementById('isa-saved-lists');
    const full = document.getElementById('isa-all-saved-lists');
    const makeRows = () => playlists.map((item,index) => {
        const type = item.type === 'xtream' ? 'Xtream Codes' : item.type === 'mag' ? 'MAG' : 'M3U';
        const detail = item.type === 'xtream' ? item.host + ' • ' + item.username : item.type === 'mag' ? item.host + ' • ' + item.mac : (item.url || 'Cihazdan yüklenen dosya');
        return `<div class="isa-list-row"><span class="isa-list-info"><strong>${esc(item.name || ('Liste '+(index+1)))}</strong><small>${esc(type)} · ${Number(item.lastCount || 0)} içerik</small><small>${esc(detail)}</small></span><span class="isa-list-actions"><button data-refresh-list="${index}" title="Yenile"><i class="fas fa-rotate"></i></button><button class="delete" data-delete-list="${index}" title="Sil"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button></span></div>`;
    }).join('');
    if (compact) {
        if (!playlists.length) compact.innerHTML = '<p class="isa-vod-note">Henüz kaynak eklenmedi.</p>';
        else {
            const active = playlists[playlists.length-1];
            const n = playlists.length;
            compact.innerHTML = `<details class="isa-active-list"><summary><span><b>AKTİF LİSTE</b><strong>${esc(active.name || ('Liste '+n))}</strong><small>${Number(active.lastCount || 0)} içerik · ${active.type==='xtream'?'Xtream':active.type==='mag'?'MAG':'M3U'}</small></span><i class="fas fa-chevron-down"></i></summary><div class="isa-account-menu">${makeRows()}</div></details>`;
        }
    }
    if (full) full.innerHTML = makeRows() || '<p class="isa-vod-note">Henüz kaynak eklenmedi.</p>';
    [compact,full].filter(Boolean).forEach(box => {
        box.querySelectorAll('[data-refresh-list]').forEach(button => button.onclick = async e => {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); sourceLoading(true,'Kaynak yenileniyor...');
            try { await refreshAll(true); } finally { sourceLoading(false); }
        });
        box.querySelectorAll('[data-delete-list]').forEach(button => button.onclick = async e => {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); const index=Number(button.dataset.deleteList); if(!playlists[index]) return;
            if(!confirm((playlists[index].name||'Liste')+' silinsin mi?')) return;
            playlists.splice(index,1); saveLists();
            sourceLoading(true,'Kaynaklar güncelleniyor...'); try { await refreshAll(false); } finally { sourceLoading(false); }
        });
    });
}

async function loadUserLists(forceRefresh=false) {
    const result = [];

    for (let index=0; index<playlists.length; index++) {
        const item = playlists[index];

        try {
            if (item.type === 'xtream') {
                const live = await xtreamAPI(item, 'get_live_streams');

                const categories = await xtreamAPI(
                    item, 'get_live_categories'
                ).catch(() => []);

                const categoryMap = new Map(
                    (Array.isArray(categories) ? categories : []).map(c =>
                        [String(c.category_id), c.category_name || 'Genel']
                    )
                );

                for (const stream of (Array.isArray(live) ? live : [])) {
                    const ext = stream.container_extension || 'ts';
                    const url = item.host.replace(/\/+$/, '') +
                        '/live/' +
                        encodeURIComponent(item.username) + '/' +
                        encodeURIComponent(item.password) + '/' +
                        stream.stream_id + '.' + ext;

                    result.push({
                        name:stream.name || 'İsimsiz kanal',
                        url,
                        logo:stream.stream_icon || '',
                        group:categoryMap.get(
                            String(stream.category_id)
                        ) || 'Genel',
                        headers:{},
                        id:'xtream-live-' + index + '-' + stream.stream_id
                    });
                }

                item.lastCount = live.length;
                item.error = '';
                continue;
            }

            if (item.type === 'mag') {
                const magChannels = await loadMagChannels(item);

                for (const channel of magChannels) {
                    result.push(channel);
                }

                item.lastCount = magChannels.length;
                item.error = '';
                continue;
            }

            if (item.type === 'url' || item.type === 'm3u-url') {
                item.text = await getText(item.url, forceRefresh);
            }

            if (!item.text ||
                (!item.text.includes('#EXTM3U') &&
                 !item.text.includes('#EXTINF:'))) {
                throw new Error('Geçerli M3U içeriği bulunamadı.');
            }

            const parsed = parseM3U(
                item.text,
                'user-' + index
            );

            item.lastCount = parsed.length;
            item.error = '';

            // Dosya adı artık grup adına eklenmez.
            for (const channel of parsed) {
                channel.group = channel.group || 'Genel';
                result.push(channel);
            }

        } catch(error) {
            item.error = error.message || 'Kaynak yüklenemedi.';
            console.warn(item.name, error);
        }
    }

    saveLists();
    return result;
}



function xtreamAPI(source, action, extra={}) {
    const host = String(source.host || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');

    const params = new URLSearchParams({
        username:source.username,
        password:source.password,
        action,
        ...extra
    });

    return getText(
        host + '/player_api.php?' + params.toString(),
        true
    ).then(text => {
        const data = JSON.parse(text);

        if (data && data.user_info &&
            data.user_info.auth === 0) {
            throw new Error('Xtream kullanıcı bilgileri geçersiz.');
        }

        if (data && data.user_info &&
            data.user_info.status === 'Disabled') {
            throw new Error('Xtream hesabı devre dışı.');
        }

        return data;
    });
}

function sourceHost(value) {
    let host = String(value || '').trim();

    if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(host)) {
        host = 'http://' + host;
    }

    const parsed = new URL(host);

    if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(parsed.protocol)) {
        throw new Error('Geçerli HTTP/HTTPS host girin.');
    }

    return {
        host:parsed.origin + parsed.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, ''),
        hasPort:!!parsed.port
    };
}

function sourceLoading(show, message) {
    const box = document.getElementById('isa-source-loading');
    const text = document.getElementById('isa-loading-text');
    if (box) box.classList.toggle('active', !!show);
    if (text && message) text.textContent = message;
}

function nextSourceName(type) {
    const prefix = type === 'xtream' ? 'Xtream' :
                   type === 'mag' ? 'MAG' : 'M3U';

    let n = 1;
    while (playlists.some(p => p.name === prefix + ' ' + n)) n++;
    return prefix + ' ' + n;
}

async function loadMagChannels(source) {
    const host = String(source.host || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const mac = String(source.mac || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!host || !/^([0-9A-F]{2}:){5}[0-9A-F]{2}$/.test(mac)) {
        throw new Error('MAG host veya MAC adresi geçersiz.');
    }

    const portal = host + '/portal.php';
    const baseHeaders = {
        'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (QtEmbedded; U; Linux; C) AppleWebKit/533.3',
        'X-User-Agent':'Model: MAG250; Link: WiFi',
        'Referer':host + '/c/',
        'Origin':new URL(host).origin,
        'Cookie':'mac=' + mac + '; stb_lang=en; timezone=Europe/Istanbul',
        'Accept':'*/*'
    };

    async function portalRequest(params, token='') {
        const query = new URLSearchParams({
            ...params,
            JsHttpRequest:'1-xml',
            mac:mac
        });
        const headers = {...baseHeaders};
        if (token) headers.Authorization = 'Bearer ' + token;
        const raw = await getTextWithHeaders(portal + '?' + query.toString(),headers);
        let response;
        try { response = JSON.parse(raw); }
        catch (e) { throw new Error('MAG portalı geçerli JSON döndürmedi.'); }
        if (response && response.js && response.js.error) {
            throw new Error(String(response.js.error));
        }
        return response;
    }

    const handshake = await portalRequest({type:'stb',action:'handshake',token:''});
    const token = handshake && handshake.js && handshake.js.token
        ? String(handshake.js.token) : '';
    if (!token) {
        throw new Error('MAG handshake token alınamadı. MAC ve portal erişimini kontrol edin.');
    }

    try {
        await portalRequest({type:'stb',action:'get_profile'},token);
    } catch (e) {}

    let genres = [];
    try {
        const genreResponse = await portalRequest({type:'itv',action:'get_genres'},token);
        const genreData = genreResponse && genreResponse.js
            ? (genreResponse.js.data || genreResponse.js) : [];
        genres = Array.isArray(genreData) ? genreData : [];
    } catch (e) {}

    const genreMap = new Map();
    for (const genre of genres) {
        const id = genre.id ?? genre.genre_id ?? genre.tv_genre_id;
        const name = genre.title || genre.name || genre.genre_name;
        if (id != null && name) genreMap.set(String(id),String(name));
    }

    const channelResponse = await portalRequest({
        type:'itv',action:'get_all_channels',force_ch_link_check:''
    },token);

    let rows = channelResponse && channelResponse.js
        ? channelResponse.js.data : [];
    if (rows && !Array.isArray(rows) && Array.isArray(rows.data)) rows = rows.data;
    if (!Array.isArray(rows) || !rows.length) {
        throw new Error('MAG portalı kanal listesi döndürmedi.');
    }

    function cleanCommand(value) {
        return String(value || '').trim().replace(/^(ffmpeg|auto)\s+/i,'').trim();
    }

    async function resolveMagLink(row) {
        const cmd = String(row.cmd || row.url || '').trim();
        const direct = cleanCommand(cmd);
        if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(direct)) return direct;
        if (!cmd) return '';

        const linkResponse = await portalRequest({
            type:'itv',
            action:'create_link',
            cmd:cmd,
            series:'0',
            forced_storage:'',
            disable_ad:'0'
        },token);

        const data = linkResponse && linkResponse.js ? linkResponse.js : {};
        const value = cleanCommand(
            data.cmd || data.url ||
            (data.data && (data.data.cmd || data.data.url)) || ''
        );
        return /^https?:\/\//i.test(value) ? value : '';
    }

    const result = [];
    // Portalı aşırı yüklememek için dörder kanal halinde çözümlenir.
    for (let offset = 0; offset < rows.length; offset += 4) {
        const batch = rows.slice(offset,offset + 4);
        const resolved = await Promise.all(batch.map(async (row,localIndex) => {
            try {
                const url = await resolveMagLink(row);
                if (!url) return null;
                const genreId = row.tv_genre_id ?? row.genre_id ?? row.category_id ?? '';
                return {
                    name:row.name || row.title || 'MAG Kanal ' + (offset + localIndex + 1),
                    url:url,
                    logo:row.logo || row.icon || '',
                    group:row.tv_genre_name || genreMap.get(String(genreId)) || 'MAG',
                    headers:{...baseHeaders,Authorization:'Bearer ' + token},
                    id:'mag-' + mac.replace(/:/g,'') + '-' + (offset + localIndex)
                };
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }));
        for (const item of resolved) {
            if (item) result.push(item);
        }
    }

    if (!result.length) {
        throw new Error('MAG portalından oynatılabilir yayın alınamadı. Portal create_link desteği vermiyor olabilir.');
    }
    return result;
}

async function detectXtreamM3U(url) {
    try {
        const parsed = new URL(url);
        const username = parsed.searchParams.get('username');
        const password = [REDACTED]('password');

        if (!username || !password) return null;

        const source = {
            host:parsed.origin,
            username,
            password
        };

        const data = await xtreamAPI(
            source,
            'get_live_categories'
        );

        if (!Array.isArray(data)) return null;

        return source;
    } catch(error) {
        return null;
    }
}

async function addM3UUrl(url) {
    const xtream = await detectXtreamM3U(url);

    if (xtream) {
        const choice = confirm(
            'Bu adres Xtream Codes desteği sunuyor.\\n\\n' +
            'Tam Xtream sistemiyle film ve dizileri de yüklemek için ' +
            'Tamam seçin.\\n\\n' +
            'Yalnızca düz M3U kanalları için İptal seçin.'
        );

        if (choice) {
            playlists.push({
                ...xtream,
                type:'xtream',
                name:nextSourceName('xtream')
            });
        } else {
            playlists.push({
                type:'url',
                name:nextSourceName('m3u'),
                url,
                text:''
            });
        }
    } else {
        playlists.push({
            type:'url',
            name:nextSourceName('m3u'),
            url,
            text:''
        });
    }

    saveLists();
    await refreshAll(false);
}
